ji ltar 'dab gshog med pa yi// bya yis mkha' la 'phur mi nus// de bzhin mngon shes stobs bral bas// sems (563) can don byar nus ma yin// zhes pa dang*/ ji srid mngon shes med pa de srid gzhan don mi bya ba bse ru lta bur gnas par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar smin byed kyi lam sngon du btang nas stong nyid zab mo sgom na tshegs chung zhing don che bas dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba dang 'chi ba rjes su dran pa kha tsam min par sems dang 'dres pa yang yang bsgoms pa'i ngang nas/ 'du byed sdug bsngal la dgongs nas/ sdug bsngal sgom par gsungs pa yin/ zhes pa ltar 'khor ba'i bde ba mtha' dag duḥkha'i rang bzhin du nges pa legs par drangs te/ dge sdig gi blang dor la 'bad dgos par sa'i snying po'i mdo las/ gang zhig ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dge ba'i las kyi lam gcig tsam yang mi srung la/ 'on kyang tshig 'di skad du/ nga ni (564) theg pa chen po ste/ nga bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'tshol zhes zer na/ gang zag de ni shin tu tshul 'chos dang rdzun chen po smra ba/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'jig rten pa slu bar byed pa chad par smra ba ste/ de rmongs bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus byed cing log par ltung bar 'gro'o// zhes pa dang*/ de ltar rgyu dang 'bras bu thams cad med par blta zhing chad par smra ba dag ni mi'i nang na gnas kyang*/ de ni yang dag par srin po yin no// zhes gsungs so// gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par/ dbang po yongs su ma smin pa rnams la ni chos kyi gtam brjod par mi bya'o// zhes pa dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdor/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po las thog ma pa la de nyid brjod du yod pa'i 'du shes kyi tshul gyis dmigs pa dang (565) bcas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug brjod par bya'o// zhes pa dang*/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdor/

theg pa chen po sdud par byed pa'i chos gcig ste/ bya ba 'jug par 'os pa la zhugs shing las kyi rnam par smin pa la yid ches pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ rgyu 'bras mi slu bar yod pa'i 'du shes brtan po bzung nas sku gzugs dang mchod rten la sogs pa mdun du byas te phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa 'bul ba la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa dang skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga rgyas bsdus gang rung gis yang yang sems bskyed pa dang*/ mdo klog pa dang mchod rten bskor ba dang tsha tsha btab pa la sogs pa 'phags pa'i yul du byon pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mchog gi grub pa brnyes pa dag gis las dang po pa'i sa sbyang ba'i (566) bstan bcos rnams las 'byung ba'i chos spyod la brtson par bya zhing de dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba gal che ste/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus par/ dper na rdza mkhan gyis snod du ma byas par snod kyi ming mi 'thob bo// shā ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub tu ma bsngos pas ni pha ro tu phyin pa'i ming mi 'thob bo// zhes gsungs so// yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa dang*// nyan dang len dang 'dzin pa dang*// klog dang kha ton byed pa dang*// de sems pa dang sgom pa'o// spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid ni// bsod nams phung po dpag tu med// ces kyang gsungs so// deng sang bstan pa nyams pa'i dus su tshul khrims srung ba dang dam pa'i chos byed pa phan yon shin tu che ba yin te/ zla ba sgron me'i mdor/ bskal pa bye (567) ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du// sangs rgyas dag ni bye ba khrag khrig la// gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i phreng ba dang*// zas dang skom gyis dad sems mchod byas pas// gang gis dam pa'i chos ni 'jig pa'i tshe// bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'gag pa na// nyin zhag gcig tu bslab pa gcig bzung ba// de bas bsod nams 'di ni khyad par 'phags// zhes pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snang tshul la yang bsam par bya'o// rgyal sras kyi spyod pa thams cad bsam pa dang*/

sbyor ba gnyis yin la/ bsam pa ni tshad med pa bzhin yin cing de yang snying rje chen por 'dus te/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshad med pa 'di dag thams cad ni snying brtse ba zhes bya ste/ de lta (568) bas na de dag dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ni brtse ba can zhes bya'o// zhes gsungs so// de ni spyir sems can sdug bsngal ba thams cad la dmigs nas skye ba yin la/ khyad par du/ rab 'bar dgra yi dbang du song*// sdug bsngal gyis non mun pas bsgribs// bgrod dka'i lam du kun tu zhugs// 'ching ba che dang yang dag ldan// zas chen dag dang 'dres la zhen// lam ni rab tu stor gyur pa// lam gol rab zhugs stobs chung ba'i// sems can rnams la snying rje'o// zhes pa'i bye brag bcu la dmigs nas bsgom pa yin no// gzhan don sgrub pa'i sbyor ba thams cad ni bsdu ba'i dngos bzhir 'dus pas des byed pa'i tshul ni/ sbyin mtshungs de ston len 'jug dang*// bdag nyid rjes su 'jug rnams (569) kyis// snyan par smra dang don spyod dang*// don mthun nyid du 'dod pa yin// zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ sbyin pa'i g.yab mos legs bos te// snyan par smra bas gtam byas te// don mthun pa yin bag phab ste// don chen gros chen gdab par bya// zhes pa ltar ro// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// (570) ༈ //gsum pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs gtan la dbab pa la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ gzhung dang sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ spyir theg dman las/ theg chen khyad par 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan (571) ni/ mdo sdud par/ ci phyir de ni sems dpa' che zhes bya zhe na// sems can tshogs rnams mang po'i mchog tu gyur pa na// sems can khams kyi lha rnams chen po gcod pas te// de phyir sems dpa' chen po (572) zhe/ ni rab brjod do// gtong ba che dang blo che ba dang mthu che ba// rgyal ba rnams kyi theg chen mchog la zhugs pa dang*// go cha chen po bgos shing bdud kyi rgyu 'dul ba// de yi phyir na sems dpa' che zhes rab tu brjod// ces pa dang*/

dmigs pa chen po nyid dang ni// de bzhin sgrub pa nyid dag dang*// ye shes brtson 'grus brtsom pa dang*// thabs la mkhas par gyur pas te// chen po 'di dag dang ldan pas// theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod// ces gsungs pa de ni sngags dang mtshan nyid kyi (573) theg pa gnyis ka'i khyad chos thun mong ba yin la/ khyad par sngags kyi theg pa'i khyad chos la/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes pa'i don ni phal cher la grags pas go sla la/ slob dpon dz+nyā na shrīs/ sngags kyi theg pa 'di theg pa chen po dbu ma pa las kyang khyad par ci zhig yod par bstan ce na/ dmigs pa dang sgrub pa dang ye shes dang brtson 'grus dang (574) gdul bya ma lus pa rjes su 'dzin nus pa dang*/ nyon mongs byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ byin gyis rlob pa myur ba dang*/ myur du 'byung ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa spong pa dang*/ bsam pa spyod pa bla na med pa'i thabs mkhas pa ste rnam pa bcu gcig gis khyad par du 'phags so// zhes pa'i dang po ni/ dgyes pa rdo rje dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang*/ dgra nag la sogs pa'i rgyud sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa la dmigs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la brten nas lus kyi bkod pa sna tshogs pa dang ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis kyang ston nus pa'o// gsum pa ni/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la brten nas rgyud dang ngo bo dang las dag pas ye shes myur du 'grub pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i dbang gis brtson 'grus chen po myur du brtsom pa'o// lnga pa ni/ mtshams (575) med pa lnga byed pa la sogs theg pa gzhan du spangs pa rnams kyang 'dir 'grub par 'gyur ba'o// drug pa ni/ lha mchod pa'i tshul dang bde ba la brten pa'i rdzogs rim la sogs pa'o// bdun pa ni/

da lta nyid nas sangs rgyas kyis dbang bskur cing byin gyis rlob pa'o// brgyad pa ni/ tshe 'di dang skye ba bdun dang skye ba bcu drug nas nges par 'tshang rgya ba'o// dgu pa ni/ yul rnams khyad par can du byas te/ dbyibs dang kha dog gi dam tshig gis nyon mongs pa rang bzhin gyis grol ba'o// bcu pa ni/ bskyed rim gyi dmigs pas tha mal gyi snang ba 'gags te/ las kyi rnam smin log nas bsod nams kyi tshogs 'phel cing bdag med pa'i don la ngang gis 'jug ste/ rnam par smin pa 'dir smin pa// las rnams kyi ni 'bras bu thob// gang tshe grub pa thob gyur pa// de tshe las (576) kyi rnam smin ldog /sems ni rang dngos med phyir dang*// 'bras bu rgyu rnams spangs pa'i phyir// las kyi skye ba rnams las thar// skye ba nam mkha' lta bu yin// zhes gsungs so// gsang sngags bzlas pas ngag rgyal ba'i bkar 'gyur chos rjes su dran cing chos la shes nas dad pa thob/ bden pa'i tshig 'grub cing thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa'i ye shes dang dran pa thos bsam rtse gcig par 'gyur/ 'phags pa rnams mchod pa dang 'gro ba'i don du 'gyur/ lha mnyes shing dngos grub ster/ chos thams cad yi ge'i rnam 'phrul la dbang bsgyur/ bdag med kyi don rim gyis 'jug sgra thams cad brag char shes pa'o// thugs kyi rnal 'byor gyis chos rnams sgyu ma lta bur shes shing nyon mongs pa rnams tshegs med par spangs te/ gnyen po dge ba la rloms sems med par mchog thun mong gi dngos grub nges par (577) thob bo// bcu gcig pa ni/ dka' thub sdom pa mi bzad pa// bsten nas 'grub par mi 'gyur gyi// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// brten na myur du 'grub par gsungs// zhes gsungs pas/ lus gsos shing yid bde bas rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ sems kyi ting nge 'dzin ni gtso bor byed pa dang*/ btsog gtsang dang bzang ngan gyi rtog pa gzhom pa'i phyir sha lnga la sogs pa mi gtsang ba dag la'ang ngor snyoms par spyod pa yin no// gnyen po stobs chung bas nyon mongs tshar gcod mi nus pa dang*/

sems phyi rol tu g.yengs pa dang*/ gtsang zhen gyi rtog pa spong mi nus pa'i gang zag la/ bsnyung bar gnas pa dang sbyang ba'i yon tan la gnas nas glegs bam klog pa dang*/ mchod rten bskor ba la sogs lus ngag gi spyod pa gtso bor gsungs pa yin no// gsang sngags (578) kyi khyad chos de dag mtshan nyid pa'i theg pa la yang cha mthun tsam gyis 'dod yon lam du byed pa dang*/ yi ge a ra pa tsa na la sogs pa re re'i sgra don chos kyi sgo du ma la 'jug pa la sogs gsungs na'ang*/ sngags kyi theg par gsungs pa'i khyad chos nyon mongs rdo rje 'chang gi lam du 'khyer tshul dang don mi cig go /bla ma 'ga' zhig sngags kyi theg pa'i zab khyad dngos gzhi bskyed rim la sbyor ba yang dbang gong ma rnams kyi lam rim chos zab pa rnams yal bar 'dor ba'i rkyen tshig yin nam snyam mo// dbu ma pa'i spros bral stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba dang*/ sngags kyi lta ba'i mthar thug khyad par med par nyams su len dgos na'ang*/ spros bral du shes par bya ba'i gzhi thabs kyi bye brag mang po yod pa'i phyir/ des khyad par du byas pa'i stong pa nyid nyams su len pa yin gyi/ stong nyid rkyang pa sgom pa'i rdzogs rim sngags kyi

(579) nyams len la mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor pa la med do// yang mtshan nyid kyi theg pa la rgyu dang*/ sngags la 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes rgyu 'bras kyi tha snyad mdzad pa ni dbang mdor bstan du/ stong nyid lugs 'dzin rgyu yin te// 'bras bu snying rje mi 'gyur 'dzin// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// byang chub sems zhes bya bar bshad// ces rnams pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid gtso bor ston pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa ste/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdor/ 'di lta ste dper na/ bu kha nas rlung 'jug pa de bzhin du gang dang gang nas sems la skyon byung ba de dang de nas bdud kyis klag rnyed par 'gyur ro// de lta bas na byang chub sems dpas sems la skyon med pa nyid du bya'o// de la sems la skyon med pa ni 'di yin te/ 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog (580) dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'o// rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang la 'di la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su mi gtong bas dngos po thams cad stong pa nyid du goms par byed pa'am/ goms par byas pas te/ zhes pa ltar ro// de la brten nas 'bras bu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po 'byung bas de gtso bor ston pa sngags kyi theg pa'o// yang na blo'i 'dzin stangs sems can las dang nyon mongs pa dang de'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal bas gdung pa rnams la byams pa dang snying rje la sogs pa sgom pa dang*/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems sbyong pa la sogs sangs rgyas kyi rgyu'i chos la goms par byed pa dang*/ da lta nyid nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi nga rgyal bzung nas lam bsgrub pa'i tshul gyis rgyu 'bras kyi theg par bzhag pa yin no// zhes (581) kyang bla ma dam pa dag gsungs so// rgyud kyi don ni/ thog mtha' bar du rgyun mi chad pa gnas pa yin te/

rdo rje rtse mor/ rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya ba ste// 'khor ba rgyud du 'dod pa yin// zhes pa dang*/ gsang 'dus su/ rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste// rgyun de rnam pa gsum du 'dod// gzhi dang de yi rang bzhin dang*// mi 'phrogs pa yi rab dbye'o// rang bzhin rnam pa rgyu yin te// gzhi ni thabs zhes bya bar brjod// de bzhin yid 'phrog 'bras bu yin// zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis// don ni rnam pa gsum du 'dus// rgyu dang thabs dang 'bras bu'o// rgyu ni theg chen rigs can te// dge ba'i chos kyis rnam par brgyan// thabs ni rnam pa gnyis yin te// dbang bskur de bzhin spyod dang bcas// 'bras bu sku (582) gsum thun mong grub// yang dag spong bar byed dang bcas// zhes rgyu rgyud dang theg chen gyi rigs dang sangs rgyas kyi snying po rnams don gcig cing*/ sam+pu ṭir/ rang bzhin ngo bo nyid 'di la// chos kyi skur ni rab tu brjod// ces pa dang*/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// zhes pa dang*/ gur du/ chos kyi dbyings ni mchog tu zhi// 'di ni rin chen sems su brjod// yid bzhin nor bu rin po che// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu rab ster ba// zhes pa dang*/ sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das phro ba// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster byed pa'i// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa dang*/ rgyal ba byams pas/ de bzhin nyid 'di thams cad la// khyad par (583) med kyang dag 'gyur bas// de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir// 'gro kun de yi snying po can// zhes gsung pa'i don sems kyi chos nyid 'dus ma byas pa'i de bzhin nyid yin pas 'dus byas kyi spros pas dben pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dang*/

sems kyi chos can rang rig pa'i ngo bo 'dod chags la sogs pa'i sems byung glo bur gyi dri mas rang bzhin gyis dben pa'i phyir sems kyi rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba yin te/ brgyad stong par/ sems la sems ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o// zhes so// de gnyis zung du 'jug pa ni 'dir rgyu rgyud yin no// de sems can thams cad la khyab pa'i don gyi rigs chad pa'i gang zag mi srid cing*/ mdo sde rgyan du/ la la gcig tu nyes pa spyod nges yod// la la thar pa cha mthun (584) dge ba med// la la dkar po'i chos rnams rnam par bcom// dkar po dman pa yod pa'ang rgyu dang bral// zhes pa dang log sred can gtan yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba zhes gsungs pa ni/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs med pa la dgongs pa yin te/ thogs med rang bzhin gnas pa dang*// yang dag blangs pa mchog nyid do// zhes pa dang*/ gter dang ljon pa'i shing bzhin du// rigs 'di rnam gnyis shes bya ste// zhes rgyal tshab byams pa'i gsung shin tu gsal zhing go sla ba 'di lta bu la'ang gsung nang 'gal bar smra ba dang*/ rang gi blo'i dri ma ngan pas dmus long lta bur gyur kyang gsung rab kyi don la blo gros kyi mig dang ldan par rlom pa du ma zhig byung ngo*// bdag med ma'i bstod 'grel du/ chos rje nyid kyis/ rgyu rgyud ni rang bzhin dri med ces pa ste/ rang gi (585) sems kyi chos nyid rang bzhin gyi rtog pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba yin te/ hai badz+ra las/ sangs rgyas ma yin sems can min// gcig kyang yod pa ma yin te// zhes pa dang*/ 'phags pa byams pas kyang*/ chu khams gser dang nam mkha' bzhin// dag pa bzhin du dag pas gnas// zhes gsungs pa yin no// de ltar na 'bad pa med par grol bar 'gyur ro zhe na ma yin te/ blo gros glo bur du dri mas sgribs pa zhes smos te/ sems kyi chos nyid rang bzhin gyis dag kyang sems kyi mtshan nyid glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs pa zhes bya ba'i don to// de ltar rang bzhin gyi dag pa la glo bur gyi dri mas gos na 'bad pa don med par 'gyur ro zhe na ma yin te/

glo bur gyi dri ma ni sbyang du rung ba la bya'o// sngar med pa la phyis (586) dri ma byung ba lta bu ma yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo las kyang*/ gang dag sbyang du rung ba'i chos de ni glo bur ba'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na gang zhig gser 'grub pa'i dus su g.ya' 'grub mod kyang g.ya' sbyang na dag par 'gyur bas de la glo bur ba zhes gdags so// dri mas bsgribs pa zhes pa ni/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pas thar pa'i go skabs bkag pa'o// rgyu'i rgyud zhes rgyu rgyud kyi ngos 'dzin lam khyer gsungs pa 'di mkhyen par mdzod la sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta 'di ltar 'dod do// cal col smra ba rnams thugs dran pas 'dzin par zhu/ grub chen bir+wa pas kyang kun gzhi rgyu rgyud ces pa dang*/ kun gzhi rnam par dag pa chos kyi sku'o zhes pa dang*/ 'di ni rang bzhin sku gsum dang*// ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid de// sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// sangs (587) rgyas gzhan du bstan pa med// ces pa dang*/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// srid med mya ngan 'das pa med// bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste// chos 'di bde ba chen po'o// zhes khyad par gyi chos dang ldan pa gsal bar gsungs so// thabs kyi rgyud ni bla ma dam pa dang*/ smin byed dbang dang grol byed rim pa gnyis dang*/ de'i grogs su gyur pa phyag rgya dang dam tshig dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rdo rje'i lus skyon med pa rnams yin te/ lus thabs rgyud ces gsungs so// 'bras bu'i rgyud ni gnas skabs thun mong gi 'bras bu mkha' spyod dang*/ sa 'og na spyod pa dang gnod sbyin ma dbang du bsdud pa la sogs dngos grub che chung rnams ci rigs par thob cing*/ mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya chen po mngon du 'gyur ba yin te/ (588) phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud ces gsungs so// de dag ston par byed pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi gsung la'ang rgyud kyi mtshan btags pa yin no// rgyud sde 'og ma rnams la mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i rgyas gdab pa shas chung na yang rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams kyi brjod bya'i don zab cing rgya che ba rnams la rang gar 'jug pa dgag pa dang*/

snod min la gsang ba'i phyir tshul bzhi dang mtha' drug gis rgyas btab pa rnams snod ldan la ston pa'i tshe 'grol shes dgos pas/ de la tshul bzhi ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ yi ge dang ni yan lag dang*// bsdus pa'i don dang spyi yi don// sbas dang de bzhin thar thug pa// rgyud rnams nges pa kho na yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar brjod bya spyi dang*/ sbas pa dang mthar thug pa dang gsum/ brjod byed yi ge'i (589) tshul dang bzhi las/ spyi ni mtshan nyid theg pa'i lam la goms pa'i nyan thos dang rgyal sras rnams kyi theg pa la zhugs pa rnams kyi brjod pa dang the tshom spang ba'i phyir lam lnga dang phyogs mthun sum cu rtsa bdun bshad pa lta bu sngags dang mtshan nyid gnyis ka la yod pa'i spyi dang*/ dang po sbyor ba dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin gsum lha bskyed tshul phal cher la mthun par ston pa bskyed pa'i rim pa spyi dang*/ de bzhin du skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sdom pa bzung ba dang rab gnas dang sbyin sreg dang gtor chog la sogs phal cher rgyud mang po la spyi khyab tu yod pa rnams spyi'i khongs su 'dus pa yin no// gzhan yang rgyud ni rgyud gzhan gyis rtogs par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar rnal 'byor bla med du yang*/ dkyil 'khor cho ga de nyid 'dus pa ltar (590) bya bar gsungs pa dang*/ spyi rgyud dus gsung pa'i dam tshig dang lag len mang po spyi khyab tu sgrub dgos pa rnams spyi'i tshul du 'dus pa yin no// sbas pa'i don ni/ spyir mchog dbang gsum ma thob cing bum pa'i dbang tsam gyi lam la brten pa'i gang zag la/ gong ma'i dbang dang dam tshig la nyams len rnams sba zhing*/ slob dpon gyi dbang ma thob pa la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bya ba dang dam tshig rnams kyang sbas pa yin la/ de bzhin du gong ma gong ma'i dbang dang lam dang dam tshig rnams 'og ma rnams la sbas pa'i don yin no// spyir bla med kyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i rdo rje bzlas pa dang*/

rang byin brlabs dang*/ sems can rnam par dag pa'i rim pa yang gsang sngags kyi zab don yin pas sbas pa'i tshul du bshad dgos te/ sgron gsal las/ sbas pa rnam pa gsum du bshad// (591) ces so// de las kyang khyad par du 'dod chags lam du byed pa'i thabs kyi man ngag phyag rgya bzhi bsten pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ de la brten pa'i ye shes ngos bzung nas nyams su len pa'i tshul ni rnams pa kun tu sbas pa'i don yin no// mthar thug pa'i tshul ni/ spyir de las gong du bogs dbyung du med pa gcig la zer ba yin cing*/ mi slob lam dang bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa la sogs pa dang*/ sngags kyi lam la sa bcu gnyis pa dang*/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa lta bu 'bras bu'i mthar thug pa dang*/ rim pa lnga'i zung 'jug gi rim pa las lhag pa'i lam med pas lam gyi mthar thug dang*/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i de bzhin nyid las gzhan pa'i pha rol na rtog par bya ba'i don med pas don dam pa'i bden pa mthar (592) thug tu gsungs pa lta bu'o// gzhan yang*/ dbang bzhi dang 'brel pa'i rtogs pa tshad du phyin yang*/ rang rang gi mthar thug gi don du bshad kyang 'gal ba med do// rjod byed yi ge'i don ni/ thun mong gi rig pa nges brjod/ sdeb sbyor dang*/ dbyings dang*/ rtags dang*/ rkyen gyi yi ge la sogs pa sgra la mngon par zhen pa rnams rjes su bzung ba dang*/ brnyas pa bzlog pa'i phyir bshad pa yin te/ sgra yi bstan bcos rab gsal ba'i// phyi rol bstan bcos mkhas pa yis// de yi sgrub pa rab ston pa// yi ge'i don du nges par bshad// ces pa ltar yi ge'i dbyings dang yi ge kha phral te phri ba dang bsnan pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis bshad pa/ na ra mi dang*/ ga bi ba lang dang*/ ku ra khyi dang*/ rak+ta khrag dang*/ shu kra khu ba'i ming la/ yi ge phyis bsnon gyis (593) ston pa/ sha lngar/ na las mi'i sha ga las ba lang gi sha

ku las khyi'i sha zhes pa dang*/ bdud rtsi lngar/ ra las khrag dang*/ shu las khu ba zhes pa lta bu dang*/ thugs kyi sa bon hūm̐ yig la so sor phral te ha la sngon du gh+ra dang*/ phyis ka bsnan te/ gh+ra ka zhes pa bzung ba dang*/ de bzhin du gh+ra ha tsa zhes pa 'dzin pa dang*/ zhabs kyu'i ū yig sha'i srog tu bcug pas shu dang*/ n+ya tā bsnan pas shu n+yā tā stong pa nyid dang*/ klad skor gyi ma la a no byin pas/ ma nu zhes pas yid de/ de ltar bzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong par gyur pa'i yid de nyid la/ yi ge tra sbyar bas rnam par rtog pa las skyob pa'i don du 'gyur ba la sogs pa dang*/ e baṃ ma ya zhes pa la/ e yig dbyibs gru gsum du yod pa/ lte ba man chad (594) sum mdo'i bar gru gsum du gnas pa/ dbyibs mthun pa tsam la e yig tu btags pa la sogs dang*/ sgra la mkhas par rlom pa rnams sngags kyi don la rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang*/ yan lag gi rlung lnga ste bcu las/ ko ṭā khyad ko ṭā ba zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ lha sbyin gtsang pa klu zhes pa la sogs sangs rgyas kho nas brda sbyar ba yin gyis/ sgra sgrub rgyud dang ming don bshad rgyu med pa'i yi ge bla ma dam pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa kho na la rag las pa du ma yod do// mtha' drug ni sgron gsal du/ drang ba dang ni nges don bcas// dgongs pas bshad dang dgongs min dang*// ji bzhin ji bzhin ma yin sgra// mtha' ni drug tu shes par bya// zhes pas nges don zab mo bstan pa'i snod du mi rung ba'i gang zag the tshom dang yid gnyis can rnams la/ bskyed rim (595) dang zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i dngos grub phra mo ston pa drang don dang zab mo bstan pa'i snod du rung ba'i gdul bya skal ldan la/ sbas pa'i don zab mo gsal bar ston pa nges don dang*/ shin tu zab pa'i don 'jig rten gyi lugs dang 'gal ba'i tshig gis ston pa dgongs pa dang*/

tshig gi tha snyad spyod pa'i shes rab dman cing shin tu zab pa'i don bstan pa'i snod du rung pa la/ 'jig rten na grags pa'i tshig gis ston pa dgongs pa ma yin pa dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i thig dang*/ tshon gyi cho ga dang*/ nad zhi ba dang*/ tshe spel ba dang*/ char dbab pa la sogs sgra ji bzhin pa bstan pa dang*/ rnal 'byor slongs mas mi rgyu zhing*// zhes pa lta bu/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa skad cig tsam yang sems la mi rgyu bar yang dag pa'i (596) don sgom pa lta bu sgra ji bzhin ma yin par bshad dgos pa yin no// bshad tshul de dag kyang rkyang pa dang*/ gcig la gnyis dang*/ gsum la sogs pa tshang ba'i rnam bzhag 'grel pa dang man ngag gi yi ge rnams su yang mi gsal cing rtogs par dka' ba mang du yod pa rnams la yun ring du goms par byas te/ rang rgyud la nges pa yang dag par drangs nas skal ba dang ldan pa dag la'ang rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa ma nor bar ston pa ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod kyi bstan pa lung gi chos 'dzin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mtshan gsal bar rig pa yin no// rgyud nyan pa'i slob ma ni slob dpon zla ba grags pas rigs lngar bshad do// thog mar rgyu thos pa'i tshe/ tshig don 'dzin pa la mkhas kyang myur du brjed par gyur te bsam byung gi shes rab kyis gtan la 'bebs par mi nus pas ut+pal lta bu dang*/ tshig

(597) don mang du thos shing bzung bar gyur kyang gzhan la ston pa'i mthu med pa pad dkar lta bu dang*/ dad pa dang snying rje dang shes rab dang ldan pas tshig don khong du chud kyang rim gyis nyams par 'gyur ba pad+ma dmar po lta bu dang*/ thos pa nyung zhing nga rgyal che la don rtogs pa'am rtsa ba med par tshig tu smra ba mang la gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i yan lag dang bral ba tsan+dan lta bu dang*/ tshul khrims dag cing mkhas shing sgrin la tshig don legs par khong du chud nas gdul bya'i blo dang mthun par ston pa rin po che lta bu'i gang zag go /dang po bzhi la bum pa'i dbang bskur nas bskyed rim dang drang don gyi cha ci rigs pa bstan pa'i snod du rung bas tshogs la bshad pa zhes bya/ lnga pa ni mchog dbang gsum bskur nas sbas pa dang nges pa'i don zab mo bstan pa'i snod du rung ba slob ma la bshad pa zhes (598) rigs gnyis su mdzad do// slob dpon mkhas pa rnams kyi bshad srol la/ rnal 'byor rgyud du/ dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa la snod du rung mi rung brtag mi dgos par gsungs pas/ slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas legs par bsgrubs pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor lta bu/ khrom chen pos mthong ba la yang gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa med cing*/ mtshams med lnga la sogs sdig pa chen po las grol ba'i phan yon yod de/ nyin re bram ze gsod pa dang*// mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang*// gdol pa smig ma mkhan la sogs// tshon rtsi mthong bas grol bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas nyams su len pa'i gang zag yin na snod brtag dgos shing*/ de la bya rgyud kyi nyams len tsam la theg chen sems bskyed (599) dang gso sbyong zhag re tsam blangs pa la/ lha bsgom bzlas bogs su rung ba'i phyir snod brtag dgos pa che chung ngo*// rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de nyid bsdus pa lta bu'i chos sgor zhugs nas nyams su len pa yin na/

so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang theg chen sems bskyed gzhir bzhag pa'i steng du rigs lnga'i sdom pa srung ba'i snod rung la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang bskur nas don byed nus gcig dgos par gsal lo// rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi chos sgor zhugs nas nyams su len pa'i gang zag la/ rigs gnyis su pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gnyis med kyi rgyud thams cad nas gsal bar gsungs pas/ kun rdzob bskyed pa'i rim pa la brten nas thun mong gi dngos grub don du gang zag la/ bum dbang gi dam tshig dang sdom pa ma nyams par (600) bsrung ba gcig dgos la/ don dam rdzogs rim la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa'i gang zag la/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa blangs nas ma nyams par bsrung ba gcig dgos pas gdul bya'i snod brtag pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid bla ma lnga bcu par gsungs pa ltar legs par brtag nas blang dor byed pa shin tu gal che'o// rgyu mtshan des na gsang sngags kyi sgor 'jug pa'i gang zag la chos de dang de'i snod du rung mi rung brtag pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'i tshe yang yol ba'i phyir byed pa shin tu gal che'o// 'jug dang nang 'jug dang gdong ras 'ching ba la sogs de dag chen po mdzad pa yin no// rgyud sde bzhir 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mi rigs bzhi'i spyod tshul dang bstun nas 'jog pa dang*/ rdzogs ldan la sogs pa dus bzhi chen po dang sbyar nas 'jog pa dang*/ (601) gnyid sad pa la sogs pa bag chags bzhi sbyor ba dang sbyar ba dang*/ thun mtshams bzhi dang sbyar ba dang*/ grub mtha' bzhi dang sbyar ba dang*/ phyi rol pa'i rig byed bzhi dang sbyar ba dang*/ 'dod chags rigs bzhi dang sbyar ba la sogs pa rgyas par mkhas pa rnams kyis yang dang yang gtan la phab pas 'dir ma smos la/ rgyud sde lnga dang drug dang gsum du 'byed tshul yang de dag na gsal lo// spyir sngags kyi theg pa'i khyad chos rgyud sde 'og ma rnams la'ang tshang dgos na 'byed tshul 'ga' zhig la ji bzhin du sbyar dka' bar snang ngo*// rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos gtso cher thabs kyi cha nas 'dod yon lam du byed pa dang*/

shes rab kyi cha nas rgyu rgyud kyi khyad chos tshang ba sems kyi steng du ngos bzung nas nyams su len pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa (602) ma spangs par sangs rgyas kyi lam du khyer ba yin pas/ khyad chos gal che ba rnams ma tshang na gsang sngags kyis go mi chod pa'i phyir byang phyogs kyi lam la yang tshang dgos so// sam+pu ṭīr/ srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhir gnas// zhes pa'i don nyon mongs pa la gnas nas nyon mongs pa zad par byed pa yin te/ shing 'bu shing la gnas nas za bar byed pa bzhin no// de la nyon mongs pa dug gsum du 'dus pa rgyud sde 'og ma gnyis gti mug shas che ba'i gang zag dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud drug gsum bar ma la gnas pa dang*/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi pha rgyud dug gsum chen po la gnas pa dang*/ ma rgyud dug gsum shin tu che ba'i rigs can la gsungs pa yin te/ rab tu sgron gsal las/ de la rab dang 'bring gi gti mug gi rigs can la/ rgyud bstan (603) to// gti mug dman pa'i rigs can rnams la spyod pa'i rgyud bstan to// dman pa dang bar ma'i 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi rigs can rnams la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud bstan to// 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug rab kyi rigs can rnams la rnal 'byor bla ma'i rgyud bstan to// rab rab kyi 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi rigs can rnams la rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud bstan to// zhes gsungs pa ltar nyon mongs pa gzhan thams cad kyi rtsa ba yang gti mug yin pas/ de'i lam du byed tshul bya ba'i rgyud du gsungs pa bzhin nyams len byas pa la/ las dang po pas khams dwangs par bya ba'i phyir srog chags med pa'i chu gtsang gis dus gsum du khrus byed pa dang*/ gos gsar pa brje ba dang*/ ku sha gtsang ma'i stan la (604) 'dug pa dang*/ stan gcig dang*/ bsnyung gnas dang*/ dkar gsum tsam la brten nas gnyid kyi rgyu rnams spangs te/

thog mar nang gi dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu 'jog mi nus pas phyi rol gyi ras bris la sems bzung nas nyams su len pa yin no// de yang dpung bzangs las/ bu gcig lus dag par ni bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pas bsnyung ba mi gsungs te// bsam gtan bde ba 'grub par bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pas bsnyung ba rjes su gsungs// zhes so// gti mug bsrabs par gyur pas bris sku nyid yi dam gyi lha dang dbyer med du gyur nas 'od zer bgyed pa dang*/ lung ston pa dang*/ dngos grub stsol bar mdzad pa yin no// de bas gti mug shas chung ba'i rigs can gyis ras bris kyi lha dang rang nyid lhar bskyed pa res 'jog tu nyams su blangs pas (605) gom pa mthar phyin nas yi dam gyi lha'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum mtshungs shing khyad par med par gyur pa'i tshe grub pa yin no// de yang*/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur bar/ ye shes rdo rje bla na med// bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa yi// ye shes gzugs su gnang ba 'di// blun po rnams kyi mi shes so// zhes spang bya gti mug ngos bzung nas/ yid rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa de tshe rnam pa thams cad du brtag par bdag gi lus dang lha'i gzugs mtshungs pa dang*/ bdag gi ngag dang lha'i ngag tu mtshungs pa dang*/ bdag gi yid dang lha'i yid du mtshungs par mthong ba de'i tshe mnyam par bzhag pa yin no// zhes gsungs so// dug gsum bar ma la gnas pa'i gdul byas/ phung po lnga dang nyon (606) mongs lnga la/ rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga'i tha snyad cha mthun tsam du sbyar nas/ de rnams so so'i cha la 'khor gyi lha dang sbyar te/ dam tshig pa bskyed de ye shes pa spyan drangs nas gcig tu byas pa la/ dam tshig phyag rgyas sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i thugs dang*/ chos kyi phyag rgyas gsung dang*/ phyag rgya chen pos sku dang*/ las kyi phyag rgyas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las su byin gyis brlabs te mi 'bral bar bcings nas/

mnyam pa gsum gyi ngang la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum bya ba dang bcas pa rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs phrin las su sgrub pa yin te/ de nyid 'dus par/ ji ltar rgyal po'i phyag rgya nyid// rgyal po'i khrims la 'debs pa ltar// bdag nyid chen pos skye bo rnams// sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje yi// gzugs brnyan gyi (607) ni tshul du yang*// nyid kyi phyag rgyas btab pa ni// bdag nyid che ba'i phyag rgya cher// shes nas dngos grub thob par 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan mdun du tshig tsam gyis kyang sgoms la/ ci dga' bar byed cing rdo rje'i tshig gis lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na myur bar dngos grub tu 'gyur ro// zhes pas mdun du lha sku gsal btab tsam gyis kyang phrin las sgrub par nus so// nyon mongs chen po la gnas pa'i gdul bya la rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud nyams su len tshul rags pa phyis rim gyis bstan par bya'o// rnal 'byor ma rgyud la sgyu 'phrul chen po'i lugs kyis/ sngags dang dbyibs dang chos bdag nyid sbyor ba rnam gsum shes bya ste/ ye shes rnam pa gsum gyis ni// srid pa'i nyes pas gos mi 'gyur// zhes pa'i don bum pa'i (608) dbang lus la bskur nas bskyed rim sprul skur ngo shes nas sgom pa dbyibs kyi bdag nyid nyams su len pa dang*/ gsang dbang ngag la bskur nas ngag longs skur ngo shes nas gtum mo bsgom pa sngags kyi bdag nyid dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang sems la bskur nas/ yid chos skur ngo shes pas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sgom pa chos kyi bdag nyid gcig dang*/ sgo gsum rlung dang bcas pa la tshig dbang bskur nas rdo rje gsum dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i rlung ngo bo nyid skur ngo shes nas/ rdo rje rba rlabs sgom pa chos kyi bdag nyid de/ dbang bzhi'i lam sku bzhi'i bdag nyid du shes nas nyams su len pa la/

bdag nyid gsum gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshul shin tu zab mo 'di sgrub par 'dod na/ grub chen ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun dang*/ nag po lha la dad pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa la sogs pa (609) grub thob kyi gdams pa'i nying khu mar pa lo ts+tsha nas brgyud pa bzhin du shes par bya'o// yang 'bras bu sku bzhi dang sbyar ba'i gnas bzhi'i sgrub tshul ni/ gong bu chu dang gzugs su bcas// de bzhin gzugs las 'das pa ste// gnas pa rnam pa bzhi ru ni// rgyud rnams nges pa kho na yin// zhes pa'i don ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'gyur ba med pa'i dga' bde la ro gcig par longs spyod pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir gong bu gnas pa'o// chos kyi sku ni dbyings dang ye shes chu la chu 'dres pa ltar dbyer mi phyed pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir chur gnas pa'o// sprul pa'i sku ni mtshan dpes spras pa'i dbyibs dang kha dog gi rnam pa can du snang pa'i phyir gzugs su gnas pa'o// ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni sku gsum po thams cad kyang de'i rang bzhin du (610) 'dres shing thim pa'i phyir gzugs las 'das par gnas pa'o// 'di la ni mngal skyes dang sbyar ba dang*/ dbang dang sbyar ba dang*/ lha bskyed par sbyar ba dang*/ sbas pa'i don dang sbyar ba la sogs ma rgyud pa'i gnad shin tu zab mo rnams yod do// rgyud sde'i dbye don mdor bsdus pa tsam yin te/ gang nyams su len pa'i rgyud de'i nyon mongs pa lam du byed tshul khong du tshud par bya'o// rgyu'i rgyud lam nyams len pa'i snod du rung bar byed pa la/ smin byed dbang dgos shing de yang dkyil 'khor la brten dgos pas/ de la'ang lus dang ngag dang yid dang bha ga dang byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa mang po gsungs kyang*/ ras bris dang rdul tshon gyi de la thig gdab pa'i cho ga shes dgos la/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i lugs su grags pa la/

sdom pa 'byung ba la sogs pa'i rgyud (611) 'ga' zhig tu thig gi gdab tshul zhib mo 'byung yang cung zad go dka' bar snang ngo*// rgyud phal mo cher/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa// rta babs bzhi yis nye bar mdzes// zhes pa tsam dang*/ sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha'o// zhes pa dang*/ ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes// zhes pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa 'dra ba yin// zhes pa lta bur rags pa las ma gsungs shing*/ mkhas grub 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba bod yul du 'gyur nas/ phal cher de'i rjes su 'brang zhing*/ la la dgag sgrub 'dres ma byed do// de'i snga rol du lo ts+tsha ba chen po rin chen bzang pos/ paṇ+ḍita shrar+dha ka ra warma yun ring du bsten nas/ rdo rje 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gtso bor byas pa'i thig gi bstan bcos rtsa 'grel rtsom par (612) zhus pas gnang nas mdzad do// bod kyi gsang sngags la mkhas pa rnams de'i rjes su 'brang ba yin no// deng sang de'i lugs la rdo rje phreng bar cung zad bkag pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas dgag pa byed pa mang na yang*/ a bh+ya ka ra'i lung gis shrad dha'i lugs dgag par mi nus te/ 'jam dpal dbyangs grub pa'i slob dpon nor bu gling pa'i slob ma kha che rin chen rdo rje dang*/ o rgyan slob dpon sangs rgyas zhi ba yang dngos grub brnyes pa yin la/ de dag gis rjes su bzung zhing rgyud sde du ma'i dbang gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par thob cing khong du chud pa yin pas yid ched pa'i gnas su gyur pa yin no// de bas na rang rang gi gzhung lugs tshad mar bya'o// de la shrad dha'i lugs ni/ dang por dkyil 'khor gyis tshad dang mnyam pa'i tshangs thig shar nub drang por btab la (613) de cha mnyam pa bzhir bgos nas shar nub kyi cha re re dor la/ dbus ma'i cha gnyis dang tshad snyam pa'i thig shing sboms su che chung gcig yod pa drang zhing 'jam pa byas nas/

nub nas shar du kha bltas te/ dbus ma'i nub kyi mtha' dang tshangs thig 'dzom pa'i sar thig shing gi rtse gcig lag pa g.yon pas mi 'chug par mnan la/ g.yas pas rtse mo gcig shos bzung nas byang dang lho'i phyogs su drud nas sa ris bya'o// de bzhin du langs nas kha nub tu bltas pas/ dbus ma'i shar gyi mtha' dang tshangs thig 'dzom par lag pa g.yon pas thig shing rtse gcig sngar ltar byas la g.yas pas kyang lho dang byang du drud la sa ris bya'o// de ltar lho byang du bya rog rjes gnyis byung pa'i steng du tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab bo// de'i shi tshad kyis tshangs thig steng nas 'tshams (614) kyi bya rog rjes btsal nas zur thig gdab par bya'o// de nas lo ma bstubs byas te/ cha chen bcu drug tu gdab la/ lte ba nas bzhi dang*/ lhag ma bzhi po re re la sa cha phran bzhi bzhir bsgos te/ nang nas rim pa bzhin tshon rtsi lnga'i sa cha phran gcig dang*/ gnyis 'khyams te stegs bu'i sa dang*/ gcig pha gu dang*/ gnyis drwa ba dang gcig shar bu/ gcig mda' yab/ bzhi rta babs dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i stan cha chung gcig dang*/ gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gcig gdugs kyi sar bya'o// tshangs pa'i g.yas g.yon du cha chung gsum pa/ nang gi ngos cha chen gcig sgo khyud nang gi kyus cha chung gnyis/ sgo 'gram dang nang gi ngos cha chung gnyis/ sgo logs dang nang gi dkyus cha chen bzhi/ ya phub dang thams cad kyang sboms su cha chung re re'o//

(615) rta babs kyi ka ba dkyus cha phran lnga/ rta babs thad kar ka chen bzhi/ 'phangs su cha chen gcig skas kyi rim pa ltar ci mdzes su bya zhing*/ glang po che'i rgyab dang*/ ma ka ra dang*/ ngang pa la sogs pas brgyan pa byas la/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i gdan dkyus cha chung gnyis pa'i pad+ma dang*/ de nas cha chung gcig gis ring bar ri dwags dang*/ de las rgyab tu cha chung gcig dor bar spangs cha chung gcig pa'i rin po che'i dbyug pa la ba dan 'phyang ba dang dril bu khrol ba la sogs pa bya'o// de las lhag pa'i rta babs 'di ltar byed gsal bar ma gsungs pas/ bla ma rnams kyi phyag chen la bang rim bzhi pa'i gong ma gsum ngos gnyis nas cha chung re re phri ba mdzad cing*/ cha phra mo rnams thig shing gis 'byed pa yin no// chu srin gyi kha nas byung (616) ba'i rdo rje'i rwa la sogs pa'i byed tshul mi gsal bas gzhan nas bshad pa ltar kha bkang par bya'o// rdo rje dang sar rta babs rgyal po nyes gsum ma nus la sogs pa'i tshad bkag pa'i phyogs snga ma shrad dha'i bzhed par byed pa ni ma nges pa'o// rta babs kyi ka ba mda' yab kyi thig las 'das par 'dzugs pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang khyi mgo'i ka ba brgyad/ nang gi ka ba la ngos 'dzin par bkag pas/ rta babs kyi ka ba la bzhed pa ni rdo rje phreng ba'i dgongs par mi gsal te/ ka ba'i dag pa 'phags lam yan lag dang sbyar ba'i phyir dang*/ thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud du/ yang dag spong ba bzhi po ni// rta babs rnams dang ka bar byung*// zhes pa dang*/ 'gyur gzhan du/ ka bar bcas pa'i rta babs bzhi// yang dag spong (617) ba bzhi po nyid// ces rta babs kyi khongs su bsdus shing*/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni/ ka ba brgyad ces bya bar bshad// ces spyi 'gro'i ka ba brgyad la dag pa de las tha dad du gsungs shing byung ba'i phyir ro// thig gdab pa'i tshul zhib par bla ma mkhas pa dag gis mang du gsungs pa'i phyir 'dir ma bris so// gzhung dang sbyar ba'i mdor bstan ni/

rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs nas// myur du sangs rgyas thob 'dod na// smin grol gnyis la 'bad par bya// zhes pa/ byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi lam du zhugs nas myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas/ rgyud nyan pa la sogs pa'i snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir thog mar smin byed kyi dbang zhus nas/ grol byed kyi lam nyams su len pa la 'bad par bya'o// (618) gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ smin byed dbang bskur ba'i tshul/ grol byed lam rim pa gnyis kyi nyams len/ lam gyi bogs 'don spyod pa dang 'grel ba'i gnas skabs so// dang po la brgyad las/ dbang bskur byed bla ma'i mtshan nyid/ bskur bya dbang gi gnas lugs/ gnang bkag bsdus te gdams pa/ rang lugs 'thad ldan bgod pa/ rgyud sde 'og ma la dbang bzhi bskur ba dgag pa/ ha cang thal ba'i nor pa sun dbyung ba/ chos sgo'i ming la 'khrul pa dgag pa/ dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur kyang*// bla ma brgyud pa ma nyams shing*// cho ga 'khrugs par ma gyur la// phyi nang rten 'brel bsgrig mkhyen cing*// sku bzhi'i sa bon thob nus pa// sangs rgyas gsung bzhin mdzad pa yi// bla ma (619) tsam la dbang bzhi blang*// de yis sdom pa gsum ldan 'gyur// zhes pas/ rdo rje slob dpon ni bla ma lnga bcu par gsungs pa'i khro ba dang nga rgyal la sogs pa'i skyon dang mi ldan cing*/ snying rje dang de nyid bcu la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa/ rdo rje 'chang nas brgyud pa'i dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin brlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gdam ngag gis sarga ma log pa/ mos gus kyis bsam pa tshim pa ste/ snyan brgyud bzhi dang ldan pa/ gsang sngags lag len gyi mtha' can yin pas bla ma gong ma'i phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa'i bka' srol la phye bsal ma zhugs pa/ dmar 'khrid kyi gsung rgyun khungs nas byung ba rnams tshang ba'i sgo nas cho ga ma 'khrugs par rgyud gzhan dang thun mong ba'i rgyas 'gebs pa dgos pa rnams tshang zhing rang rang gi lugs thun mong

(620) ma yin pa gzhan dang ma 'dres par dgongs pa rnams dmigs phyed pa/ dbang po'i tha dad du slob dpon dang*/ dbang rdzas dang*/ slob ma rnams kyi sbyang gzhi dang sbyang bya dang*/ sbyong byed dang sbyang 'bras rnams thad kar ngo 'phrad pa'i dbang bskur shes pa gcig dgos so// de ltar dbang bskur bas snod du rung ba'i slob ma la 'bras bu sku bzhi'i sa bon thob pa gsang sngags kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs de rgyas 'gyur gyi nus pa mthu can du grub pa yin te/ dbang bskur ba thob pa zhes bya ba'i tha snyad don dang mthun par bya'o// slob ma sngar nas so sor thar pa'i sdom pa gang rung dang byang sems kyi sdom pa dang ldan pa ste/ gsang sngags kyi dbang bkur ba legs par thob pa'i tshe sdom pa gsum ldan gyi rigs pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun du 'gyur ro// 'ga' zhig sbyang gzhi dang sbyang bya'i shan mi phyed (621) cing*/ dbang rdzas kyi mtshon byed tsam yang legs par mi shes pa'i cho ga rgyas shing mdzes pa mang du byed pa snang ste/ slob ma'i rgyud legs par smin na rjes su yid rang ngo*// kha cig dbang bskur gyi sngon du bdag 'jug len pa mi dgos zhes smra na'ang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba sor chud pa la sogs pa'i phan yon chen po dang ldan pa rgyud nyid las gsungs pas/ bla ma'i khyad chos tshang bar byed pa'i lag len dgag par mi rigs so// gnyis pa la brgyad/ phag mo'i byin brlabs chos sgo'i dbang du 'dod pa dgag rang bzo'i cho gas dbang bskur byed pa dgag cho ga nor pa la dngos grub med par bstan/ byin brlabs tsam gyi dbang bskur byung khungs med par bstan/ (622) dbang bskur zhu ba'i slob ma grangs nges yod par bstan/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'khrul pa dgag dbang bskur rang gi yin lugs gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ don dgod pa ni/ deng sang rdo rje phag mo yi// byin brlabs dbang bskur yin zhes zer// de yi chos kyi sgo phye nas// gtum mo la sogs bsgom pa mthong*// zhes pa/

da lta gangs ri'i khrod na rdo rje phag mo'i byin brlabs kyi cho ga la phag mo brda bzhi'i dbang bskur zhes ming btags nas gri gug dang*/ thod pa dang*/ long pa dang*/ phag mgo rnams slob ma la ston cing*/ nges pa'i don 'di dang 'di lta bu yod pa dpe 'dis tshon no zhes zer nas/ gsang sngags kyi lam sgom pa'i snod du rung bar byed pa'i dbang bskur chos kyi sgo 'byed kyi go chod par byas nas (623) dbang gnyis pa'i lam rlung dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor sgom pa dang*/ de bzhin du dbang gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa'i lam zab mo 'bogs shing sgom pa mthong ngo*// 'di 'dra rgyud sde las ma gsungs/ bstan bcos nyid las bshad pa med// rdo rje phag mo nyid las kyang*// dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig ldan// de la byin brlabs bya zhes gsungs// dbang bskur med la byin brlabs bkag /ces pa/ phag mgo'i byin brlabs kyis gsang sngags bla med kyi lam sgom pa'i dbang gi go chod par rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud rnam dag rnams dang*/ rgyud 'grel dang*/ sgrub thabs dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yid gtad du rung ba gang nas kyang ma bshad cing*/ rje btsun ma rin chen rgyan gyi sgrub thabs las kyang*/ 'di ltar rnal 'byor pa dbang bskur ba (624) thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ zhes pa dang*/ sngon gyis bla ma'i man ngag gi dbang bskur ba'i rim pas de'i don la dmigs nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsam par bya'o// zhes gsungs shing de bzhin du rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs gzhan du yang*/ byang chub kyi sems brtan por bzung ste/ dbang bskur ba legs par thob nas/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin yin kyang*/ rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa la mngon du phyogs par byas te/ zhes gsungs so// des na rdo rje phag mo ni/ 'khor lo bsdom pa'i rgyud kyi lha yin pas/

thog mar bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang yongs su rdzogs pa ma bskur bar rdo rje phag mo'i byin brlabs kyi cho ga byas na gsang ba bsgrags pa'i nyes pa 'byung zhing*/ (625) lam snga phyi log par yang 'gyur bas bkag go /gnyis pa dpes bstan pa ni/ dper na mu zi'i bcud len 'ju// de nas dngul chu bza' bar gsungs// mu zi thog mar ma bsten par// dngul chu zos nas 'chi ba bzhin// zhes pa/ thog mar lus kyi phyi nas chang gis 'khrud pa dang*/ til mar gyis byugs shing nyed pa la sogs pa dang*/ nang nas skyu ru ra dang tar bu'i chu 'thungs pas lus sbyang zhing*/ gser mu zi 'dul ba'i rdzas dri chu dang ga gon gyi chu la sogs pas dri ma dang bral bar byas te/ man ngag las gsungs pa'i ril bu byas nas yun ring du bsten pas lus yang zhing zo mdog bde ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// de nas dngul chu'i bcud len byas pas nad dang rgas pa 'joms shing stobs rgyas par 'gyur la/ thog ma nas (626) dngul chu zos na nad 'chi ba la sogs pa nyes pa 'byung ba yin no// de bzhin thog mar dbang bskur blang*// de nas rdo rje phag mo sbyin// dbang bskur med par byin brlabs na// dam tshig nyams par thub pas gsungs// zhes pa/ thog mar 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par blangs nas bye brag tu rdo rje phag mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas grub thob brgyud pa'i byin brlabs kyi rim pa zhus nas sgrub par bya'o// dbang bskur dang byin brlabs snga rting go log na sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang 'gal cing*/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur te/ dbang med pa la dngos grub med// ces sogs bkag pa la spyad par gyur pa'i phyir/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' la 'goms pa yin no// mdor na rnal 'byor bla med kyi lha bsgoms nas de'i lam rim pa (627) gnyis nyams su len na/ thog mar dbang go chod pa thob pas/

lha de'i rjes gnang yang bshad tshod bzhin zhus nas sgrub pa yin no// gsum pa rgyu mtshan bshad pa la gnyis las/ dang po dngos kyi don ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin brlabs la// sdom pa gsum ldan byar mi rung*// phyi nang rten 'brel 'grig mi 'gyur// sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs mi nus// des na 'di ni byin brlabs tsam// yin gyi smin par byed pa min// zhes pa/ byin brlabs tsam gyis sdom pa gsum ldan byar mi rung ste/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa ni dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ma nor cing ma 'khrugs pa la skye ba'i phyir ro// phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang sems can dang*/ phyi gzhal yas khang dang nang lha dang*/ de bzhin du phyi lus dang nang rtsa khams la sogs pa dang*/ phyi phung (628) po khams skye mched dang nang sbyong byed kyi lam dang 'bras bu la sogs pa'i rten 'brel zab mo ngo shes nas nyams su blangs na/ sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i thabs gzhan la rag ma las par rmongs pa thams cad 'ching ba'i rgyu de/ 'dir rmongs pa'i lam du gyur tshul ni/ byin brlabs tsam la brten nas rten 'brel de dag gang dang yang mi 'grig pa'i phyir ro// slob ma snod ldan la dbang bzhi bskur bas rim pa bzhin sprul sku dang longs sku dang chos sku dang ngo bo nyid kyi sku ring por mi thogs par 'grub nus la sku bzhi'i sa bon byin brlabs tsam gyis bzhag par mi nus so// des na rdo rje phag mo'i byin brlabs kyi cho ga ni mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i rkyen gyi yan lag tu rung gi rgyu'i rang bzhin du mi rung ngo*// dper na zhing la sa bon ma btab pa rlogs pa tsam la lo thog 'byung ba'i nus pa med cing*/ sa bon btab nas so nam byas (629) pas lo thog 'byung ba bzhin no// des na thub pas rgyud sde las/ dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba'i// mdun du 'di ni ma smra zhig /smras na dam tshig nyams zhes gsungs// zhes pa rgyud sde rnams las/

dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhes pa dang*/ ma mthong ba'i mdun du ma smra shig smras na dam tshig nyams so// zhes gsungs pas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa dang*/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba la smras na rtsa ba'i ltung bar 'gyur ba yin no// gnyis pa de la logs pa'i lan dgag pa ni/ 'ga' zhig 'di la phag mgo la// sogs pa'i dbang bskur yod ces zer// 'di 'dra dbang bskur nyid ma yin// rgyud sde kun las 'di ma gsungs// gal te rgyal bas gsungs srid kyang*// rjes gnang yin gyi dbang (630) bskur min// zhes pa/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu dang phan 'dogs byed kyi rkyen tsam gyi bye brag ma phyed cing*/ sku bzhi 'grub pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig tshul gang yang ma go bar rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i nyams len byed par rlom pa 'ga' zhig rdo rje phag mo'i byin brlabs la'ang phag mgo dang mda' gzhu la sogs pa'i dbang bskur yod pas chos sgo 'byed pa'i go chod ces smra na'ang*/ 'di ni dbang bskur gyi ming tsam yin gyi/ don dang mi ldan pa'i phyir rgyud dang grub thob rnams kyis smin byed kyi dbang yin par ma gsungs so// gal te byin brlabs la dbang bskur gyi ming btags nas gsungs pa srid na'ang rjes gnang yin gyis chos sgo 'byed pa'i dbang bskur ma yin no// chag lo'i dri bar/ rgya la phag mgo'i dbang la sogs pa gsungs na/ dbang zhes brjod pa la 'gal ba ci mchis/ zhus pa'i (631) lan du/ de 'dra rgyud sde gang nas kyang gsungs pa mi gda'/ brtag pa mtha' bzung gi gsungs pa srid na dbang brtags pa ba yin te/ dbang bskur la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga mang po yod na'ang*/ dngos gzhi de dbang yin/ gzhan rnams cha lag yin/ dge slong gi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga la mang po yod na'ang*/ gsol bzhi'i las de cho ga dngos yin/ bum dbang bcu gcig zer kyang yan lag la ming btags pa yin/

sam+pu ṭī las kyang*/ dbang dang rjes gnang thob pa yi// zhes tha dad du gsungs la/ dbang gi ming brtags tshad dbang yin na/ 'dul ba sum brgya par/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal snod dbang bskur yin// zhes pa dang*/ mdo las/ dbang thob pa'i byang sems zhes pa dang*/ (632) rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba zhes sogs kyang gsungs/ des na mda' gzhu gtod pa la sogs kyang rjes gnang gi dbang yin/ phag mgo'i dbang bskur yang gsung 'dug na 'di 'drar bsdu dgos te/ brdzun 'ba' zhig yin gyis gsungs pa gcig kyang med do// zhes pa'i lan mdzad do// gnyis pa la gsum las/ de cho ga ma yin par bshad pa ni/ la la rdo rje phag mo la// sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga dang*// dkyil 'khor dang ni dbang skur sogs// rang bzo'i cho ga byed pa thos// rang bzo cho gar 'gyur mi srid// cho ga sangs rgyas spyod yul yin// zhes pa/ rdo rje phag mo'i cho ga byed pa la la/ ma brgyud kyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bsres nas dbang bskur ba la sogs rang bzor sbyar ba'i

(633) cho ga byed pa ni/ chos sgo 'byed pa'i go mi chod de/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga kun mkhyen gyi spyod yul yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis 'dra ba'i dpe dgod pa ni/ khyim pas gsol bzhi'i las byas kyang*// dge slong sdom pa mi chags ltar// rdo rje phag mo'i byin brlabs la// sdom pa phog kyang chags mi 'gyur// zhes pa/ dper na dge slong gi sdom pa dang*/ mi ldan pa'i khyim pas gsol bzhi'i las kyi cho ga byas kyang*/ sdom pa len pa po la dge slong gi sdom pa mi skye ba ltar/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin brlabs la rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa'i cho ga phog kyang mi skye'o// gsum pa 'gag bsdus te gdams pa ni/ cho ga cung zad nyams pa la// cho ga chags par ma gsungs na// cho ga phal cher nyams pa la// cho ga (634) 'chags par 'gyur re rkan// zhes pa 'dul bar bdag gi ming ma brjod pa dang*/ mkhan po dang dge 'dun gyi ming brjod na'ang*/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi cho ga zur nyams pas mi 'chags par gsungs na/ 'dir cho ga'i yan lag phal che ba 'khrugs shing sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs pa'i dbang bskur dngos gzhi lag len nyams pa la gsang sngags kyi sdom pa 'chags par ga la 'gyur/ gsum pa ni/ des na 'chad pa'i gnas skabs su/ cung zad nor par gyur kyang bla// cho ga nor par gyur pa la// grub pa nam yang med par gsungs// zhes pa gsang sngags kyi rgyud dang bstan bcos 'chad nyan byed pa'i tshig 'chad tshul cung zad nor kyang nyes pa chung la dbang dang bsnyen sgrub la 'jug pa'i tshe lag len gyi cho ga dang dmigs pa la gnad ma shes pa'i nor pa la yun ring du bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub cing nyes dmigs (635) dang bcas par 'gyur la/ slob ma la bstan na'ang bslus par 'gyur te/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud du/ de kho na nyid kyi dngos po mtha' dag yongs su mi shes par/ gsang sngags smra ba nga yin no zhes mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis gsang sngags kyi cho ga 'chad par byed na dam tshig thams cad nyams par 'gyur ro// dam tshig las nyams na bdud kyis bzung bar 'gyur ro// skyes bu de shi 'phos nas dmyal ba'i gnas mi zad pa chen por 'gro bar 'gyur ro// sems can rnams la brten te byang chub thob par 'gyur bas/

sems can bslu ba de lta bu mi bya'o// zhes pa la sogs pa mang du gsungs so// gzhan yang phag mo'i byin brlabs la// gsang sngags chos sgo 'byed pa na// rgyud sde gang na'ang bshad pa med// ces pa/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin brlabs (636) kyi cho ga tsam gsang sngags bla med kyi rim gnyis zab mo sgom pa'i chos sgo 'byed par rgyud sde gang nas kyang zin pa med la/ de bas dge slong byed pa la// rang byung gi ni bsnyen rdzogs dang*// ye shes khong du chud pa dang*// 'phrin gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang*// de bzhin ston par khas blangs dang*// tshur shog la sogs bsnyen rdzogs sla// 'khrul pa yin par mnyam pa la// 'di rnams sngon gyi cho gar gsungs// zhes pa/ lung gzhi las/ sangs rgyas rang byung gi bsnyen rdzogs dang*/ 'khor lnga sde ye shes khong du chud pa dang*/ mchod ma 'phrin dang*/ 'od srung chen po ston par khas blangs pa dang*/ mchog zung gcig la sogs tshur shog gi dang*/ shākya'i bu mo mang po lci chos khas blangs dang*/ bzang sde'i tshogs skyabs su song ba dang*/ po ta ya na'i bu dris (637) pa'i lan thebs pa dang*/ gsol bzhi'i las kyis gcig car rab byung bsnyen rdzogs 'di la dbus dang mtha' 'khob phye nas bcur byed pa dang*/ dang po la sangs rgyas dang rang sangs rgyas phye nas bcur byed pa'i lugs gnyis yod do// sngon gyis bsnyen rdzogs de 'dras da lta byas na'ang blangs te/ lung las gsungs la/ byin brlabs la dbang bskur du gtan ma gsungs pas/ cho ga 'khrul pa yin par mtshungs pa la snga ma lung las gsungs pa'i phyir ro// lnga pa la gnyis las/ dang po dngos don theg pa gzhan dang sbyar nas ston pa ni/ des na nyan thos theg pa ni// nub kyang gzugs brnyan tsam zhig snang*// rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la// gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi snang ngo*// zhes pa/ nyan thos kyi (638) theg pa la sangs rgyas kyis rung mi rung*/

cho ga 'chags mi 'chags phyed nas gsungs pa'i tshul la brten pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam zhig snang ste/ da lta sngon cho ga mi rung zhes mi brjod do// gsang sngags kyi bstan pa la gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi snang ste/ rdo rje 'chang gis ma gsungs pa'i rang bzo du ma byed pa'i phyir ro// blun po snying phod can gyis kyang*/ 'dul ba'i cho ga brgal ma nus// gsang sngags cho ga thams cad la// blun po rnams kyis rang bzor spyod// ces pa/ gsang sngags kyi tshig don phyogs gcig tsam la'ang blo kha ma phyogs pa'i blun po/ rdo rje 'chang khyad du gsod pa'i snying phod can gyis 'dul ba'i cho ga khyad du gsod par ma nus kyang*/ gsang sngags kyi cho ga dang*/ nyams len la rang rang gi blo la gang dran rang dgar spyod do// gnyis (639) pa de nyid go sla'i dpe dang sbyar nas bshad pa ni/ dper na rab byung gang zhig ni// gsum las mang pa 'jug mi nus// sngags kyi dbang bskur byed pa ni// grangs med par yang dbang skur byed// de ni rdo rje 'chang gis bkag /'dul bar/ tshogs kyis tshogs kyi las mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa sgrub bya gsum las mang ba la lhan cig tu rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mi byed la/ gsang sngags dbang bskur slob ma'i grangs la nges pa med par ji tsam tshogs pa la byed do// 'di ni rdo rje 'chang gis bkag kyang ma khegs par byas so// drug pa la gsum las/ dang po spyi rgyud kyi lung drangs pa ni/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang skur la/ slob ma grangs nges med par gsungs// lhag ma dmigs bsal mdzad pa yi// slob (640) ma la ni grangs nges yod// ces pa rnam snang mngon byang las/ slob ma dad cing rigs btsun pa// de bzhin dkon mchog gsum la dad// zab mo yi ni snod dang ldan// spro ba che zhing tshul khrims ldan// dpa' la yi dam brtan pa ni// bcu 'am brgyad dam bdun nam lnga// gcig gnyis bzhi las lhag kyang rung*// dpyad mi dgos par bzung bar bya// zhes yon tan de dag dang ldan na zung du gyur pa yang dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gsungs shing*/

yang rdo rje slob dpon chen po dang ldan pas sems can gyi khams ma lus par bsgral bar yi dam bcas pa kho nar byas te/ des byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyur 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir sems can tshad med pa yongs su bzung bar bya'o// de nas de dag bos la gsum la skyabs su btang bar bya'o// sdig to (641) mi bya ba rnams kyang bgo bar bya'o// de nas de dag la spos dang me tog la sogs pa sbyin no// de dag dus gsum du sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes kyi sdom pa yang 'dzin du gzhug go /'dzin du bcug nas sngags pa yis// de nas so shing dag kyang sbyin// zhes gsungs pas/ yon tan tshang ba'i slob ma grangs ma nges pa la'ang dbang bskur du rung bar gsungs shing*/ spyi rgyud du/ mdor na slob ma phan tshun du// nang mi gshin pa mi bzung ngo*// gcig la gcig ni sems bzang zhing*// zhi thul bla ma la phan pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i slob ma'i khyad chos ni shin tu gal che'o// phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba dang*/ dam tshig gsum bkod du'ang*/ grangs kha 'cham gsungs so// rdo rje phreng bar/ slob ma gcig gam gnyis (642) sam mang po zhes 'byung bas grangs nges med pa yin zer ba ni brtag dgos so// spyod rgyud kyi dbang zer yang bas nub gcig la yang mang po la bskur zin pa'i dbang du byas so// rgyud sde gong ma gnyis kyi dbang bskur ba'i slob ma la grangs nges yod do// 'di ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum// lnga'am yang na bdun dag gam// nyi shu rtsa ni lnga yi bar// zung du ma gyur yongs su bzung*// de las lhag pa'i slob ma ni// yongs su bzung bar mi shis so// zhes gsungs 'di ni kun la 'jug /ces pa/ spyi rgyud du/ rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la mkhas pas slob ma gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa la sta gon bya bar shis shing*/

de bas mang ba zung du gyur pa bkra mi shis par gsungs so// zung dang (643) ya gyal bzang ngan gyi tha snyad rgyud gzhan nas kyang gsungs shing*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ rten 'brel 'khor lo rtsis dang*/ rgya gar gyi mo'i bstan bcos dag las kyang byung ngo*// 'o na dpal mchog tu/ de la 'dir ni snod dang snod ma yin pa brtag par mi bya ste/ sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams bde ba chen po'i rdo rje'i dam tshig 'di dang*/ 'dod pa'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i rdo rje'i sbyor bas rdo rje chos kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes snod brtag pa dang grangs nges mi dgos par gsungs so zhe na/ dkyil 'khor du gzhug par rung ba'i gsung yin te/ sems can thams cad dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rjer dbyer med pa'i phyir ro// dus kyi 'khor lor/ rigs (644) ldan gyi rgyal po 'jam dpal grags pas/ phyi rol pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag du ma dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur bar gsungs pa ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mdzad spyod la 'gran par nus pa'i rdo rje slob dpon yin na ji ltar dgyes par mdzod cig deng sang chang la bag med du spyod pa grub thob bir+wa pas chang gsol ba'i rnam 'khrul khungs su 'dren par byed do// gnyis pa grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ de bas lhag pa'i slob ma la// cho ga yongs su rdzogs par ni// mtshan mo gcig la tshar mi nus// de yi mtshan mo ma tshar na// cho ga nyams par 'gyur bar gsungs// zhes pa/ nyi shu rtsa lnga las lhag pa'i slob ma la dbang bskur dngos gzhi'i cho ga mtshan mo gcig la bskur bar mi nus shing*/ cho ga ma tshar na nyams pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ tshor du (645) mi rung ba'i skye bo mang pos rig par 'gyur ba dang*/ bum pa dang rdo rje dril bu dang thod pa dang cang te'u la sogs gzhan gyis mthong du mi rung ba'i yo byad rnams nam langs pa'i tshe skye bo mang pos mthong bar 'gyur ba la sogs dgag bya dang dgos pa du ma yod pa'i phyir ro// deng sang bla ma 'ga' zhig gi

rang gis ma lcogs par dbang rdzas rnams lag brgyud byed pa dang*/ g.yog po la bskur nas sla chos byed pa dang*/ slob ma spyi la dbang rdzas lan cig reg pa la sogs lag len ma dag pa rnams kyang dbang zhu mang pa las byung ba'i skyon yin no// de yang gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ lha yang nyi ma nub pa na// nges par byin gyis brlabs kyis 'du// nyi ma shar bar ma gyur bar// mchod nas gshegs su gsol ba shis// zhes pa/ (646) spyi rgyud chen po bzhi'i nang nas dkyil 'khor dang dbang bskur ba la sogs cho ga gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud du/ gsang sngags nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa la/ srung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ sbed pa dang*/ rgyud byin gyis rlob par byed pa'i phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro la sogs lha rnams kyang nyi ma nub nas rang bzhin gyis 'du zhing dngos grub ster bas mtshan mo'i dus su dbang bskur ba dang gtor ma sbyin pa la sogs pa gsungs shing*/ nam langs pa'i tshe dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gtang rag gi mchod bstod dang*/ bzod par gsol ba dang*/ dge ba bsngo ba dang*/ gshegs su gsol ba sogs bya zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa de la the tshom spang pa ni/ 'di ni bya ba'i rgyud yin pas// gzhan gyi cho ga min snyam na// (647) gzhan rnams kun la'ang de 'jug par// spyi rgyud nyid las 'di skad gsungs// zhes pa/ slob ma'i grangs nges dang*/ mtshan mo gcig la dbang rdzogs par zin dgos pa la sogs ni/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi lugs yin gyi gzhan la mi dgos snyam na/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi thun mong du spyi rgyud nyid las gsungs so// ji ltar gsungs zhe na/ gang du las ni yod gyur pa// las kyi cho ga rnams med pas// der ni spyi rgyud dag las kyang*// gsungs pa'i cho ga mkhas pas bsten// de skad gsungs phyir cho ga 'di// rgyud rnams kun la 'jug pa yin// zhes pa/

rgyud sde gang du dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ sbyin bsreg la sogs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi las rnams bya bar (648) gsungs la/ las kyi cho ga gsal por ma gsungs pa rnams su spyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i cho ga ji ltar 'os pas kha bskang nas lhag chad dang nor 'khrul med par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// bdun pa la bzhi las/ dang po rang bzo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas sdom pa mi thob par bstan pa ni/ deng sang byin brlabs mi byed cing*// dbang bskur byed pa kha cig kyang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa yis// dkyil 'khor cho ga mi byed par// g.yung drung ris kyi dkyil 'khor dang*// nas 'dra la sogs byed pa thos// 'di 'dra gang du dbang bskur yang*// sdom pa thob par mi 'gyur ro// zhes pa/ sngags kyi slob dpon dbang bskur byed pa kha cig rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga'i lugs mi byed par/ bon (649) po'i dkyil 'khor la dpe blangs nas g.yung drung ris dang nas 'dra ris dang 'ja' tshon phub kyi sba ltar bskor ba dang*/ gru gsum dang zla gam mang po bsgrigs pa'i dkyil 'khor byed de de 'drar dbang bskur yang rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa thob par mi 'gyur ro// gnyis pa de'i rgyu mtshan rten 'brel mi 'grig pa'i tshul ni/ de yi rgyu mtshan bshad kyis nyon// phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel gyi// stobs kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba yin// 'di la rten 'brel bsgrig min nus// des na sangs rgyas rnams kyis bkag /ces pa/ rang bzo'i dkyil 'khor du gsang sngags kyi sdom pa mi skye ba'i rgyu mtshan/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi dngos po'i gshis la gnas pa'i stobs kyis rgyud sde rnams su dkyil 'khor gyi dbyibs dang tshad kha (650) dog gi bye brag mi 'dra bar 'byung ba yin cing*/ de dag mthun par bla ma mkhas pas dbang bskur bas rten 'brel 'grig nas sdom pa skye zhing*/

rdo rje'i lus la nus pa 'jog cing sems la rtog pa bzang po skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin no// g.yung drung ris la sogs pa blun bzo yin pas cir yang mi rung ngo*// rgyud las/ mi mnyam med pas gru bzhi ste// zhes pa gang yang ma tshang ba'i/ ṭal de 'dra sangs rgyas kyis bkag go /dbang bskur byed pa phal cher yang*// slob ma brgya stong grangs med la// sbyor dngos rjes kyi cho ga rnams// sangs rgyas gsung bzhin mi shes par// zhes pa/ deng sang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga byed pa phal cher/ slob ma mang po la rgyud nas gsungs pa'i sbyor ba sta gon gyi chos dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang gi cha lag mtha' rten dang bcas pa dang*/ (651) rjes gsang bar gdams shing dkyil 'khor mchod pa la sogs pa byed mi shes par/ ma 'grel 'gal zhing nyams pa yi// cho ga'i gzugs brnyan byed pa la// dbang bskur yin zhes blun po smra// de yi lus ngag yid gsum gyi// rnam pa gdon gyis bsgyur ba la// byin brlabs yin par 'khrul pa mang*// zhes pa/ snga phyi 'khrugs shing lhag chad du gyur pas ma 'brel pa dang*/ rgyud sde gong 'og gi khyad par ma phyed pas bya rgyud la rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba dang*/ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa dang*/ ming gi dbang bskur la rdor dril rnam snang du bskyed pa la sogs cho ga 'gal ba dang*/ ye shes dbab pa'i dmigs pa nor ba dang*/ gal che ba chad nas nyams pa la sogs ltar snang tsam la dbang bskur yin no zhes ming btags nas

(652) blun pos blun po slu ba'i chos lugs la gdon gyis snang ba bsgyur ba'i nus pa phra mo byung ba la byin brlabs che'o zhes 'khrul pa shin tu mang ngo*// gsum pa de las byung ba'i yon tan bgegs kyi bar chad yin par bstan pa ni/ dpal ldan dam pa dang po las// cho ga nyams pa'i byin brlabs kun// bgegs kyi yin par rgyal bas gsungs// zhes pa/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga nyams pa dang*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi dmigs pa nor ba la phan yon chen po 'byung bar snang ba nad gdon zhi ba dang*/ lha'i zhal mthong ba dang*/ 'das ma 'ongs lung ston pa la sogs pa ni/ dur khrod kyi sha za la sogs pa las kyi rdzu 'phrul yod pa'i bgegs kyi bar chad yin par mdo rgyud mang po nas gsungs te/ bdud sdig can sangs rgyas dang mkhan slob kyi cha byad bzung nas yul phyogs dang pha mes lung ston pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa la nus pa dang mngon shes bskyed nas gzhan khyad du gsod pa'i (653) rlom sems 'byung ba la sogs bar chad la yon tan du 'khrul par ngo shes nas spang dgos so// bzhi pa cho ga dag pa la sangs rgyas kyi byin brlabs 'jug par bstan pa ni/ cho ga dag par gyur pa las// byung ba sangs rgyas byin brlabs yin// zhes pa/ cho ga rnam par dag pas dbang bskur ba dang*/ rjes su gnang ba thob na yi dam lha'i byin brlabs ngang gis 'byung ba yin te/ rgyud las/ dbang dang rjes gnang thob nas ni// ma bsnyen par yang de la ni// lha ni 'go zhing nye bar gnas// zhes so// brgyad pa la gsum las/ dang po dbang ma thob par sngags kyi sgor 'jug pa dgag pa ni/ dbang bskur med kyang lam zab mo// bsgoms na sangs rgyas 'grub snyam na// dbang bskur med par lam zab mo// bsgom pa ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs// zhes pa/ sngon du dbang ma bskur yang rim (654) gnyis kyi lam zab mo bsgoms pa 'grub ste/ lam ma nor bar nyams su blangs pa'i phyir snyam na/

dam pa dang por/ dbang bskur med par sngags 'chad dang*// zab mo'i de nyid sgom byed pa// de don legs par shes na yang*// dmyal bar 'gyur zhing grol ba med// zhes pa dang*/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar/ dbang nas med par rgyud 'chad pa// sgrub bo sngags kyi don shes kyang*// slob dpon slob ma mtshungs pa ni// shi nas ngu 'bod chen por lhung*// zhes gsungs pas/ rdo ba mkhregs pa'i ngos la sran ma'i 'bru bzhag pa bzhin no// phyag rgya chen po thig le las// dbang med na ni dngos grub med// bye ma brtsir la mar med ltar// gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis// dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa// slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang (655) dmyal bar skye// zhes pa/ dbang ma thob par rgyud zab mo 'chad pa dang*/ las tshogs sgrub pa la sogs byed na/ 'char 'bebs pa dang*/ 'byung po 'dul ba sogs thun mong gi dngos grub cung zad thob kyang*/ mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i skal ba med cing dmyal ba chen por skye'o zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa 'bad pas dbang bskur zhu dgos par bstan pa ni/ de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// bla ma la ni dbang don zhu// zhes gsungs rgyud sde gzhan las kyang*// de ltar gsung phyir 'bad par bya// dbang ma thob par sngags kyi sgor 'jug pa la/ nyes dmigs chen po gsungs pa des na/ gsang sngags kyi lam du 'jug pas dka' dpyad bla ma'i zhabs tog sgrub pa'i rtsol ba chen pos thog mar dbang zhus nas gsang sngags la (656) 'jug par bya'o// sangs rgyas thod par/ bu tsha med pa'i khyim bdag po shi ma thag khang pa nor gyis stongs par 'gyur ba bzhin du/ dbang ma thob par sngags la 'jug pa yang shi ma thag nyams par 'gyur ro// zhes sogs gsungs so// gsum pa rang bzo'i ngan rtog sna tshogs dgag pa la bdun/ dbang po'i khyad par 'dod pa dgag sems bskyed tsam gyis chog par 'dod pa dgag

gtor dbang smin byed du 'dod pa dgag dbang bskur lam gyi rting du 'jog pa dgag chos min thams cad dor bya yin par bstan/ dbang bskur byas pa dgos med yin pa dgag cho ga med par dbang bzhi len pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ kha cig gang zag dbang po rab// smin byed phag mo'i byin brlabs yin// 'bring dang tha ma dag la ni// dbang bskur cho ga dgos zhes zer// gang zag (657) rab 'bring gsum ka las// phag mo'i byin brlabs smin byed du// rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa med// ces pa/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin brlabs dbang po rab kyi chos su 'dod pa kha cig gsang sngags nyams su len pa'i gang zag la rigs gsum yod pa'i dbang po rno zhing skal ba rab la phag mo'i byin brlabs tsam gyis smin byed dbang gi go chod do// 'bring dang tha ma la rgyud nas bshad pa'i cho ga bya dgos pa yin zhes zer te/ de 'dra'i rnam bzhag rgyu dang grub thob rnams kyis gsungs pa med do// 'o na phyag na rdo rjes u rgyan gyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs su bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po zla ba bzang po la dbang bskur ba dang*/ 'jam pa'i rdo rjes/ sangs rgyas (658) ye shes zhabs la dbang bskur ba la sogs yod do snyam na/ 'phags pa rnams kyis gang zag rab// sprul pa yi ni dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur mdzad ces gsungs pa ni// sngon gyi cho ga'i 'phags pa'i yin// deng sang gang zag rab 'bring kun// rdul tshon gyi ni dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur bya ba gsungs mod kyi// gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag /ces pa/ rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi la sogs kyang sprul pa yin par gsungs shing*/ ye shes kyi snang ba tsam gyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang bskur bar mdzad pa ni sngon byung gi cho ga rigs gsum mgon po la sogs pa'i rnam 'phrul yin no// de yang thog mar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i phyir/

sa gzhi brtag pa dang*/ sbyang ba dang*/ yongs su bzung ba dang*/ sta gon du gnas pa dang*/ de bzhin du slob (659) ma'i snod brtag pa dang*/ blo bcos pa dang*/ sdom pa sbyin pa dang*/ srung ba la sogs pa rgyud dang dbang chog rnams las rgyas par 'byung ba ltar/ thog mar rdul tshon dang ras bris la sogs pa'i phyi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas dbang po rab la lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar gsungs kyi/ de las gzhan pa'i dbang de 'dra rgyud sde las bkag go /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po 'dod tshul bstan pa ni/ la la sems bskyed byas pa la// gsang sngags sgom du 'dod ces zer// 'di ni sngags kyi 'khrul yin lo// zhes pa/ rgyud sde'i don ma go bar blo khog che bar rlom pa la/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed ni sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam thams cad kyi brten yin la/ des gsang sngags kyi lam sgoms pas skyon du mi (660) 'gyur te/ sngags kyi theg pa'i nang gi blo yangs pa'i 'khrul mig chen po yin lo// gnyis pa phye ste 'khrul pa dgag pa la gnyis las/ dang po bya ba'i rgyud kyi rnam gzhag ni/ 'di yang phye ste bshad kyis nyon// bya ba'i rgyud la rnam gsum yod// don yod zhags sogs 'ga' zhig la// dbang bskur sems bskyed ma thob kyang*// bsnyung gnas la sogs byed nus na// gang zag kun gyis sgrub par gsungs// zhes pa/ theg chen sems bskyed gsang sngags kyi brten du 'dod pa/ rgyud sde so sor phye nas byed tshul shes dgos te/ bya rgyud la yang nyams su len tshul gsum yod de/ spyan ras gzigs kyi cho ga la sogs nas gsungs pa 'ga' zhig la dbang bskur dang sems bskyed sngon du ma song yang gso sbyong dang bsnyung gnas tsam la brten nas kyang sgrub tu rung bar gsungs te/ sems (661) can rnams la nus sam mi nus dris te sbyin par bya'o// zhes pa dang*/ gzhan dang 'gran pa dang*/

gzhan khyad du bsad pa'i phyir 'jug na'ang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi byin brlabs su mkhas pas shes par bya'o// ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag gi rna lam du grags par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// zhes pa dang*/ dud 'gro'i rna lam du'ang sgrogs shig ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// oṃ ma ni pad+me hūm̐ zhes pa/ brgya lam du bris pa dang*/ mang po 'dus par bsgrags na gsang sgrog gi nyes pa 'byung zhes zer ba'ang grags te/ gzhung lugs 'di lta bu ma mthong ba'i khyad gsod yin no// dam tshig gsum bkod la sogs pa// 'jug pa sems bskyed thob na ni// phrin las 'ga' zhig sgrub pa'i phyir// cho ga shes nas sgrub par gnang*// zhes (662) pa/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed dang sdom pa rgyud la ldan pas sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ zhi rgyas kyi phrin las sgrub pa la sogs pa'i phyir du dpal rdo rje gtso 'khor gsum sgrub pa dang*/ thub pa'i dbang po mdun du bsams nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa stong rtsa brgyad bzlas na mngon sum du zhal mthong bar 'gyur ba la sogs mang du gsungs so// khrus dang gtsang sbra sogs med par spyod lam ci bde bas 'grub par gsung pa'i phyir spyod pa'i rgyud yin par yang mi 'gal lo// legs par 'grub pa yan chad du// rang gi dbang bskur ma thob na// sems bskyed thob kyang gsang sngags bkag /de yang legs par grub pa las// dbang bskur ma byas pa dag la// cho ga shes pas sngags mi sbyin// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs la ltos// zhes pa/ dbang bskur ma thob na cho ga shes pa tsam (663) gyis gsang sngags rang gis sgrub pa dang*/ gzhan la sbyin pa bkag cing*/ dpung bzangs las kyang*/ gang dag rigs dang dbang bskur cho ga med// gang dag dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang*// gang dag byang chub sems ni ma bskyed pa// nga yi gsang sngags bzlas na phung bar 'gyur// zhes so// sku gsung thugs kyi rigs gsum phyi'i rigs pa gtad pa'i cho ga thob pas/

rang gi lha rigs gang yin gyi rjes gnang zhus nas bsnyen sgrub byed par rung zhing*/ rat+na kirtis gzungs thams cad kyi cho ga kun snang gsal bar lha du ma'i rigs gtad phyogs gcig tu bkod pa ltar lag tu blang bar bya'o// dkyil 'khor gang yang rung bar bum pa'i dbang dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang legs par thob cing ma nyams na/ bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud (664) nyan pa dang*/ rjes gnang zhus nas sgrub pa la nyes pa med do// de las gzhan du rgyud nyan pa dang*/ lha sgrub pa bkag pa yin no// gnyis pa rgyud sde gong ma'i dmigs gsal ni/ lhag ma rgyud sde gsum po las// dbang bskur thob pa ma gtogs pa// sems bskyed tsam la brten pa dmigs// yi dam sgom par gsungs pa med// dbang bskur nang gi rten 'brel yin// zhes pa/ rgyud sde gong ma gsum la rang lugs kyi dbang ma thob par theg chen sems bskyed tsam la brten nas rgyud 'chad nyan byed pa dang*/ yi dam lha yi sgom bzlas byed par ma gsungs te/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga slob ma'i lus sems la dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i rten 'brel gyi nus pa rgyas par byed pa yin la/ sems bskyed la ni rten 'brel med// des ni sems bskyed byas na yang*/ (665) /gsang sngags zab mo sgom pa la// ltung ba yod par rgyal bas gsungs// de phyir rnam dbye shes dgos so// zhes pa/ sems bskyed tsam la slob ma'i rgyud la rten 'brel 'grig pa'i cho ga tshang ba med pa'i phyir ro// des na dbang bskur ma thob pa'i gsang sngags zab mo nyams su len pa'i 'khrul rtsis na dmyal bar skye ba la sogs pa'i nyes dmigs yod do// rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir na rgyud sde gong 'og gi rnam dbye shes nas nyams su len dgos so// gsum pa ni/ gtor ma'i dbang bskur zhes bya dang*// ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bskur yang*// slob ma smin byed cho ga ru// rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa med// ces pa/

gtor ma slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag nas yi dam gyi lha yin par bsgoms te thim par bsams (666) pas dbang thob par 'dod pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa tsam phog nas slob ma smin byed kyi dbang thob par 'dod pa dang*/ ā li kā li'i yig 'bru slob ma la thim zhing nang gang bas tsaṇ+ḍa li'i man ngag dbang gnyis pa'i lam sgrub pa'i snod du rung par 'dod pa la sogs mu stegs kyi gdams pa dang*/ rang bzo'i cho ga rgyud las ma gsungs shing*/ bla ma dam pa las ma brgyud pa'i chos lugs rgyang ring du dor bar bya'o// nag po chen po la sogs pa'i bka' srungs slob ma la gtod pa'i tshe/ gtor ma spyi bor 'jog pa'i phyag len yod pas/ l+h+wam dpe zhwa la bkab pa 'dra ste/ chos rgyus chung ba lhan cig 'dus nas 'khrul gzhi cung zad re la brten pa'i rnal 'byor pa mang du 'byung bar snang ngo*// bzhi pa ni/ 'ga' zhig gsang sngags da lta spyod// dbang bskur phyi nas khas len byed// 'di yang sangs (667) rgyas bstan pa min// dbang ma thob la chos bshad la// slob dpon ltung ba can 'gyur cig /slob ma'ang sngon du nyams par 'gyur// nyams par gyur pa dam chos kyi// snod min zhes ni rgyal bas gsungs// zhes pa/ nyes pa can khrims mun du bcug nas rngan pa phyis khas len byed pa ltar/ gsang sngags kyi nyams len da lta byas nas/ sngon du 'gro dgos kyi dbang bskur phyis zhu ba'i khas len byed pa 'di 'dra dpon slob gnyis ka dud 'gro mi'i cha byad can gyi spyod yul yin pas sangs rgyas bstan pa'i khongs su mi gtogs so// dbang ma thob par snod min la zab chos bstan nas gnyis ka ltung bas nyams pa'i rjes su dbang bskur byed par rlom pa 'di/ 'dul bar/ lhag por ma byas par spangs pa la zas sbyin pas ltung ba 'byung ba bzhin no// gzhan yang (668) dge slong gi sdom pa med par 'dul ba'i las rigs brgya rtsa gcig po gang rung gi gral du bsdad na rku thabs su gnas pas phyis dge slong gi sdom pa blangs kyang mi skye ba dang*/

mu stegs kyi lta ba ma spangs par rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs bzung nas chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod nyams su myongs par byas na mu stegs can zhugs pa zhes bya ba phyis sdom pa'i snod du mi rung ba bzhin du 'dir yang shes par bya'o// lnga pa ni/ mdor na chos kyis ci byed soms// sangs rgyas byed na chos bzhin gyis// zhes pa/ dbang bskur dang*/ byin brlabs dang lha bsgom pa dang*/ gsang sngags bzlas pa la sogs pa'i chos des ched du bya ba'i don ci zhig thob par 'dod pa yin/ rang gi sems la brtag par bya zhing rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dod pa yin na/ nyams len kyang sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mthun par bya dgos (669) te/ rdo rje 'chang nas bla ma mkhas par rim par brgyud pa'i gsung bzhin bsgrubs pas sangs rgyas 'grub pa yin gyis/ de las gzhan pas 'bad kyang sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba kho na'o// ye shes thig ler/ gcig nas gcig tu rim par brgyud// bla ma rab kyi zhal nas blangs// gzhan du rtog ge'i tshogs la mkhas// sgra yi bstan bcos rtag mos la// dbang gi mchog ni rnam pa gsum// blang bar mi bya sbyin mi bya// yang dag 'bras bu 'dod pa na// de ni ring du spang bar bya// zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje snying po'i rgyan du/ yang dag de nyid dngos po mi shes par// gsang sngags smra ba po yin zhes brjod pa// de dag mngon pa'i nga rgyal sngags mchog 'chad// de ni dam nyams 'di dang pha rol brlag /bdud kyis bzung nas shi nas dmyal bar 'gro// zhes
