gshegs bstan pa'i ring lugs bla na med// zhu chen bsgyur byed mchan bu'i gnas 'dug pa'i// skad gnyis smra ba blo gros gsal ldan pa// de dag bdag cag rnams kyi mig tu gyur// mi yi dbang po chos bzhin sa skyong pa// rnam dpyod blo can des pas 'gro ba 'dul// dpa' mdzangs blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor nas// skye dgu 'di dag bu bzhin legs par bskyangs// zhes bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i bsngags pa mdzad do// gsum pa chos log gi ro langs tshul ni/ phyis nas rgyal khrims nub pa dang*// rgya nag mkhan po'i gzhung lugs kyi// yi ge tsam la brten nas kyang*// de yi ming 'dogs gsang nas ni// phyag rgya chen por ming bsgyur nas// da lta'i phyag rgya chen po 'di// phal cher rgya nag chos (885) lugs yin// zhes pa/ 'gong po gnam the'u'i bu dum btsan glang dar mas/ blon po ngan pa rgyal to re dang*/ cog ro legs sgra la sogs pa dang gros ngan bshams te/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan ral pa can bskrongs nas/ bod yul gyi chos khrims dang rgyal khrims gnyis ka bshig glang dar ma'ang lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes bsad/ de rjes su yum brtan dang 'od srung 'khrugs nas bod yul phung par gyur pa'i tshe hwa shang gi chos lugs 'ga' zhig yi ge bkod pa 'ga' zhig gter nas thon pa la brten nas blun po chos dad can gdam ngag 'bogs pa la spro bas phyag rgya chen po'i ming btags nas bshad de/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo paṇa mkhas pa rnams kyi chos lugs legs par ma dar ba'i (886) skabs su chos yin ma yin shan 'byed pa mkhas pa ma byung pas/ bsod nams chung ba'i sems can 'ga'// lha skal chad pas 'byung po sgrub// ces pa ltar/ phyag rgya chen po'i gdam ngag gi ming la 'khrul bas dar bar gyur to// 'bum las/ chos thams cad ni nam mkha'i ngang tshul can no zhes bya bar sems can rnams la chos ston to// zhes pa'i 'dres gsungs pa la brten nas/

sems ngo 'phrod nyal bas chog ces pa'i ngo 'phrod la/ chos thams cad sems su ngo sprod/ sems nam mkha' dper blangs nas ngo sprod/ nam mkha' ci yang med pa'i stong nyid du ngo sprod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ngo sprod gsum par grags pa dang*/ sems la sems ma mchis te rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i slad du'o// zhes pa'i lung la brten nas rig pa gsal tsam 'di la (887) bde bar zhen pa dang*/ gsal bar zhen pa dang*/ mi rtog par zhen pa ste gol ba gsum bcad nas gshis la shor ba dang*/ sgom du shor ba dang*/ lam du shor ba dang*/ rgyas 'debs su shor ba ste shor ba bzhi spangs nas so ma de ma bcos pa dang lhug pa dang 'bol le shig ger 'jog lugs bzhi nyams su len pa yin te/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di// slod na grol bar the tshom med// bram ze skud pa 'khal ba ltar// so ma ma bcos lhug par zhog /ces bram ze chen pos gsungs pa'i nyams len yin zhes zer ba de/ chos rje nyid kyis phyogs bcu sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la zhu ba'i 'phrin yig las/ dpe ma grub cing don nor par gsungs te/ 'di don brtags pas (888) 'di ltar mthong*// so mar bzhag na bal nyid yin// skud par byas na bcos par 'gyur// de phyir 'di la dpe skyon yod// don gyi skyon yang 'di ltar mthong*// gol ba gsum po bcad tsam gyis// phyag rgya chen por 'gyur na ni// nyan thos 'gog pa'ang der 'gyur ro// shor pa bzhi po spangs nyams pa'i// rnam rtog phyag rgya chen po min// rtogs pa med na spong mi nus// rtogs pa med kyang spong nus na// sems can kun la 'bad med du// phyag rgya chen po ci mi skye// zhes gsungs so// bram ze chen po'i gsung rkang pa dang po gnyis tshad ma yin la/ phyi ma gnyis brdzun yin no// dgag pa rgyas par sgom rim gsum par gsungs pas shes shing*/ 'di ni hwa shang gi bsam gtan nyal chog gi nyams len yin par the tshom med do// des

(889) na phyag rgya chen po la nyams len mdzad pa rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang grub thob kyi gsungs las legs par thos bsam mdzad nas dgongs pa ma nor bar gtan la phebs pa dang nyams len mdzad pa gal che shing*/ khyi btsal brgyugs su ma song ba byed 'tshal lo// lnga pa ni/ nā ro dang ni mai tri pa'i// phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa// de ni las dang chos dang ni// dam tshig dang ni phyag rgya che// gsang sngags rgyud nas ji skad du// gsungs pa de nyid khong bzhed do// zhes pa/ bla ma nā ro dang mai tri pa'i lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po mar pa lo ts+tsha la gnang ba de nyid las dang chos dang dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang*/ bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po gsang sngags bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma nor ba yin te/ mai tri pa'i de nyid nyi shu las/ las dang dam tshig (890) phyag rgya gnyis// 'khor lo rdzogs par sgom pa nyid// tha ma'i byang chub sgom pa ni// dag pa'i de nyid phyir phyogs pa'i// ye shes phyag rgya mnyam sbyor bas// 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs gtso// bde min brdzun min rnam par ni// bdag nyid sgom pa 'bring po'o// bdag byin brlab pa'i go 'phang gang*// de nyid rtogs par mi nus phyir// de dag la ni rim pa yis// byang chub sgrub pa'i lam bstan to// lha la mngon par zhen na ni// de la bag chags ci ste med// bag chags nyid ni rnam dag na// thams cad du yang de bzhin no// de nyid mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pa// phyag rgya chen po la gzhol ba// thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin gyis// dbang po dam pa gnas par bya// ngo bo nyid bden gang thob pas// rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs// gang

(891) phyir 'gro ba 'di de nyid// de phyir thams cad dri ma med// ces pa la sogs pa dang*/ theg chen nyi shu par/ zung 'jug go 'phang bskyod pa po// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// mtshan nyid med cing 'dus ma byas// gnyug ma'i sku la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor pa dbang po tha ma las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya la brten nas rtsa rlung gi rnal 'byor dang*/ de nas dbang po 'bring po chos dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dbang gsum pa'i lam sgom zhing*/ lha sku sgyu ma lta bu sgyu lus rim pa mngon du gyur nas de la zhen pa'i bag chags sbyang pa'i phyir 'od gsal sgom zhing*/ de las langs te zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po dngos po thams cad la khyab pa'i rang bzhin (892) dbang po rab kyi lam sgom pa yin no// de la lhan skyes pa'i rang bzhin zhes kyang gsungs te don gcig go /nā ro pas kyang*/ dpe'i ye shes lhan cig skyes pa nyams su myong ba ngos bzung nas bsgoms pas don gyi ye shes lhan cig skyes pa mngon du byed par bzhed do// de'i don ni gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud du/ 'dir ni shes rab ye shes gang*// mngon par dbang bskur bzhi pa ru// byis pa'i skye bo smra bar 'gyur// de ni slar yang de bzhin ces// bzhi pa de nyid gsum pa ru// de bzhin byas par mi 'gyur te// dang po'i yan lag las slar yang*// smos pa skyon 'gyur de bzhin du// byis pa rnams kyis rgyu gsum pa// gang yin 'bras bu bzhi pa ste// rgyu 'bras dbye ba med pa'i phyir// bzhi pa'ang gsum par grub bo zhes// sngar brjod don dam bden pa nyid// (893) ces shin tu gsal bar gsungs pas dbang gsum pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba de ni kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin la/ de'i 'bras bur gyur pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba zung 'jug gi ye shes de ni don dam pa'i bden pa yin no zhes brjod do// rgyu 'bras rang bzhin dbyer med pa'i phyir bzhi pa de yang gsum pa de bzhin no zhes gsungs pa yin la/

phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mtshan nyid pa ni dbang gsum pa'i skabs su mi 'byung ste/ gal te 'byung na de nyid dbang bzhi par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// des na i n+d+ra bo dhi'i zhal snga nas/ dbang po gnyis byung ba de ba ni// de nyid yin zhes skye ngan smra// de ni bde chen de nyid du// rgyal ba mchog gis ma gsungs so// zhes log par rtog pa bkag pa yin no// mai tri pa'i lhan (894) skyes grub par yang*// gang phyir lhan cig skyes ma bcos// de phyir 'dogs med lhan cig skyes// zhes dpe'i ye shes dbang po gnyis byung gi bcos ma yin la/ don gyi ye shes ni rang byung gi ye shes ma bcos pa yin no// 'di la'ang deng sang gsang sngags 'chol bar spyod pa mang du yod de/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis rjes su gzung bar bya'o// 'phags pa klu sgrub nyid kyis kyang*// phyag rgya bzhi par 'di skad gsungs// las kyi phyag rgya mi shes pas// chos kyi phyag rgya'ang mi shes na// phyag rgya chen po'i ming tsam yang*// rtogs pa nyid ni mi srid gsungs// zhes pa/ phyag rgya chen po ston pa'i gzhung i n+d+ra bo dhis mdzad pa'i ye shes grub pa dang*/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i thabs shes grub pa/ pad+ma badz+ra'i gsang ba grub (895) pa/ ḍoṃ bi pa'i lhan cig skyes pa grub pa/ dpal chen po'i gnyis med grub pa/ dha ri ka pa'i gsang ba'i de kho na nyid dgu/ rnal 'byor ma tsi tis mdzad pa'i dngos po gsal ba'i de nyid grub pa ste grub pa sde bdun dang bram ze chen po dh+wa ha mdzod kyi glu/ tog tse pa'i bsam mi khyab/ lhan skyes rdo rje'i gnas pa bsdus pa/ ār+ya de ba'i sems kyi sgrib sbyong*/ de ba tsan+d+ra tra'i shes rab ye shes gsal ba/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po bzhi pa ste/ snying po skor drug tu grags pa rnams las phyag rgya chen po sgro skur gyi mtha' chod par zhib tu gtan la phab cing*/

phyag rgya bzhi par/ las kyi phyag rgya'i nyams len mi shes pas/ chos kyi phyag rgya rgyud la bskyed tshul mi shes pas/ de ma shes na dam (896) tshig gi phyag rgya'i don mi go zhing*/ phyag rgya chen po'i sgra don tsam yang legs par mi shes par gsungs te/ de rnams dbang bzhi dang rim pa bzhin sbyor ba dang*/ 'bras bu sku bzhi dang sbyor ba yod na'ang*/ phyi rol gyi bud med rgyud nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las kyi phyag rgyas ni de las byung ba'i ye shes la rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ rdo rje lus kyi rtsa 'khor lo bzhi rten dang bcas pa chos kyi phyag rgyas ni de la brten pa'i ye shes la rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ khams byang chub sems ma nyams pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas de'i ye shes la rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen pos chos thams cad la rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ yang 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi ye shes chos kyi phyag rgya/ chos sku phyag rgya chen po/ gzugs sku gnyis dam (897) tshig phyag rgya/ de dag phan tshun du rgyas gdab dang*/ 'debs byed ro gcig tu rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la skyes pa'i nyams dang*/ dngos po'i gshis la gnas tshod sbyar nas shes par bya'o// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i steng du phyag rgya bzhi gsungs tshul sna tshogs ma nor bar nyams su len 'tshal lo// slob dpon a bh+ya ka ra ni/ phyag rgya bzhi pa klu sgrub kyi gsung ma yin no zhes zer ro// rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan dang ni// bstan bcos chen po gzhan las kyang*// dbang bskur dag dang ma 'brel ba// de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /dbang bskur ba las byung ba yi// ye shes phyag rgya che rtogs na// da gzod mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i// 'bad rtsol kun la mi ltos so// zhes pa/ dus kyi (898) 'khor lo'i rgyud du/ dbang mngon du ma song bar ye shes skye ba med pas/ thog mar kun rdzob bden pa 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub don du gnyer bas byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun zhu ba dang*/

don dam pa'i bden pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phyag rgya chen po sgrub pa'i phyir dbang gong ma bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gsungs shing*/ dang po ni byis pa skyes ma thag khrus byed pa ltar yum lnga'i chu dbang dang*/ gtsug phud 'jog pa ltar sangs rgyas lnga'i cod paṇa gyi dbang dang*/ rna ba 'bigs pa ltar nus pa bcu'i dar dpyangs kyi dbang dang*/ dgod cing smra ba ltar gtso bo yab yum rdo rje dril bu'i dbang dang*/ 'dod yon la longs spyod pa ltar sems dpa' sems ma'i brtul zhugs kyi dbang dang*/ ming 'dogs pa ltar khro bo khro mo'i dbang dang*/ (899) yi ge 'bri klog slob pa ltar rdo rje sems dpa'i rjes gnang dang bdun ni/ rtsa rgyud dang bsdus brgyud dang rdo rje snying po'i 'grel pa la sogs par dag bya dag byed zhib tu gsungs so// gong ma'i dbang la slob ma gzhug pa'i dbang bzhi dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon du byed pa'i dbang bzhi lugs gnyis/ dbang bdun thob pa'i slob ma la ster ba yin te/ dbang bdun po de mngal gyi gnas skabs dang sbyar nas mngal du thog mar lus grub pa bzhin du/ chu dang cod pan gyi dbang rtsa dang rlung grub pa bzhin dar dpyangs dang rdor dril gyi dbang*/ dbang po dang las dbang rnams grub pa bzhin brtul zhugs dang ming gi dbang*/ ye shes kyi rlung rgyu ba bzhin rdo rje sems dpa'i rjes gnang bskur ba yin no// slob ma gzhug (900) pa'i dbang bzhi ni nu ma la reg pa'i bum dbang dang*/ bdud rtsi byin nas bha ga la blta ba'i dbang dang*/ phyag rgya gtad de snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba la rtog pa'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang*/ nor bu nang du tshud pa'i bde ba la rtog pa bzhi pa ste/ rgyud zab mo nyan pa'i snod du rung bar byed pa yin no// slob dpon gyi dbang bzhi ni/ de las khyad zhugs pa'i skur tshul bla ma dam pa'i man ngag bzhin du ngo sprad cing*/

bzhi pa'i don ni mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po yin no// de ltar ngo legs par 'phrod pa'i nus pa bzhag nas nyams su blangs pas don gyi dbang bzhi pa nyid la'ang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ nye ba'i sgrub pa dang*/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa chen po dang*/ bzhi rim gyis (901) mthar phyin nas yongs su rdzogs par 'grub cing*/ dga' ba bzhi po re re la'ang*/ sku gsung thugs ye shes bzhi bzhir phye ba bcu drug tu 'gyur cing*/ de ni kye rdo rjer 'pho ba bcu drug sgrib bral du gyur pa'i tshul dang don gcig go /mtshan brjod du/ de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig /ces gsungs so// 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi mar/ so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang*// srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*// rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin// rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu 'dod// ces gsungs pa'i rim pa ltar nyams su blangs pas dbang bzhi'i don rgyud la skyes pa la/ mtshan brjod du/ 'jig rten gsum na gzhon lus gcig /gnas brtan rgan po skye dgu'i bdag /ces gsungs te/ (902) dbang dang po gsum gyi ye shes ni gzhon nu dang*/ de'i shugs kyi dar la bab pa dang*/ gnas brtan rgan po dang*/ bzhi pa'i ye shes ni skye dgu'i bdag po ste zag pa dang bcas pa'i rlung dang*/ 'pho ba'i sgrib pa thams cad dang bral nas dbu mar brtan pa thob pa'i don yin no// de yang so sor sdud dang bsam gtan gyis gtsug tor dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ srog rtsol dang*/ 'dzin pas snying ga dang*/ rjes dran dang ting nge 'dzin gyis gsang gnas nas nor bu'i rtse mo mthar thug pa 'pho ba med pa'i bde ba yongs su gang zhing*/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa yin la/ yas rim nas 'dzin pa dang*/ mas rim nas brtan pa thob pa yin no// mtshan brjod du/ bzang ngan shes shing dus shes pa// zhes dkar po'i cha 'phel (903) ba chags pa chen po bzang ba dang*/

nag po'i cha 'pho ba'i sgrib pa chags bral gyi bde ba ngan pa'o// dus kyi rtsa la thim pa ni 'du shes so// gsang ba dang*/ lte ba dang*/ snying ga dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ dpral ba'i 'khor lo srog 'pho ba'i bag chags kyi grong 'dzin pa stongs nas/ 'pho med kyis gang zhing brtan par gyur nas sa gnyis gnyis non pa yin no// gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo 'pho ba'i bag chags dang*/ de'i bzhon pa srog gi rlung gzhom du med pa'i ma rig pa zhes bya ba mtha' dag zad cing*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang zung du 'jug pa mthar thug pa bcu gsum pa rdzogs pa la/ chos kyi dung ste sgra chen 'dzin// rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od// chags bral dang po chags (904) pa che// zhes gsungs shing*/ de bzhin du g.yas phyogs kyi nyi ma'i 'gros rim gyis gtsug tor nas nor bu'i mthar son pa ni/ chos kyi gaṇa ḍi sgra bo che// rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che// kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od// bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan// rkang pa ya gcig mthil gyis gnon// sa yi dkyil 'khor gzhi la gnas// zhes gsungs so// zla ba gtsug tor du mnan pas// tshangs pa'i sgong nga rtse nas gnon// rkang thob son mo'i khyon la gnas// zhes gsungs shing*/ 'od gsal ba las zung 'jug tu mtshams sbyor ba'i rjes dran gyi yan lag la stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po bud med kyi rnam par snang dgos zhes 'ga' zhig smra ba ni/ 'dzin pa dang*/ rjes dran dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag la/ rgyud (905) sde zab mo'i don bzhin legs par ma 'dris shing nang gi rnam rtog sngon song gi blos bstan par zad do// dus kyi 'khor lo/ phyag rgya gsum du gsungs pa'i las kyi phyag rgya dbang po brtul ba dang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya dbang po 'bring po srog 'dzin sbyong ba'i skabs tsam dang*/

phyag rgya chen po rjes dran dang ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs su sgom zhing*/ chos dang dam tshig gi phyag rgya srog 'dzin gyi yan lag la phal cher tshang ba yin no zhes bla ma dam pa dag gsungs so// //gser 'gyur sgrub pa'i skabs nas/ dngul chu 'bros pa dang 'phar ba dang 'dar ba dang 'tsheg pa dang*/ g.yo med du bstan pa'i gnas skabs dang sbyar nas 'ching ba'i thabs rgyas par gsungs pa ni/ mchog gi dbang gong ma bzhi nyams su (906) len pa'i tshul shin tu zab pa'i gnad/ rgyud sde gang du'ang ma gsung pa'i gsang chen sbas don mthar thug pa rdo rje 'chang gis dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud du bstan pa'o// 'di la bshad pa dang nyams len mdzad pa rnams kyis legs par dgongs 'tshal lo// 'di rnams zhib par phyag rgya chen po mngon du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug man lung gu ru'i gsung gi rgyun ma bcos pa las khong du chud par bya'o// byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor gsum dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa bha ba bha ṭa'i bde mchog gi bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'grel pa dang*/ rgyud sde mang po'i bshad rgyud sam+pu ṭi'i 'grel pa man ngag gi snye ma dang*/ kyai rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje gur gyi 'grel pa rnams dang*/ gsang ba 'dus (907) pa 'phags lugs dang*/ ye shes zhabs kyi 'grel pa la sogs bstan bcos chen po rnams las kyang*/ dbang bskur ba sngon du song ba dang ma 'brel pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i don sgom pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po rgyud la skye ba bkag pa yin no// dbang bskur phyin ci ma log pa thob nas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa sngon du gyur na/ de yan chad du sgrib pa'i lhag ma spong ba dang*/ lam gyi lhag ma sgom pa dbang 'og ma gsum gyi lam ltar 'bad rtsol mi ltos par ngang gis 'grub pa yin te/ gaṅgā la sogs pa'i chu bo chen po bzhi ngang gis rgya mtshor 'jug pa bzhin no// lam la rim gyis 'jug pa'i tshul la/

bir+wa pa'i man ngag tu/ sems can la ma dag pa'i snang ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa la (908) nyams kyi snang ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa la dag pa'i snang ba zhes snang ba gsum 'char tshul dang*/ 'khor lo 'cham pa 'jig rten pa'i lam dang*/ 'khor lo bskor ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam/ zhes pa dang*/ lus kyi rtsa'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa bum dbang gi lam sgom pa dang*/ yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa gsang dbang gi lam sgom pa dang*/ khams bdud rtsi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang gsum pa'i lam sgom pa dang*/ snying po rlung sems dwangs pa'i dkyil 'khyor la brten nas dbang bzhi pa'i lam sgom pa dang*/ lam de rnams kyis sa drug dang*/ bzhi dang*/ gnyis dang*/ sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed non nas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa dang*/ yang dang por kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la brten nas gtso bor rgyud smin par byed pa (909) dang*/ de las lus thabs rgyud la brten nas grol byed kyi lam sgom pa dang*/ de la brten nas 'bras bu'i rgyud phyag rgya chen po 'grub pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa la thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i bdud dang*/ shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i bdud dang*/ de gnyis ka'i bdud las ngo bzung nas lam du byed tshul dang*/ yi dam dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan la sogs byung na bgegs kyi rnam 'phrul yin nam/ rang gi nyams snang yin nam/ zhal mthong gsung thos pa yang dag pa yin nam/ rnam gsum rigs dbye'i gdams pas ngos 'dzin tshul shes par bya zhing*/ de'ang ga ya dha ra'i bzhed pas 'khor bskyed rim gtso cher bsgoms nas rdzogs rim gyis rgyas 'debs pa tsam dang*/ sems la brten pa cung

(910) zad thob nas cha snyom du sgom pa dang*/ brten pa cher thob nas rdzogs rim shas cher sgom par bzhed do// drug pa la gsum/ 'khrul pa ngos bzung ba/ sngon byung gi dpe dgod pa/ ma nor ba'i don gyi khyad par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ deng sang 'ga' zhig bla ma yi// mos gus tsam gyis sems bsgyur nas// rtogs pa cung zad 'gags pa la// phyag rgya chen po ngo sprod byed// de 'dra bdud kyi yin pa'ang srid// yang na khams 'dus 'ga' la'ang byung*// zhes pa/ dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba 'ga' zhig mos pa tsam gyis chos kyi 'brel pa yod pa'i bla ma rang gi mdun nam spyi bor bsgoms pas de la sems zin pas/ tha mal rnam rtog rags pa 'gags te sems gnas pa tsam la ma bcos phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes su ngo sprod par byed de/ nyams rtogs (911) de 'dras zhi gnas yang dag gi go yang mi chod na/ phyag rgya chen por lta ci smos/ bdud kyi thibs kyis non pa'ang srid cing*/ yang lus kyi rtsa gnas 'ga' zhig tu sngar ma 'dus pa'i rlung dang*/ 'byung bzhi'i nus pa tshogs pa'i nyams snang la'ang 'byung bar gsungs te/ de nyid yun ring du goms na bying rmugs 'thibs pa'i nyams gnyan pos bsal bar dka' ba 'byung bas sems gnas pa mchog tu bzung bar mi bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ ka ru 'dzin zhes bya ba yi// brdzun brlabs can gyi grub thob byung*// de yi dgon pa mthong tsam gyis// 'ga' la ting 'dzin skye zhes zer// phyis nas de yi grub thob zhig /de nas ting 'dzin de rgyun chad// de 'dra'i ting 'dzin bdud kyi rigs// 'byung po rnams kyis byed par (912) gsungs// zhes pa/ sngon mi rgan po zhig gis ri sul du bud shing 'tshol ba la song bas/ gnya' lo skams pa'i phung po zhig gi khrod na lug gu'i pags pa la byas pa'i zhwa gcig 'dug pa rnyed nas mgo la gyon pas mi rnams kyi mtshan dpes rgyan pa'i skyes bur mthong nas grub thob ka ru 'dzin zhes grags shing*/

de'i ming thos pa dang dgon pa mthong ba tsam gyi dran rtogs 'gags pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni skye ba byung ste/ rang gi khang par zhwa de phud nas 'dug pa'i tshe sngon gyi rgan po'i gzugs su gyur pa slob ma zhig gis mthong nas/ gzhan dag la'ang smras te/ pags pa'i zhwa dkar po mi rnams kyis khyer bas grub thob zhig ting nge 'dzin ni skye ba'ang rgyun chad do// de 'dra'i rigs kyi byin brlabs dang nus pa bdud kyi bar chad du shes par bya'o// ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi (913) le 'ur/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag dgu gsungs pa'i dang po bdud kyi las shes nas spong bar byed pa la/ bdud rigs kyi lha dga' rab dbang phyug dang*/ de'i chung ma me tog gi gtsug phud can gyi spyi bo na me tog gi mda' lnga yod de/ dregs par byed pa dang*/ rmongs par byed pa dang*/ kun tu rmongs par byed pa dang*/ brgyal bar byed pa dang*/ sems med par byed pa de rnams gang la 'phangs nas phog pa de'i rigs rus yon tan dbang phyug la sogs pas dregs pa dang zhe sdang dang gti mug dang brjed nges pa dang phrag gis bar du gcod par byed do// de na mngon brjod du/ mda' lnga pa zhes 'byung ngo*// de'i 'khor bdud kyi 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi ni/ 'thab pa dang*/ g.yeng ba dang*/ lhag (914) par chags pa dang*/ 'du shes log par byed pa ste dang pos thar pa'i lam du zhugs pa'i las dang po pa dag phan tshun 'thab rtsod la sbyor bar byed/ gnyis pa gnyid dang rmugs pa dang 'dod yon la g.yeng par byed/ gsum pa longs spyod la chags nas sbyin pa la mi 'jug pa dang chags pa'i 'du shes skyed par byed/ bzhi pa rab tu byung ba rnams tshong dang zhing las dang glu gar dang bza' btung dang*/ dgod cing rtse ba dang*/ bud med la sred cing rmi lam du'ang sa bon 'phrog pa dang*/ tshangs spyod dri ma can du byed/ klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa ma rungs pa rnams bskul cing lo tog ma rungs par byed/

chos dang ldan pa rnams kyi srog 'phrog pa dang 'jigs pa skyed par byed/ sangs rgyas kyi sku nye bar ston pa la sogs 'khrul pa skyed par (915) byed de/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog par/ mi bzad brtul zhugs bzung ba yi// sgrub pa po la bdud kyi rigs// 'dod pa'i gzugs 'dzin lha mo dang*// de bzhin gzhan gyi lus su yang*// sna tshogs gzugs kyi rnam pa yis// dbang po bsdom pa 'tshe bar byed// ces gsungs pa ltar/ sdom pa bzung ba dang*/ sems las su rung ba dang*/ bsam pa dag par gyur pa dag la mtho 'tsham zhing 'khrul pa skyed par byed de/ 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa las/ bdud kyi las ni brtson 'grus dang ldan pas 'byung bar rig par bya ste/ mi brtson pa la bdud kyi ci zhig bya/ de nyid bdud kyi las yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa dang*/ dpung bzangs las/ bgegs kyis (916) bsod nams ma lus zad par byed// de phyir mi la gsang sngags 'grub mi 'gyur// ji ltar zla ba sprin las rnam grol ltar// de bzhin bgegs las grol ba rnam par mdzes// zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang gtor ma 'dod pa dang non dang*/ bsod pa'i phyir lus la 'jug pa la sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud las mang du gsungs te/ de rnams shes nas spang bar bya ste/ spong tshul ni rdo rjer tse mor/ rang gi sems ni bdud ces gsungs// rang gi sems nyid bgegs yin no// rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs// zhes gsung pas/ rang gi sems la brtags te bdud las ngo shes par bya zhing*/ gzhan yang bdud las spong ba'i thabs mya ngan med kyis byin pas zhus pa dang*/ (917) seng ge lung bstan pa dang*/ blo gros rgya mtsho'i mdor/ bdud bzhi ngos bzung ba dang spong ba'i thabs dang*/ sangs rgyas gsang bas bgegs ngos 'dzin dang spong tshul rgyas par gsungs pas ma nor bar shes nas lam zab mo sgrub pa la 'bad par bya'o// gsum pa ni/

sangs rgyas gsung bzhin bsgrubs pa yis// byin brlabs sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin// zhes pa/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa bzhin du lam bsgrubs pas bar chad zhi ba dang yon tan 'phel ba'i phan yon 'byung ba ni rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin brlabs zhugs pa'i rtags yin la/ dam pa'i chos dang mi mthun pa'i chos byas pas nad zhi ba dang yon tan 'phel ba la sogs phan yon byung ba ni bdud kyi bar chad yin pas ma nor (918) bar blang dor byed pa gal che ste/ de'ang bka' bstan bcos rnam par dag pa la thos bsam tshul bzhin byas pa las byung bar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ dad pa yod pa la dbang bskur mi dgos par 'dod pa dgag ngo sprod nor pa'i 'chal gtam dgag blun pos 'phags lam gyi ming don nor pa dgag pa'o// dang po la gnyis las/ dang po 'dod pa brjod pa ni/ kha cig skye ba snga ma la// sems bskyed dbang bskur ma byas na// chos la dad pa mi srid pas// gang dag theg chen dad thob pa// de dag sngar sbyang yin pas na// da lta dbang bskur mi dgos zer// zhes pa/ tshe 'di'i sgo gsum gyi byed spyod snga ma'i goms shugs kyis 'byung bar gsungs pas des 'khrul gzhi byas nas legs par ma brtag pa kha cig tshe 'dir (919) theg chen gyi chos la dad cing gsang sngags la mos pa de/ snga ma'i las 'phro sad pa yin pas sems bskyed dbang bskur zhu mi dgos zer ro// de dgag pa la gnyis las/ dang po stobs mtshungs kyi rigs pas dgag pa ni/ 'o na so sor thar pa yi// sdom pa dag la mos pa yang*// snga ma'i sdom pa yod pa'i phyir// da lta rab tu dbyung mi dgos// zhes pa/ dge tshul dang ge slong la sogs pa so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la mos pa de yang sngon sbyang las 'phro sad pa'i phyir sdom pa blang mi dgos sam/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed kyang*// snga ma'i sems bskyed yod pa'i phyir// da lta sems bskyed bya mi dgos// de dag dgos na gsang sngags kyi// dbang bskur yang ni cis mi dgos// zhes

(920) pa/ theg chen sems bskyed la dad pa de yang*/ snga ma'i las 'phro yod pa'i phyir da lta sems bskyed bya'ang mi dgos sam/ gal te de dag dgos na dbang bskur kyang zhu dgos par mtshungs so// gsum pa khrel bor ba'i tshang brus te dgag pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos la mi dga' ba'i// mu stegs byed kyis chos spangs pa// de la mtshar du mi rtsi yi// sangs rgyas chos la brten bzhin du// mdo rgyud nyan bshad 'gog byed pa// de la kho bo ngo mtshar skyes// zhes pa/ phyi rol mu stegs byed rnams sangs rgyas la ston par mi 'dzin pas des gsungs pa'i chos la smod cing log par rtog pa mtshar mi che yi/ theg chen gyi lam du zhugs nas sangs rgyas sgrub par 'dod pa 'ga' zhig dbang bskur dang sems bskyed 'gog pa dang*/ mdo rgyud zab mo'i nyan (921) bshad byed pa la tshig gi na ya tsam yin pas dgos pa med do zhes 'gog cing btang snyoms tsam yang mi byed par sun 'byin pa de dag la khrel ba'i gnas su gzung bar bya'o// 'jig rten pa dag lha ma gsol bas lo nyes so zhes pa ltar/ blo ma sbyangs pas blun po kho nar tshe rabs brgyud pa yin te/ tshe snga mar chos la sbyangs pa'i las 'phro tshe 'dir sad par 'dod pa bzhin du/ gzhung lugs rnam dag la thos bsam byed pa don med par smra ba ni bzhad gad kyi gnas su gsal bar grub bo// gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po zer lugs brjod pa ni// la la zhi gnas cung zad dang*// snang stong rtogs pa phra mo la// mthong lam yin zhes ngo sprod byed// khyung gi sgong nga ji bzhin du// lus kyi rgya yis bcings pas na// (922) da lta yon tan mi 'byung bas// lus rgya zhig pa'i shi ma thag /yon tan phyis nas 'byung zhes zer// ces pa/ sa lam gyi yon tan dang spangs rtogs kyi sa mtshams cha shas tsam yang mi shes par rang nyid kyi rnam rtog la gang shar rang dgar smra ba la la/

zhi gnas dang lhag mthong ngo ma shes pas sems cung zad mi 'phro bar gnas pa tsam la zhi gnas dang*/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes kyis snang ba 'gags pa'i stong pa tsam gyi rtogs pa shar ba la/ mthong lam thob pa yin zhes ngo sprod byed de/ gsung rab nas bshad pa'i zhi gnas ni bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin thob na zhi gnas kyi go chod do// thog mar bsam gtan dang po skye ba la'ang sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu dang yid la byed pa bcu gcig shes nas sgom dgos shing*/ nyer bsdog gi chos drug thob (923) nas bsam gtan dang po'i ting nge 'dzin skye zhing de sgom pa'i rjes la dngos gzhi khyad par can gyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ de nas gnyis pa la sogs pa'i zhi gnas rim gyis 'byung ba yin cing*/ de 'dra'i rnam dbye tsam yang rna bas ma thos pa la zhi gnas ga la 'byung*/ lhag mthong ni bden pa gnyis kyi gnas legs par shes pa'i lta ba yin pas/ de la nges shes legs par ma drangs pa'i 'ol phyi tsam go bas go mi chod do// de nas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong ngo mi shes par zung 'jug tu sgom pa'i rnam par ga la 'byung*/ rdo rje theg pa'i mthong lam dang*/ mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i sa mtshams dang ngo bo la khyad par med do// des na mthong lam thob nas kyang tha mal gyi rnam rtog dang nyon mongs ma spangs pa 'di 'dra khyung gi phrug gu (924) sgong nga'i rgyas bcings pa'i dpes mtshon du mi rung*/ 'phags pa'i ye shes lus kyi rgyas bcings pa ma yin te bdag 'dzin gyi sa bon spangs pa'i phyir ro// so sor skye bor log nas 'ongs pa yang mi rigs te/ bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes nyams pa med pa'i phyir te/ bdag lta'i sa bon spangs pa'i phyir/ slar mi gshegs pa nyid yin no// zhes pa dang*/ 'tshe ba med dang yang dag don// ngo bo nyid las phyin log gis// 'bad du zin kyang mi ldog ste// blo ni bde phyogs 'dzin phyir ro// zhes gsungs so// 'byung pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i skye bo bzhi byung ba las gcig na re/

sems nyid stong pa 'di lus rgya dang bral ba'i tshe stong pa chen po'i ngang du thim nas rang grol du 'gyur ba yin te/ bum pa bcag pa'i tshe nang gi nam mkha' nam mkha' (925) chen po dang 'dres pa yin no// zhes ngo sprad pa 'di 'dra'i rigs rnams mu stegs rgyang 'phan pa'i 'dod pa dang khyad par med pa'i phyir rgyang ring du dor bar bya'o// de la blun po de dag na re/ da lta mthong lam ngo mthong tsam nyi ma ri rtser shar tsam dang 'dra/ yon tan rnams phyis rim gyis rdzogs par 'byung zer ro// gnyis pa de dgag pa la gnyis las/ dang po sgrub byed kyi khungs med par bstan pa ni/ theg pa chen po mdo rgyud las/ 'di 'dra'i chos lugs bshad pa med// ces pa/ khyod kyis theg pa chen po'i mthong lam gyi skye tshul dang*/ yon tan gyi 'byung tshul 'di 'dra mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnam dag gang nas kyang bshad pa med de/ mdo las/ de chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang (926) bral ba skyes so// the tshom las brgal to// som nyi las brgal to// zhes gsungs shing*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ gang gis rten cing 'brel par byung*// mthong ba de yis sdug bsngal dang*// kun 'byung dang ni 'gog pa dang*// lam gyi de nyid mthong ba yin// zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon zla ba grags kyang*/ gang gis rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba skye ba med par shes pa dang 'gag pa med par mthong ba'i skad cig ma gcig la chos thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyis skye ba med pa dang 'gag pa med par mngon sum gyis mthong ste/ sngar ma mthong ba'i lta bar bya ba gzhan med do// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa 'brel med kyi dpe dgod pa ni/ nyi ma de ring shar ba yi// 'od zer nangs par 'byung ba mtshar// zhes pa/ theg pa chen po'i (927) mthong lam la yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung bar bka' dang bstan bcos rnams nas gsungs pa de/

ma 'ongs pa na 'byung bar 'dod pa ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor da ltar shar nas 'jig rten gsal bar byed pa'i 'od zer nangs par rim gyis shar nas mun pa sel ba dang*/ pad+mo rgyas pa'i don byed do zhes zer ba dang mtshungs te/ ma byung mi 'byung 'byung bar ma gyur pa'i mthong lam 'di lta bu shin tu ngo mtshar che'o// gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po'i 'khrul pa'i 'dod pa sun dbyung ba la gnyis/ zer lugs brjod pa ni/ kha cig pha rol phyin pa dang*// gsang sngags gnyis kyi mthong lam la// rgyan can rgyan med yin zhes zer// zhes pa/ mthong lam la yon tan brgyas/ bcu gcig 'byung (928) bar bshad pa sa bcu pa'i sde snod la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs yin gyi/ gsang sngags kyi mthong lam la yon tan de dag ma gsungs pas mtshan nyid theg pa'i mthong lam rgyan can dang*/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i mthong lam rgyan med dang po nyan thos kyi sde snod las bshad tshul la gnyis las/ dang po dgra bcom la rgyan yod med bshad pa ni/ de lta yin na sangs rgyas kyang*// rgyan can rgyan med gnyis su 'gyur// nyan thos rnams kyi dgra bcom la// rgyan can rgyan med gnyis 'thad kyi// theg pa chen po'i 'phags pa la// rgyan can rgyan med gnyis mi srid// ces pa/ theg pa chen po'i mthong lam la rgyan can rgyan med gnyis su 'dod pa de ltar yin na/ de'i

(929) 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la'ang rgyan yod med gnyis su 'gyur te de 'dra mi srid do// 'on te nyan thos kyi dgra bcom pa la rgyan can rgyan med gnyis su gsungs pa'i phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la'ang de dang mtshungs so snyam na mi mtshungs te/ nyan thos la bsam gtan dang po la sogs pa'i zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin dngos gzhi ma thob par bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med tsam la brten nas bdag med mngon sum gyis rtogs pa'i ye shes mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam dang*/ mi slob pa'i lam mthar phyin te/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i rnam grol gyi lam zad pa dang*/ mi skye ba shes pa'i ye shes thob pa de la dgra bcom pa shes rab kyi chos rnam (930) par grol ba dang rgyan med ces gsungs pa yin te/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i yon tan rnams med pa dang 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ma thob pa'i phyir ro// bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi'i zhi gnas rnam par dag pa thob cing de la brten nas zad par dang zil non dang mngon shes drug dang*/ rnam thar brgyad dang*/ mthar gyi snyoms 'jug dgu thob pa'i 'phags pa phyir mi 'ong dang dgra bcom pa ni yon tan de rnams kyis brgyan pas rgyan can zhes gsungs shing*/ mdzod du/ ston dang bse ru byang chub pa// bsam gtan mthar rten gcig la kun// zhes rab kyi mtha'i bsam gtan bzhi pa'i zhi gnas kyi sems la brten nas bdag med mngon sum gyis rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gi ye shes mthong spangs dang*/ khams gsum pas (931) dgu'i sgom spang brgyad cu rtsa gcig sgom lam dgu spangs nas mi slob pa'i chos bcu zhes bya ba bzhi 'phags lam yan lag brgyad dang*/ rnam grol dang*/ rnam grol ye shes mthong ba'i rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i tshe 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug kyang lhun grub tu thob nas sangs rgyas yon tan thams cad kyi rgyan dang ldan par gyur pa yin no// 'gog thob gnyis ka las rnam grol/

shes rab kyis ni gcig shes so// zhes pa bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis khams gsum gyi 'ching ba las grol ba dang*/ snyoms 'jug dgu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa las grol bas gnyis ka'i cha'i rnam grol dang rgyan can yin no// dgra bcom gzhan gyis 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ched du sgrub dgos na'ang (932) bcom ldan 'das ni sangs rgyas pa'i tshe lhun grub tu brnyes pa yin no zhes chos mngon pa nas bshad do// des na nyan thos kyi theg par yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyan can du grub cing*/ theg pa chen por sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa'i tshe yon tan gyi rgyan de dag rdzogs par thob pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la theg pa thams cad kyis 'phags pa'i yon tan lhun gyis grub cing*/ 'phags pa gzhan la med pa'i yon tan stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i phyir rgyan med kyi tha snyad mi srid do// theg chen gyi grub thob rgyan med dang sangs rgyas rgyan med 'dod pa ni 'phags pa'i gang zag la skur pa 'debs pa'i las mtshams med las kyang shin tu lci ba yin no// gnyis pa bar dor mya ngan las (933) 'da' bar bshad pa ni/ nyan thos lcags kyi tsha tsha'i dpes// tshe 'dir mya ngan ma 'das pa// bar dor mya ngan 'da' bar gsungs// zhes pa/ nyan thos kyi sde snod las/ 'phags pa phyir mi 'ong bar dor mya ngan las 'da' bar bshad pa yang*/ gzugs khams kyis bsdus pa'i las la nus pa gsum yod cing*/ phyir mi 'ong ba dbang po gsum yod pa'i las dang nyon mongs chung ngu dang*/ dbang po rnon po de gzugs khams kyi bar do grub ma thag dang*/ bar do'i tshe phyed tsam dang*/ bar do 'gags nas skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshe lhag bcas dang lhag med kyi mya ngan las 'da' ba yin te/ mgar bas lcags me 'bar ba la tho bas bsnun pa'i tsha tsha me shi ba myur bul gsum 'byung

(934) ba bzhin no// las dang nyon mongs dang dbang po 'bring ni gzugs khams su skyes nas mya ngan las 'das tshul gsum dang*/ las dang nyon mongs chen po 'phags pa dbang po rtul po ni gong du 'pho ba yin cing de rnams la skyes bu dam pa'i 'gro ba bdun zhes bya ste/ dam pa dam min 'jug mi 'jug son pa phyir mi 'ong phyir ro// zhes dam pa ma yin pa'i sgo gsum gyi las la 'jug pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa de theg chen gyi lugs rgya dang mi mtshungs par bstan pa la gnyis las/ dang po brdzun tshig yin par bstan pa ni// de bzhin gsang sngags bsgom pa las// tshe 'dir mthong lam ma thob pa// bar dor mthong lam thob mod kyi// tshe 'dir mthong lam skyes pa la// yon tan shi nas 'byung ba ni// blun po rnams kyi brdzun rigs yin/ (935) /zhes pa/ nyan thos kyi theg par 'phags pa phyir mi 'ong gzugs khams kyi bar dor mya ngan las 'da' ba bshad pa ltar/ gsang sngags kyi theg par yang*/ tshe 'dir mthong lam ma thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'chi khar rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin gsal bas 'byung ba rnams rim gyis thim pa'i rlung dang snang ba la rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ sems la dmigs pa dang*/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ngos zin par byas te/ khams dang sems kyi dwangs ma chos nyid 'od gsal dang gnyis su med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas bar do dang po'i nyams shar ba'i tshe zung 'jug gi ye shes mthong lam thob par rgyud dang grub thob rnams kyis gsungs te/ 'on kyang nyan thos kyi bar dor mya ngan las 'da' ba dang ming tsam 'dra na'ang don rnam pa (936) thams cad du mi mtshungs so// nyan thos kyi theg par 'dod pa khams kyi bar do bden pa mthong ba tsam yang mi srid na mya ngan las 'das pa lta ci smos/ rdo rje theg par/ gzugs khams kyi bar do mthong lam thob pa tsam yang mi srid na/ 'tshang rgya ba lta ci smos/

des na gsung rab mtha' dag gi bshad tshul rang sar gtan la 'bebs dgos so// mdo rgyud kyi tshig cung zad tsam la'ang ma 'dris shing sa lam gyi rgyus med par mthong lam tshe 'dir thob nas yon tan gyi khyad par skad cig tsam las sprul pa brgya 'gyed pa dang*/ zhing khams brgya g.yo ba dang*/ sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal blta zhing chos nyan pa dang*/ chos kyi rnam grangs mi 'dra ba brgya ston pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin brgya la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang ba dang*/ gdul bya brgya smin par byed pa la (937) sogs shi ba'i rjes na mar rim gyis 'byung ngo zhes smra ba ni blun po rnyed bkur sgrub pa'i thabs brdzun tshig sgrog pa'o// gnyis pa de mkhas pas spang byar bstan pa ni// mdo rgyud kun dang mi mthun pas// 'di 'dra'i chos lugs mkhas pas spangs// zhes pa/ theg pa che chung gi bka' dang bstan bcos rnam dag gang dang mi mthun pa'i rang bzo'i chos lugs yi ger bris pa dang*/ gzhan la 'chad pa dang*/ nyams su len pa du ma zhig snang na'ang*/ rang gzhan legs par 'dod pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis shes nas spang bar bya zhing ma nor bar khas blang par bya'o// gnyis pa ma 'khrul pa'i dgongs pa legs par bshad pa la gsum las/ dang po nā ro pa'i dgongs pa bshad pa ni/ jo bo nā ro ta pa ni/ (938) dbang bskur dus su mthong lam skye// de ni skad cig de la 'gag /chos mchog rjes kyi mthong lam ni// 'gag pa med ces gsung bar grags// 'di ni dpe yi ye shes la// mthong ba'i lam du btags par zad// ces pas/ bla ma te lo pa yun ring du bsten cing dka' ba spyad pas gdams pa phyin ci ma log pa'i skyes bu dam pa paṇa chen nā ro pa'i bzhed pas/ dbang bskur gsum pa'i dus su skad cig bzhi dang dga' ba bzhi nyams myong rgyud la skyes pa'i tshe skad cig bzhi pa mthong lam yin la/ de las rjes su byung ba'i rig pa de ni mthong lam 'gag pa'i gnas skabs so so skye bo'i blo yin cing*/

sbyor lam chos mchog chen po'i rjes su skyes pa'i mthong lam ni nyams pa med ces gsungs par grags ces pa des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rtsod med ma (939) gzigs pa'o// dbang bskur ba'i dus kyi nyams myong mthong lam du ngo sprad pa ni/ mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes la mtshon bya don gyi mthong lam du ming btags par zad de/ nam mkhar shar ba'i zla ba go bar byed pa la chu nang du shar ba'i gzugs ston par byed pa bzhin/ dbang bzhi pa'i tshig tsam gyis ngo sprod pa yin no// gnyis pa ār+ya de ba'i lugs bshad pa ni/ 'phags pa lha yi spyod bsdus su// bden pa mthong yang las mtha' la// chags par gsungs pa rdzogs rim gyi/ rang byung ye shes rtogs pa ni/ dpe yi ye shes nyid la dgongs// de dang lam 'bras la sogs pa// grub thob rnams kyi dgongs pa mthun// zhes pa/ gal te sgrub pa po bden pa mthong yang sngon gyi bag (940) chags goms pa'i stobs kyis zhing las dang tshong dang rnyed bkur la sogs pas g.yengs pas/ spyod pa ma spyad pa dang*/ sbyor ba chung pas spyod pa'i cho ga ma rdzogs par 'chi ba'i dus byas na srid pa gzhan du skye bar 'gyur ba'am/ rdo rje 'chang nyid 'thob par 'gyur zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ yang dag pa'i don mthong bas rtag pa dang chad pa dang 'pho ba la sogs pa'i lta ba ngan pa 'gag par 'gyur ro// 'on kyang tha snyad la brten nas 'pho ba rnam par dag pa nges par spyad par bya ste/ 'jig rten 'di pha rol tu 'pho bar mi byed de rtag pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'chi ba las gzhan las kyang mi 'byung ste/ rgyu med du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'di ltar mar me las mar me dang*/ rgya las rgya dang*/ sgra las brag cha ltar de nyid gzhan du brjod par mi (941) nus so// gser 'od dam par/ sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te// sems can rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir// mya ngan 'das par bstan pa yin// zhes pa dang*/

yang lang kar gshegs par/ 'di la gang yang rkyen rnams kyis// skye ba med cing 'gag pa med// btags pa'i rkyen rnams kho na ni// skye zhing 'gag par 'gyur ba yin// zhes pas 'chi khar blo'i 'phen pa gtong tshul 'chi ba don dam pa dang kun rdzob bden pa rtog nas 'od gsal bar zhugs te/ tha mal gyi phung po bor nas bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pas ldang bar bya'o// zhes sems brtan po skyed de/ skye ba gzhan du yid la byed pa de ni 'dor (942) bas thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur ro// bsam pa gang dang gang gis ni// mi rnams yid ni yang dag sbyor// des na de yi rang bzhin 'gyur// sna tshogs nor bu rang bzhin no// zhes gsungs so// de'i dgongs pa ni 'di yin te/ bskyed rim bstan par 'gyur nas rdzogs rim dben pa gsum dang*/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa sgyu lus kyi rim pa mthar phyin pa ni/ kun rdzob bden pa mthong ba'i lam yin la/ des 'od gsal gyi rim pa don dam pa'i bden pa mthar ma phyin par 'chi ba'i dus byed pa'i tshe/ spyod pa ma spyad pas zung 'jug mngon du byed mi nus pa'i phyir 'chi ba 'od gsal la mnyam par bzhag nas bar dor skyes pa'i tshe zung 'jug gi rim pa mngon du 'gyur te/ 'chi khar 'dun pa btang nas 'od gsal dang zung 'jug nyams su len pa'i (943) yid kyi sbyor ba bzang po de nor bu tshon gyi rnam pa brten pa ltar/ 'chi ba'i 'od gsal dang bar do'i sgyu lus kyi snang ba shar ba'i tshe/ sngon gyi 'phen pa dang lam la sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'grub par gsungs pa yin no// de nas kun rdzob bden pas mthong ba sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa la gnas nas chos mchog gi lam du 'od gsal mthar ma phyin par 'chi ba de/ spyod pa dang 'od gsal gyi rtog pa bsres nas zung 'jug 'bad med du 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir skabs der spyod pa sbyang dgos pa ma grub pa ma yin no// 'ga' zhig sgyu lus 'dzin pa sbyang ba'i phyir 'od gsal sgom pa ma yin te/

sgrib pa gnyis kyi nang nas shes bya'i sgrib pa spang dka' ba de sbyang ba'i 'od gsal gyi rim pa yin zhes zer ba yod na'ang*/ (944) sgyu lus kyi skabs su gsang ba dang ye shes kyi dbang la brten pa'i snang ba sgyu ma'i dpe gsum dang mtshungs pa'i lha sku dang*/ nyams myong dbang gsum pa'i don lam du byed pa'i dus yin pas kun rdzob bden pa'i lam de don dam bden pa dang*/ zung 'jug tu sgrub pa'i phyir 'od gsal sgom par gsungs te/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam gnyis// so so'i char ni shes gyur nas// gang du'ang yang dag 'dres gyur pa// zung du 'jug par de bshad do// zhes gsungs shing*/ sems 'grel du/ de phyir chos rnams kun gyi gzhi// zhi zhing sgyu ma dang mtshungs pa// gzhi med srid pa 'jig byed pa'i// stong nyid 'di ni rtag tu bsgom// zhes sgyu lus kyi dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir 'od gsal sgom par gsungs la/ de la sngon gyi 'phen pa dang*/ (945) 'od gsal gyis sbyangs pa'i rlung sems kyi snang ba rgyun mi chad par shar ba de zung 'jug gi sku/ rgyu bden gnyis zung 'jug nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu yang sku gnyis zung 'jug 'grub pa yin no// zung 'jug gi don ni sems 'grel du/ de nyid ji bzhin bshad pa la// kun rdzob rgyu ni chad mi 'gyur// kun rdzob las ni tha dad par// de nyid dmigs pa ma yin te// kun rdzob stong pa nyid du bshad// stong nyid kho na kun rdzob yin// med na mi 'byung nges pa'i phyir// byas dang mi rtag ji bzhin no// zhes gsungs te/ zung 'jug gi do yu ga na da ba zhes pa gnyis gcig tu gyur ba'i don to// zung 'jug thob nas de nyid nyams su blangs pas shes bya'i sgrib pa ngang gis spong zhing*/ gnyen (946) po gzhan mi dgos pa yin te/ rgyal tshab byams pas kyang*/ nyon mongs can min sgrib pa bcu// sa bcu'i mi mthun phyogs rnams kyi// gnyen po dag ni sa yin no// zhes gsungs so// 'on te sgyu ma'i snang ba de shes bya'i sgrib pa yin pas 'od gsal gyi rim pas spong snyam du sems shin tu'ang 'khrul te/

zung 'jug shes bya'i sgrib pa mngon gyur gyi snang ba can dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gnyis kyang shes sgrib kyi skur 'gyur ro// byang sems sgrib pa rnam sel gyis sangs rgyas la bstod par/ chos tshul 'di dag sgyu ma smig sgyu dang*// chu zla 'dra bar gang gis gzigs gyur pa// bsod nams zhing rab de la phyag 'tshal du// ri bo'i mchog rab 'di la bdag cag lhags// zhes pa la sogs sangs rgyas la'ang sgyu lus kyi snang ba rab (947) 'byams yod par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// lam 'bras bu snang ba gsum gyi 'khrid la sogs pa gsungs pa rnams kyang*/ nges bden gyi rtogs pa 'char tshul la/ klu sgrub yab sras dang nā ro mai tri pa la sogs pa grub thob rnams kyi bzhed pa mthun te/ lam 'bras bu bum dbang gi lam gyi lta ba dang*/ grub mtha' snang stong zung 'jug gsang dbang gis gsal stong zung 'jug shes rab ye shes kyis bde stong zung 'jug dbang bzhi pa'i lam gyi lta ba dang grub mtha' de thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i zung 'jug mthar thug tu bzhed pa yin no// gsum pa mthong lam gyi sa mtshams bstan pa ni/ des na nged kyis mthong lam ni// 'phags pa min la 'byung mi srid// ces pa/ des na grub thob rnams

(948) kyi dgongs pa bzhin du sbyor lam rtogs pa'i dpe'i ye shes la mthong lam du btags pa ni cha mthun pa la dgongs pa yin te/ nges 'byed cha mthun gyi ming don dang cig go /mthong lam mtshan nyid pa ni/ chos mchog chen po'i skad cig la rjes dran gyi mtshams sbyar nas zung 'jug gi ye shes skyes pa la zer cing*/ ye shes ni mdo las/ dpa' bar 'gro bar ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin gang du ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi spyod yul nyams su myong bas te/ 'di ni dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// zhes gsungs pa'i don dang gcig par spyod bsdus dang grub chen man lung gu ru bzhed de/ 'phags pa ma yin pa'i gang zag la ting nge 'dzin de med cing*/ sa bcu pa'i rgyal sras kyis yongs su rdzogs par thob pa yin no// don 'di 'phags pa thogs med kyis kyang (949) gsal bar gsungs te/ sprin mthong mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin 'dir khyod phyogs gcig blo gros can// blo mig dag pa'i 'phags rnams kyis kyang rnam pa thams cad mthong ma lags// bcom ldan 'das khyod gang dag chos kun blo gros mtha' yas pas// shes bya mtha' med mkha' dbyings khyab pa de dag gis kun mthong*// zhes gsungs so// lnga pa la gsum/ bstan bya theg pa'i rim pa/ ston byed bla ma'i mtshan nyid/ 'gag bsdus te bstan pa'o// dang pa ni/ theg pa gsum gyi lag len kyang*// rang rang gzhung lugs bzhin byed na// sangs rgyas bstan yin mi byed na// bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan yin zhes bya// zhes pa/ bden pa bzhis thos bsam dang sgom byung gi shes rab kyis rim gyis shes nas mngon du (950) byas pas sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi bden pa zad de/ 'gog pa dang lam gyi bden pa mthar phyin nas/ rang don mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i nyan thos kyi theg pa dang*/ de las khyad par du rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi don bsgoms pas srid pa tha ma la slob dpon gyi gdam ngag la ma ltos par byang chub mngon du byed pa'i rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang*/

gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i theg pa chen po'i lam la slob tshul rang rang gi gzhung lugs bzhin du snga phyi dang dmigs rnams ma 'khrugs par byas na/ rang gi thar pa thob pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa lung dang bshad sgrub kyi go chod pa yin no// de las gzhan pa'i bshad sgrub byed pa sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan yin pas dor bar bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis las dang po bla ma'i dbye ba ni/ (951) nyan thos rnams kyi bla ma de// bzang yang gang zag kho nar bas// pha rol phyin pa'i bla ma ni// bzang na dge 'dun dkon mchog yin// gsang sngags pa yi bla ma mchog /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med yin// zhes pa/ spyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi bla ma dang theg pa thams cad kyi ston pa yin la/ khyad par nyan thos kyi bla mas sdom pa 'bogs pa dang*/ de ma nyams par srung ba'i tshul dang*/ lam lnga go rim ma 'khrugs par rgyud la skye ba'i thabs tshang la ma nor bar ston pa de/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yin kyang gang zag bzang po yin gyis dkon mchog gsum po gang du'ang ma 'dus so// pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa ston pa'i slob dpon de zhi dul dang snying rje dang byang (952) chub kyi sems dang lam ston pa la mkhas pa dang skye ba bzod pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan na theg chen gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog yin no// rdo rje theg pa'i bla ma rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gdam pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pas dbang bskur lam ma nor bar nyams su len tshul/ gegs sel/ bogs 'don la sogs pa zab mo ster ba de dkon mchog gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin te/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// dngos grub go 'phang mchog 'dod pas// kun nas bla ma mnyes par bya// zhes gsungs so// des na de la gsol btab pas// dkon mchog gsum po tshe 'dir 'grub// de lta'i theg pa gsum po yi// so so'i gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin// bla ma'i mtshan nyid mi ldan na// bla ma yin gyis dam

(953) pa min// zhes pa/ gsang sngags kyi bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa yin pas de ltar shes nas rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab na/ rang nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor tshe 'di la 'grub par 'gyur ro// theg pa gsum po rang rang gi gzhung nas byung ba'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid tshang na bla ma dam pa yin la/ ma tshang na chos kyi 'brel pa yod pa'i bla ma tsam yin kyang dam pa ni ma yin no// gnyis pa bla ma brten tshul la gnyis las/ dang po dam pa ma yin pa brten tshul ni/ de la gsol ba btab na yang*// byin rlabs cung zad 'byung mod kyi// tshe 'di 'am bar do la sogs su// sangs rgyas nyid sbyin mi nus so// zhes pa/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid mi ldan cing chos kyi 'brel pa yod pa'i bla ma de la mos (954) gus byas na rang gi bsam pa bzang ba'i nus pas byin brlabs cung zad 'byung gis/ gang zag de la slob ma'i rgyud smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i mthu med pas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mi nus so// gnyis pa bla ma dam pa bsten tshul la gsum las/ dang po dbang bskur ba'i bla ma bsten tshul ni/ des na dbang bskur thob pa'i mis// dkon mchog gsum po bla ma ru// 'dus par mthong nas bla ma la// gsol ba btab na byin brlabs 'jug /ces pa/ rgyud lung man ngag dang mthun pa'i dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i slob ma des/ bla ma'i phung po lnga sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin dang*/ skye mched byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid dang*/ thugs bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i ngo bor shes nas/ the tshom dang log rtog gi sel ma zhugs par gsol ba btab na (955) dngos grub thams cad 'phral du 'byung ste/ mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyi gsung las/ bla ma sangs rgyas dang byang sems dang 'phags pa dang so so'i skye bo'i yon tan tsam du mthong nas gsol ba btab na de dang mthun pa'i byin rlabs 'byung zhing*/ bla ma skyon can du mthong na byin rlabs mi 'byung bar ma zad/

dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa 'byung ste/ lha sbyin gyis sangs rgyas skyon can du mthong bas dmyal bar skyes pa dang*/ lho phyogs 'bras spungs kyi slob mas bla ma'i lo gsum gyi sngon du mchog gi dngos grub thob pa bzhin no// zhes gsungs so// lam 'bras las kyang*/ dbang po gsum gyi lam bstan pa'i dbang po rab kyi lam bsgrod tshul bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong nas mos gus lam du byed pa de tshe 'dir grol ba thob par gsungs te/ (956) lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhes lam gyi mthar thug tu mdzad do// gnyis pa dbang ma bskur ba'i bla ma bsten tshul ni/ gal te dbang bskur ma thob na// bla ma dkon mchog gsum nyid du// phar la bsdus la gsol ba thob// rim gyis byin rlabs ci rigs 'jug /ces pa/ dbang ma bskur cing gdams pa zab mo byin pa'i bla ma yin na/ de dkon mchog gsum gyi nang du bsdus la/ skyabs gnas mthar thug chos dang dge 'dun kyang sangs rgyas su 'dus par gsungs pa bzhin/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po'am sman bla'am mi 'khrugs pa dang tshe dpag med la sogs pa'i rnam pa mdun du gsal bar dmigs shing de sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du yid ches byas la/ rgyun mi chad par gsol ba (957) btab na byin rlabs 'byung zhing*/ tshul 'di dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo dang*/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum bzhugs pa'i mdo la sogs pa'i dgongs pa ma nor ba yin no// gsum pa de dkon mchog gsum du bsdus pa'i 'thad pa ni/ bla ma rkyang pa bzang srid kyang*// gsol ba btab pa byin rlabs chung*// de bas dkon mchog gsum nyid la// gsol ba btab pa shin tu bzang*// zhes pa/ dbang bskur ma thob pa'i bla ma de bzang yang*/ rang gi sgo gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su rten 'brel sgrigs pa'i bla ma ma yin pas byin rlabs 'byung ba'i 'brel thag ring ba yin no// des na bla ma dkon mchog gsum du bsdus nas gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo shin tu bzang ste/

sems (958) can thams cad kyi skyabs gnas nam mkha' dang mnyam par dad gus gang byed la byin rlabs phyogs ris med par 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ mdo las/ mi gang thub pa zla ba dran byed pa// de yi mdun na thub dbang rtag tu bzhugs// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ dbang bskur dang po ma thob par// bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*// dbang bskur gnyis pa ma thob par// gtum mo la sogs bsgom pa dang*// dbang bskur gsum pa ma thob par// bde stong la sogs sgom pa dang*// dbang bskur bzhi pa ma thob par// phyag rgya chen po sogs sgom dang*// zhes pa/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dbang du byas nas bum dbang ma thob par bskyed rim sgom pa ni tha mal gyi phung po mi sbyangs snod ma dag pa yin no// gsang dbang ma thob par gtum mo dang rlung bsgom pa ni rten yi (959) ge'i dkyil 'khor ma sbyangs pa yin la/ 'di ni rlung gsum dang yi ge gsum dang ngag brjod pa gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la de dag sangs rgyas kyi gsung sgrub pa'i rten 'brel ma bsgrigs pa'i phyir ro// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ma thob par bde stong gi rnal 'byor dang*/ lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi dga' ba bzhi nyams su len pa ni khams byin gyis ma brlabs pas ye shes rnal ma skye ba'i rgyur mi rung ba'i phyir ro// dper na/ sa bon rnying pa 'ga' zhig ma sbyangs par zhing la btab na lo tog rnal ma mi skye ba bzhin no// dbang bzhi pa ma thob par phyag rgya chen po'i lam sgom pa ni lam rgyus med par don gnyer ba'i sar 'gro ba bzhin ye shes ngo mi 'phrod pa'i phyir/ des na rgyu sngon du ma song ba'i 'bras bu 'grub dka' zhing lam nor par 'jug pa'i nyes pa (960) yod la/ spyir yang dbang ma thob pa de la de'i grol byed kyi lam ston pa ni snod min la gsang ba bsgrags pa'i nyes par yang 'gyur ro// dge slong sdom pa ma thob par// mkhan po la sogs byed pa ni// gsang sngags med par sbrul gdug gi

/mgo la rin chen len pa ltar// rang gzhan brlag pa'i rgyu ru bas// mkhas pa rnams kyi rgyang ring spangs// zhes pa/ rang gi dge slong sdom pa ma thob par gzhan gyi mkhan po byed pa la sogs byar mi rung ba'i chos dang lag len byed pa thams cad dug sbrul gyi mgo la yod pa'i rin po che sngags dang sman gyi nus pa med par len na/ rin po che'i phan yon mi 'byung zhing*/ dug gi nyes pa 'byung ba ltar rang gzhan phung ba'i rgyu yin pas mdo rgyud mkhyen pa rnams kyis dor bar bya'o// drug pa la bzhi/ gtor ma'i lag len nor (961) tshul/ ras bris kyis lag len nor tshul/ cho ga'i lag len nor tshul/ mdo sngags 'dres pa'i lag len nor tshul lo// dang po la gnyis/ nor pa spang byar bstan pa/ ma nor ba blang byar bstan pa'o// dang po la lnga/ kha 'bar gtor ma'i lag len/ chu sbyin gyi lag len/ zan phud kyi lag len/ lha bshos kyi lag len/ rnying ma dang 'dres pa'i lag len no// dang po ni/ gzhan yang gangs ri'i khrod 'di na// 'khrul pa'i lag len du ma yod// kha 'bar ma yi gtor ma la// de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi yi mtshan// sngon la brjod pa'i lag len mthong*// 'di yang mdo dang mthun ma yin// mdo la sngon la sngags brjod nas// sangs rgyas bzhi po phyi nas gsungs// zhes pa/ sngar nor pa sun dbyung ba de dag (962) las gzhan yang*/ bod yul na chos kyi byed tshul sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mi mthun pa'i nor pa mang po yod de/ yi dwags kha la me 'bar ma la gtor ma sbyin pa'i cho gar/ rgyal chen shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags su grags pa de ni/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ zhes pa 'di 'phags pa la mchod pa 'bul na lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas nas 'bul/ yi dwags la lan bdun bzlas pa'i rjes su de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang dang*/ gzugs dam pa dang*/ sku 'jam klas dang*/

'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod par gsungs pa la/ mkhas 'dod gcig gis thog mar sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal ba rigs snyam nas/ sngags dang phyag go bsnor nas byed pa yod de/ phyag 'tshal ba ni bden stobs brjod pa'i don yin (963) pa ma go bar zad do// bod kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi po/ thub chen dang*/ 'jam dbyangs dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ phyag na rdo rje rnams yin par 'dod do// gnyis pa ni/ 'ga' zhig chu sbyin nang du zan// 'jug pa'i lag len byed pa thos// 'jur 'gegs can gyi yi dwags kyis// chu sbyin nang du zan mthong na// 'jigs pa chen po 'byung bar gsungs// des na chu sbyin nang du zan// 'debs pa cho ga nyams pa yin// zhes pa/ yi dwags 'jur 'gegs can la/ oṃ dz+wa la mi taṃ sarba pre te bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis chu thigs pa rgyun bcad cing ster ba dang*/ se gol gtogs pa'i lag len la chu nang du zan 'jug pa'i lugs yod de/ zan gyi dri tshor na dngangs (964) skrag chen po 'byung bar mdo de nyid las gsal por gsungs pa'i phyir lag len nor pa yin pas mi bya'o// 'dir dz+wa la zhes ring por byed pa ni nor pa'o// gsum pa ni/ zan gyi phud la lha bshos dang*/ changs bu bya bar sangs rgyas gsungs// rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las ni/ zan gyi phud la changs bu sbyin// zhes gsungs 'phrog ma'i mdo las kyang*/ sangs rgyas bstan par khas 'che na// 'phrog ma la ni changs bu sbyin// zhes gsungs de yi cho ga ni// lta ba ngan sel la sogs ltos// zhes pa/ kyai rdo rjer/ oṃ dh+waṃ dh+waṃ lha bshos kyi sngags so// zhes pa dang*/ a ka ro 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i sngags su gsungs pas bla ma dkon mchog la lha bshos phul ba dang*/ chos skyong dang 'jig rten pa'i mgron la'ang sngags des 'bul bar slob dpon dze ta ri'i yi dam

(965) blang ba'i cho gar yang gsungs so// rdo rje rtse mor/ de nas zas kyi dus su ni// rnam pa kun tu changs bu sbyin// zhes gsungs so// bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nga la ston par khas 'che ba'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa la changs bu sbyin par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// 'phrog ma'i lo rgyus ni/ rgyal po'i khab tu/ gzhon nu mang pos ri khrod nas 'ongs pa'i gzhon nu ma byis pa btsa' ba'i dus la nye ba zhig bzung ste/ rkang stabs sgyur bas lto nang gi sems can lhung bas ches khros par gyur te/ dge slong bzhi la chos ston gsol nas rgyal po'i khab kyi byis pa btsas so cog za ba'i smon lam btab pas grub par gyur to// byis pa rnams kyi srog 'phrog pas 'phrog ma zhes grags so// gnod (966) sbyin lnga rtsen gyi chung ma byas te bu lnga brgya btsas so// de'i rgyal po'i khab kyi skye bo rnams kyis sangs rgyas la 'phrog ma 'dul bar gsol ba btab pas gnang ste/ bu chung shos lhung bzed du bcug nas sbas so// bus ma mthong zhing mas bu mi mthong bar byin gyis brlabs so// bu tshol ba'i phyir du sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug par khor yug gi ri'i khongs thams cad nyul kyang ma rnyed nas/ rgyal po rnam thos kyi bu la gsol pas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus cig ces bsgo'o// ston pa la zhus pas/ rgyal po'i khab kyi byis pa skyes so cog med par byed na/ khyod la bu lnga brgya yod pas gcig ma tshang ba la mya ngan byed par mi rigs zhes gsungs so// slar bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can la 'tshe ba mi byed par bka' bsgos zhing*/

(967) 'phrog ma las dam bcas te/ me kha la'i gzungs zhes bya ba rang gi snying po phul lo// lhung bzed bsal te bu bstan pas dga' bar gyur to// sha khrag la longs spyod pa spangs pas 'tsho bas 'phongs par gyur pa la changs bu sbyin par gsungs so// lta ba ngan sel du/ bram ze'i rigs la mngon par zhen pa'i mu stegs nam mkha'i snying po zhes bya ba rdo rje'i gdan nas mai tri pa'i spyan sngar byung ba de 'dul ba'i phyir rgyal sras las dang po'i spyod pa gsungs te/ gso sbyong dang skyabs 'gro dang dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa dang*/ gsung rab klog pa dang*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa dus gsum du kha ton bya ba dang*/ dzam+bha la la chu sbyin pa dang kha 'bar ma'i sngags lan bdun zlas pa'i lag pa'i sor mo brkyang pa (968) la bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chu dang*/ zas kyi gtor ma sgo drung du byin pas yi dwags kyi tshogs rnams/ sa ma ga ta'i yul gyi bre bo che re re thob par 'gyur te/ se gol gsum gdab par bya'o// zhes pa dang*/ mdun du sangs rgyas rigs lnga rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can la mchod pa dang*/ mdo las gsungs pa'i/ sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// skyobs pa chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo// gsum la rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal// zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang*/ tsha tsha gdab pa dang*/ zas za ba'i tshe a kā ro'i sngags kyis gtor ma sbyin par bya'o// oṃ āḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa bh+yaḥbadz+ra naiwid+ya hūm̐/ zhes bya bas dkon mchog la bshos gtsang dbul lo// (969) oṃ ha ri te ma hā yak+ṣi ni/ ha ra ha ra sarba pā paṃ ni k+ṣe swāhā/ 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa la changs bu gnyis sbyin par bya'o// a gra paṇ+ḍi a shi bh+yaḥswāhā/ zhes pas phud kyi changs bu sbyin par bya'o// oṃ āḥhū?m̐ gis byin gyis brlabs te/

dang po mthe bong dang srin lag gis reg par bya'o// lhag ma'i zas la oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa biṇ+ḍa a shi bh+yaḥswāhā/ zhes pas lhag ma sbyin par bya'o// lhag ma byin gyis ma brlabs pa rnams ni yongs su dor bar bya'o// de yang*/ gtor ma btang zhing bshos gtsang dbul// 'phrog ma dang po'i changs bu dang*// lnga pa lhag mas btang bas te/ 'bras bu longs spyod chen por 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// rgyal po dang ni yon bdag dang*// sems can phung po gzhan dag kyang*// tshe (970) ring nad med phun sum tshogs// rtag tu bde ba thob par shog /ces lan gsum brjod par bya'o// zhes pa dang*/ dge bsnyen sgra bshad nye bar zhi bas dge bsnyen te/ u sems can rnams la nye bar phan 'dogs pa'o// pa rtag tu sdig pa spong bar byed pa'o// si sgro btags pa'i rtog pa las grol ba'o// ka snying rjes yongs su skyong pa nyid do// zhes bshad do// a bh+ya'i byang chub gzhung lam du'ang*/ las dang po'i chos spyod kyi rim pa rgyas par 'byung ngo*// jo bo rje'i spyod bsdus sgron mar/ de nas zas kyi dus rtag tu// snying po med pa'i lus 'di yis// snying po'i dam pa btsal bya zhes// lus la gru yi blo bzhag la// rgyags pa bskyed phyir mi za'o// ro la chags pas mi za'o// zas ni bzhi char bgo bya ste// dang po lha la bshos (971) gtsang dbul// de rjes chos kyi srung ma la// gtor ma shin tu rgya chen btang*// rang gis zos shing 'thungs pa yi// lhag ma 'byung po kun la sbyin// bar skabs der yang bsgrung brgyud dang*// ngo mtshar can gyi gtam yang byas// de nas langs la cung zhig bcag /yang na rten la bskor bas bya// bzlas brjod glegs bam bklag pa'am// yang na bde gshegs gzugs brnyan bya// ji srid rdul ni ma byung bas// de srid bskor ba ma yengs par// byas la smon lam rgya chen gdab// ces sogs gsungs pa ltar bslab par bya'o// so so'i skye bos yon sbyang bar dka' bas sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i gzungs sngags bzlas pas sbyang bar bya ste/

na maḥs man+ta pra bhā rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samya ka saṃ (972) bu d+dhā ya/ na mo mañdzu shrī ku mā ra bhū ta ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ mahā satwa ya/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ni rā lam+bhe ni rā bhā s+ya/ dza ye dza ye/ lam+bhe lam+bhe ma hā ma te/ dak+ṣe dak+ṣe ṇaṃ pa ri sho dha ya swāhā/ na mo bha ga wa te su med ru kālpa rā dza ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha/ ta d+ya thā/ oṃ kal pe kal pe mahā kal pe kal pa pa ri sho dha ye swāhā/ yon gyi phung po ri rab tsam yang byang ba dang*/ sbyin bdag gi 'byor pa dang dge ba rgya chen po 'phel bar 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas kyi slob ma rnams kyis chos sgrub pa'i 'tsho ba klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bos sbyor bar dam bcas shing*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ de gnyis kyi ming smos pa'i yon bshad par gsungs pas/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bos gtso byas pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag (973) po rnams kyis sbyin pa dam pa sems kyi rgyan du gyur cig sems kyi yo byad/ rnal 'byor gyi tshogs/ don gyi mchog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig ces brjod par bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ gang zhig sangs rgyas gsungs pa yi// lha bshos changs bu mi byed par// ma gsungs pa yi 'brang rgyas dang*// gru gsum la sogs byed pa mthong*// zhes pa/ lag len mig sngar gang bab la yid ches shing*/ khungs nas byung ba yin ma yin mi shes pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig chos dang mthun pa'i lha bshos dang changs bu bya sla ba de mi byed par 'brang rgyas bzo dka' ba dang lha bshos rtse mo gru gsum la sogs byed pa ni bon gyi lag len 'dres pa yin no// lnga pa ni/ gsang sngags rnying ma 'ga' zhig la// gru (974) gsum dbang phyug chen po'i snying*// de yi sha dang khrag gis brgyan// mtheb kyu mgo bo'i thod pas bskor// chang sogs bdud rtsis de bkang la// he ru ka la mchod ces zer// zhes pa/

snga 'gyur bar grags pa'i sngags pa 'ga' zhig gtor ma'i dbyibs gru gsum mahā de ba'i snying gi gzugs su byas nas de'i mgo'i gzugs kyi mtheb kyus bskor ba la sha khrag dang chang la sogs pas bran te dpal chen he ru ka la mchod par 'bul zhes zer na'ang*/ de ltar byed pa'i khungs yid ches pa yod med brtag par bya'o// gsang sngags gsar mar gru gsum gyi// gtor ma gzhung nas bshad pa med// zas kyi phud la khyad par du// gru gsum 'bul bar gsungs pa med// ces pa/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs la sogs gang na'ang lha bshos dang (975) gtor ma'i gzugs de ltar byed par ma gsungs shing*/ zas kyi phud la gru gsum la sogs dbyibs kyi rnam pa ched du bzos nas 'bul bar gsungs pa med pa'i phyir/ bya dka' zhing chos dang mi mthun pa'i lag len mi bya'o// skye bo la la zas kyi phud la bshos bu gru gsum dang rtse mo ring po dang dud 'gro'i gzugs bcos nas 'bul ba ni bon gyi rjes su zhugs pa yin no// gnyis pa ma nor bar blang byar gdam pa ni/ lag len thams cad sangs rgyas kyi// gsung dang mthun par bstan pa yin// des na mdo sde ma dkrugs par// sangs rgyas gsung bzhin nyams su longs// zhes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i gang zag gis so sor thar pa dang byang sems dang gsang sngags kyi cho ga dang dkon mchog (976) gsum mchod pa bkod pa dang*/ gtor ma'i lag len rang rang gi theg pa'i gzhung lugs las gsungs pa de ma bcos slad ma zhugs par ci nus su bsgrubs na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la slob pa yin no// de'i phyir mdo rgyud theg pa gong 'og ma dkrugs par nyams su longs shig gnyis pa la gsum/ nor tshul brjod pa/ de dgag pa/ dgongs pa bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba yi// phyag tu mtshon cha bskur ba mthong*// khyim pa'i cha lugs can dag la// rgyan dang cha lugs sogs srid kyi// rab byung rnams la 'di mi srid// byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya sogs// mdzad pa'i rigs lnga ser 'byams mthong*// mdo lugs yin zhes la la smra// zhes pa/

'phags pa klub kyis mdzad zer ba'i ltung bshags (977) kyi sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga'i mngon rtogs la rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs phyag tu ral gri dang go cha 'dzin pa byas pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs la mi mgo'i phreng ba dang*/ stag gi spags pas dkris pa dang*/ yum dang 'khril sbyor byed pa'ang mi 'thad de/ gdul bya'i blo ngor gang la gang 'dul gyi bkod pa ston pa yin na'ang*/ khyim pa'i gzugs kyis 'dul na de la rgyan dang mtshon cha 'dzin pa 'jig rten pa'i lugs dang mthun pas dbu skra dpyang lo dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan dang na bza' kha dog sna tshogs dang*/ phyag mtshan ral gri dang mdung thung la sogs mtshon cha 'dzin pa'i bkod pa ston pa yin la/ rab byung de 'dra'i cha lugs 'chang ba dang*/ bud med dang sbyor ba ni 'jig rten pa rnams kyis smod cing mi dad pa'i (978) rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro// bka' gdams 'ga' zhig jo bo rjes sangs rgyas mang po'i zhal gzigs pas thams cad gser btso ma'i kha dog can du 'dug gsung ba de rgyu mtshan du byas nas rigs lnga ser 'byam gyi ras bris mdo lugs yin zhes 'dod do// gnyis pa ni/ mdo nas 'di 'dri gsungs pa med// bya spyod gnyis kyi rgyud las ni// sangs rgyas rigs lngar bsdus pa med// rnal 'byor rgyud las gsungs pa yi// rigs lnga kha dog tha dad cing*// phyag rgya yang ni tha dad gsungs// zhes pa/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ltar mdzad pa'i sku mdog ser 'byams 'di 'dra pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo sde nas gsungs pa med cing*/ gser 'od dam par/ sangs rgyas thams cad kha dog mtshungs// 'di ni sangs rgyas chos nyid yin// zhes (979) gsungs pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan du/ sa bcu pa man chad kyi rgyal sras rnams thugs rgyud tha dad cing spangs rtogs yon tan gyi khyad par kyang tha dad par gsungs nas sangs rgyas kyi sar kha dog gcig tu 'dres shing*/

sku gsum 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i yon tan thams cad kyang gcig tu 'dres pas gdul bya gcig tu 'dul ba'i mdzad pa de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las yin te/ de bzhin zag med dbyings 'di ni// sangs rgyas dpag tu med 'dres shing*// mdzad pa gcig ni mdzad pa la'ang*// thams cad mdzad pa snang bar 'dod// ces chu klung rnams rgya mtsho chen por ma slebs kyi bar tha dad cing rgya mtshor phyin nas ba tsha can gyi chur ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i dpes mtshon te gsungs pa'i don de yin no// rgyud sde bzhi'i bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud las/ (980) sangs rgyas rnams rigs lngar bsdus pa'i gsal kha btod pa med cing*/ 'grel pa rnams su sku'i rigs kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ gtso bo 'jam dpal dang*/ lha mo sangs rgyas can dang*/ khro bo gshin rje gshed dang*/ gsung gi rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ gtso bo spyan ras gzigs dang*/ lha mo gos dkar mo dang*/ khro bo rta mgrin dang*/ thugs kyi rigs bdag mi bskyod pa dang*/ gtso bo phyag na rdo rje dang*/ lha mo mā ma ki dang*/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang*/ de rnams kyi pho nya dang bran gyi rigs rang rang gi las tshogs sgrub tshul dang*/ bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyang rigs gsum du phye nas 'dul byed kyi gnyen po'i lha yang dmigs gsal dang bcas pa bshad cing*/ lo chen rin chen bzang pos kyang de bzhin du mdzad do// rnal (981) 'byor rgyud du/ gtso bo sangs rgyas rigs lngar gsungs shing rigs drug pa'i tha snyad med do// rigs lnga re re'ang sku mdog phyag rgya dang phyag mtshan tha dad du gsungs shing*/ 'di yi sku mdog phyag rgya ni// rten cing 'brel 'byung sku yin pas// ye shes lnga la 'thad pa yin// dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs las// rigs lnga kha dog gzhan gsungs pa// 'byung ba rnam pa lnga sbyong ba'i// rten cing 'brel 'byung sku yin no// zhes pa/

sbyang gzhi phung po lnga dang*/ sbyang bya nyon mongs lnga dang*/ sbyangs 'bras rigs lnga ye shes lnga dang*/ dag bya dang byed sbyang gzhi sbyang 'bras rten 'brel zab mo mtshon byed kyi sku yin pas sangs rgyas rnams dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can dang*/ mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon gyi phyag rgya dang (982) rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ snang ba mtha' yas dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can dang*/ don yod grub pa sngo ljang skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can dang*/ phyag mtshan kyang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje gsungs pa yin no// dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud du don yod grub pa nag po dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po dang*/ 'od dpag med dkar po dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad ser po dang*/ mi bskyod pa ljang khur gsungs pa ni/ rlung dang me dang chu dang sa dang nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa'i yon tan dang*/ ye shes dang yan lag drug nyams su len pa'i tshul la sogs pa phyi nang mchog gsum gyi rten 'brel zab mo mtshon byed yin te/ rgyud de nyid las shes par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas gser mdog ces gsungs pa// dri ma med cing dwangs pa'am// (983) sprul sku phal la dgongs te gsungs// gzhan du sman bla nam mkha'i mdog /sngon po nyid du mdo las gsungs// zhes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi tshan pags pa gser gyi mdog ces gsungs pa ni/ gser shin tu sbyangs shing g.ya' dang dri mas dag pa'i mdog ltar dwangs shing dri ma med pa la gsungs pa yin la/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sogs sprul sku ser po yod pa la'ang sbyar du rung ngo*// rnam pa thams cad du sku mdog ser por 'dod na/ bcom ldan 'das sman bla bai ḍūr+ya sngon po'i mdog lta bu dang*/ 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po pad+ma rwa ga'i mdog lta bu dang*/

klu dbang rgyal po zhal dkar cing sku lus sngon por gsungs pa'i phyir de dag la mtshan ma tshang ba'i nyes par 'gyur ro// yi dam lha yi sgrub thabs (984) dang*// sngags kyi bzlas pa'i cho ga dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kyi// sgrub pa'i cho ga ji snyed pa// mdo sde kun las gsungs pa med// ces pa/ lha 'jam dbyangs dang*/ sgrol ma la sogs sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs can gyi mngon rtogs bsgoms nas snying po'i sngags bzlos pa'i sgrub thabs zhib mo dang*/ de la brten nas zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i phrin las byed pa dang*/ mi snang ba dang sa 'og gi gter mthong ba la sogs pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub dang*/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i sde snod las ma gsungs shing*/ bsam gtan gyi sems la mnyam par bzhag nas rnam gnas yid la byas pas rdzu 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa sgrub pa'i thabs rgya chen po gsungs so// gsum pa (985) ni/ deng sang sngags la mi mos par// lha sgom la sogs byed pa yang*// sangs rgyas bstan dang mthun pa min// gzhan yang sbyin sreg ro bsreg dang*// bdun tshigs sats+tsha'i cho ga sogs// deng sang gsang sngags lugs bor nas// mdo mchod tsam la rten pa yi// cho ga'i rnam bzhag byed pa yod// ces pa/ gsang sngags la mi mos pa'i gang zag bram ze'i chos lugs gtsang ma byed par 'dod pa'i nyams len lha sgom zhing sngags bzlos pa'i lugs yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mdo rgyud gang dang yang mi mthun no// rang tshig 'gal ba'i mthun dpe kho bo'i ma mo bsham mo zhes pa dang 'dra'o// gzhan yang sbyin bsreg dang ro bsreg dang bdun tshigs dang sats+tsha 'debs pa'i lag len rnams rgyud nas bshad pa'i cho ga

(986) bor nas mdo mchod kyi cho ga byed pa yod na'ang*/ pha rol phyin pa'i mdo sde dang*// bstan bcos kun la gsungs pa med// 'di na ngan song sbyong rgyud la// sogs pa'i rgyud sde 'ga' zhig las// gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brang ba yi// gsang sngags pa la grags pa yin// zhes pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i bka' bstan bcos rnams nas de 'dra'i cho ga gsal bar gsungs pa med cing*/ rgyud nas bshad pa'i cho ga yin na/ mdo mchod kyi don med do// jo bo rjes pha rol tu phyin pa'i sats+tsha gdab pa'i cho ga mdzad pa ni/ 'jin pa byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod nas byams pa dang snying rje'i sems kyis brdung pa dang 'bi 'bi byas te sngags de nyid brjod cing 'og min na bzhugs pa'i rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal bar mos nas rten 'brel (987) snying po'i sngags bzlas shing btab ste 'bru 'am me tog la rten 'brel gyi sngags bzlas te phul nas/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// ces sogs bsngo ba byed par gsungs so// 'di tsam la nyes pa med de/ bslab btus su/ lha sgom pa dang ma 'brel ba'i yi ge brgya pa'i sngags dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i snying po dang*/ 'od zer can gyi gzungs sngags bzlos pa la sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'dul ba lung las/ rma bya chen mo'i rigs sngags dang*/ yangs pa can du rims nad sel ba'i gzungs sngags gsungs so// sbyong rgyud las/ gshin po sdig pa sbyong ba'i bdun tshigs dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ bum pa'i khrus chog dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud du/ ngan 'gro bkug nas sngags dang phyag rgyas ngan 'gro'i (988) gnas las 'dren pa dang*/ nag po pa'i ro bsreg gi cho ga la sogs pa gsang sngags kyi lugs yin no// bzhi pa la gnyis las/ dang po 'dod lugs brjod pa ni// de bzhin rab gnas mdo lugs dang*// phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs dang*// ltung bshags dang ni sher snying sogs// sngags lugs yin zhes 'chad pa thos// zhes pa/

bka' gdams pa rnams mdo lugs kyi rab gnas byed pa dang*/ sgom chen pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rab gnas byed pa dang*/ phyag na rdo rje 'phags pa klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i gos sngon can du grags pa dang*/ byang chub ltung bshags dang*/ shes rab snying po gsang sngags lugs su 'chad pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs la brten nas 'dod par snang bas/ de klu sgrub kyi gsung (989) e yin brtag dgos par snang ngo*// gnyis pa 'dres pa so sor dbye ba la gsum/ phye bsal rgyas par bshad pa/ 'gag bsdus te bstan pa dang 'gal ba dgag phye bsal las 'phros pa'i gsal byed do// dang po la bzhi/ rab gnas kyi phye bsal/ lha sgom pa'i phye bsal/ shes nas blang dor byed tshul/ gsang sngags rang lugs kyi lag len no// dang po ni/ 'di yang brtag par bya bas nyon// mdo nas rab gnas bshad pa med// 'on kyang mchod bstod bkra shis sogs// rgyal po'i mnga' dbul lta bu la// rab gnas yin zhes smra na smros// zhes pa/ mdo las sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i rab gnas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bcug nas spyan dbye ba la sogs pa'i cho ga (990) gsum pa med cing*/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyis byin gyis rlob pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ mdo las gsungs pa'i/ me tog phal cher me tog bla re dang*// zhes sogs kyi mchod 'bul dang*/ rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// zhes sogs kyi bstod pa dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// zhes sogs kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod nas phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel sgrig pa/ rgyal po rgyal sar bkod pa la mnga' dbul byed pa lta bu la/ rab gnas yin no zhes smras na 'gal ba med do// lha sgom pa dang sngags bzlas dang*// bum pa lha yi sta gon dang*// dngos gzhi'i dam tshig sems dpa' dang*// ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug dang*// spyan dbye brtan par bzhugs pa

(991) dang*// zhes pa/ rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rab gnas la thog mar bdag nyid lhar bsgoms nas sngags bzlas pa dang*/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du bum pa dang lha'i sta gon dang*/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten la bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ dri ma bkru ba la sogs pa'i sta gon dang*/ lha la snyan gsan dbab pa la sogs pa sbyor ba'i cho ga dang*/ dngos gzhi slob dpon lhar bsgoms nas sngags bzlas pa dang*/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ rten dam tshig par bskyed nas ye shes pa bcug ste sku gsung thugs rgyas gdab pa dang*/ rgyud gang la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i tshul bzhin du/ dkyil 'khor du dbang dngos gzhi bskur ba dang spyan dbye ba dang brtan par bzhugs (992) pa'i gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ spyi dang khyad par gyi mnga' dbul ba dang*/ sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yi// me tog dor nas legs mchod de// bkra shis rgyas par byed pa yi// cho ga gsang sngags rgyud sde las// gsungs kyis pha rol phyin la min// la la gdams ngag yin zhes smra// 'o na mdo sde gang dag la// brten pa yin pa smra dgos so// zhes pa/ sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog dor na rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi bdag nyid du legs par bsgrubs te/ bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel rgyas par byed pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde dang*/ mkhas pa'i bstan bcos las gsungs shing*/ de dag gi don dang go rim nyams su blang ba'i rnam gzhag lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa (993) ltar byed pa ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bya ba khyad par can yin no// snyan gsan 'bebs pa rten gyi lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha gang la byed dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i tshe rten gyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/
