gsum pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi kyang*// bdud dang mu stegs sun phyung ba// de yang phrag dog nyid 'gyur ram// zhes pa/ thub pa chen pos bdud sdig can 'khor dang bcas pa byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang cho 'phrul gyis btul cing*/ bdud kyi 'khor mang (1534) po rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par mdzad pa dang*/ 'od srungs rdzogs byed la sogs pa mu stegs kyi ston pa chen por rlom pa rnams skye dgu'i tshogs mang po 'dus pa'i dbus su dma' phab cing*/ de'i phyogs kyi 'gro ba mang po yang dag pa'i lam la bkod nas dad par byas pa de'ang phrag dog gis byas pa yin nam legs par soms shig bzhi pa ni/ mkhas rnams blun po'i long khrid yin// nor pa'i chos dang ma nor pa'i// long khrid legs par bshad pa la// sdang zhes smra na da slan chad// sangs rgyas bstan pa ji ltar bsrung*// long khrid rnams kyi long ba la// g.yang sa bkag cing bzang po ru// 'khrid pa'ang phrag dog yin nam ci// 'o na long ba ji ltar dkri// zhes pa/ chos rnams kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid la phyin ci ma log par (1535) lta ba'i blo gros kyi mig rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam du 'jug par 'dod kyang*/ lam dang lam ma yin pa mi shes pa'i long ba rnams yang dag pa'i lam du 'khrid pa'i phyir lam log pa las phyir zlog pa de yang long ba la zhe sdang pa yin nam/ de ltar yin na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i bya ba ji ltar byed/ long ba rnams g.yang sar 'gro ba phyir bzlog pa nyes pa yin na mig bus long ba ji ltar dkri/ g.yang sar mchong ba yin na long khrid kyis dgos pa ci yod soms shig lnga pa ni/ nad pa la ni gnod pa yi// kha zas spongs shig phan pa bsten// de skad sman pas smras na yang*// sdang dang phrag dog 'gyur na ni// 'o na nad pa ji ltar gso// zhes pa/

sman (1536) pa mkhas pas nad pa za bar 'dod pa'i bza' btung 'gog cing*/ nad 'joms pa'i sman ro mi zhim pa mi 'dod bzhin du ster ba dang*/ sdug bsngal cung zad bskyed pa'i gtar sreg gis dpyad byed pa'ang phrag dog dang zhe sdang gis byas sam zhes zer ram/ 'o na sman pa mkhas pas ji ltar bya ba yang soms shig drug pa ni/ chos log pa dang ma log pa'i// rnam par dbye ba byas pa la// sdang dang phrag dog yin zer na// 'o na 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// sems can rnams ni ji ltar bsgral// ces pa/ bstan 'dzin mkhas pas chos nor ma nor gtan la phab nas lung rigs rnam dag gis nor pa sun phyung ba la zhe sdang dang phrag dog gis byas so zhes sgrogs na/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyis gdul bya 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral ba'i rjes su zhugs nas sems can (1537) 'khor ba las bsgral ba'i spyod pa la'ang ji ltar bslab par bya gzhan don byed tshul ni lam log pa las skyabs de ma nor ba la 'god pa yin pa'i phyir ro// bdun pa ni/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon pa dang*// mkhas rnams bshad pa byed pa la// 'bras bu rnam gsum 'byung ba 'di// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi lugs yin// zhes pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang rgyal sras 'phags pa gdul bya'i don du rgyal rigs la sogs par 'khrungs pa dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mkhas pas chos dang chos ma yin pa rnams par phye nas skye bo mang po 'dus pa'i dbus su legs par bshad pa la ni/ chos log sun phyung nas nub par 'gyur ba dang*/ nag po'i phyogs kyi bdud sdig can yid khong du chud de dpa' kong bar (1538) 'gyur ba dang*/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi lha rnams dang mkhas pa rnams dga' ba bskyed pa ste/ phan yon rnam pa gsum 'byung ba 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi'i lugs rten 'brel gyi che ba yin no// brgyad pa la gnyis/ bdud bcom nas lha mi dbugs phyung tshul/

de las log pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod tshul lo// dang po ni/ ma khol gyis kyang 'di skad gsungs// dpa' bo khyod kyi bstan pa ni// mu stegs thams cad skrag mdzad cing*// bdud ni sems khong chud mdzad la// lha dang mi rnams dbugs kyang 'byin// zhes gsungs zhes pa/ bdud bzhi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' bo sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can gyi tshar gcod dang rjes su 'dzin pa'i mdzad pa ni/ mu stegs byed la gcer bu pa bden smra lta bu (1539) rgyal sras 'phags pa gdul bya'i snang ngor mu stegs kyi ston pa'i tshul bzung nas de'i rigs can gyi gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang dag pa'i lam du 'khrid pa dang*/ thub pa'i sku skye ba snga mar mu stegs kyi drang srong rnga bong du 'khrungs te/ nyi zla gza' skar la sogs 'jig rten pa'i don mdzad pa dang*/ drang srong sngo sangs su 'khrungs nas phyi rol pa'i drang srong mngon shes kyis nga rgyal du byed pa btul ba dang*/ gnas gtsang ma'i lhas mu stegs kyi drang srong du sprul nas ma 'ongs ba'i dus su shākya'i rigs zas gtsang gi sras don grub ces bya ba shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro// zhes mdzad pa bcu gnyis gsal bar ston pa'i rig byed bstan pa lta bu sprul pa'i mu stegs byed ma gtogs pa lta spyod log pa dag skrag pa dang*/ bdud

(1540) sdig can rang gnas su mya ngan byed cing*/ 'khor rnams kyi glu dbyangs dang sil snyan dkrol ba'i tshe/ sgra ma byed ces zer cing yi mug par gyur pa dang*/ dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams me tog gi char 'bebs shing a la la zhes ga zha'i sgra sgrog pa dang*/ 'khor rnam bzhi la sogs pa mi rnams dga' bas dbugs phyin pa'i rjes 'dzin gyi phrin las mnga' bar slob dpon dpa' bo'i bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las gsungs pa ltar ro// deng sang 'di na yang*/ mkhas pa rnams kyis chos bshad na// chos log spyod pa pham byed cing*// bdud rigs thams cad yi mug 'gyur// mkhas pa thams cad dga' bar byed// 'di 'dras bstan pa 'dzin nus 'gyur// zhes pa/ bod yul 'dir yang dam pa'i chos ma nor bar bshad cing*/ nor pa sun phyung bas bstan pa bshig (1541) pa'i skye bo ngan pa rnams pham par byed pa dang*/ nag po'i phyogs kyi 'byung po skye bo ngan pa'i rgyud byin gyis rlob pa rnams yi mug par 'gyur ba dang*/ dkar phyogs kyi lha dang mkhas pa rnams dga' bar byed pa'i rnam thar bzang po 'di lta bus thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel bar byed pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ 'di las bzlog pa byung 'gyur na// bstan la gnod par shes par gyis// zhes pa/ bstan pa 'dzin tshul 'di las phyir log nas chos ldan sun phyung zhing chos min 'phel bar 'gyur na phan yon gsum yang mi 'byung bar chos bzhin byed pa pham pa dang*/ nag po'i phyogs kyi 'byung po yid bde ba dang*/ dkar phyogs kyi lha dang mkhas pa rnams khong du chud par 'gyur te/ 'dzam bu gling gi bstan pa nyams pa'i tshul dang (1542) rab tu byung ba'i spyod tshul ma rungs pa mthong nas rgyal po chen po bzhi gdong ri rab la nang du phyogs te/ shākya seng ge zhes mtshan nas 'bod cing smre sngags 'don pa dang mchi ma 'byin par 'gyur cing lha ma yin rnams gzengs stod de lha rnams kyi gnas su 'ongs nas mtho 'tshams par byed do// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la lnga/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gces spras ji ltar byas tshul/ lhag bsam bzang pos bstan bcos rnam dag brtsams tshul/ 'phags pa'i yul du nor pa gzhan gyis bkag tshul/ bod yul du 'khrul pa gsar du byung pa bkag tshul/ gsang sngags zab mo gsang dgos yin pas sbas tshul lo// dang po ni/ bdag kyang rdo rje phag mo yi// byin brlabs tsam re byas pa la// dkar po gcig thub bstan nas kyang*// myong ba cung zad skyes pa la// (1543) mthong lam du ni ngo sprad nas// rtsol sgrub med pa'i don bstan na// 'tshogs pa'ang 'di bas mang ba 'du// longs spyod 'bul ba'ang mang bar 'gyur// ces pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta bdag gis kyang chos sgo 'byed pa la phag mo'i byin brlabs re tsam byas nas thabs snying rje chen po dang las rgyu 'bras gtang snyoms su bzhag ste man ngag stong rkyang bstan nas snang ba 'gags pa'i sems kyi 'char sgo gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug dang 'dra ba'i myong ba skyes pa la theg pa chen po'i mthong lam thob par ngo sprod nas lus ngag gi chos spyod byed rgyu med pa'i spyod lam bstan na 'khor kyang shin tu mang po 'dus shing*/ zang zing longs spyod kyi 'bul ba'ang rgya chen po 'byung bar shes so// blun po rnams kyi bsam pa la// sangs rgyas lta bur mos pa skye// chos kyi gnad rnams mi shes (1544) pa'i// sde snod 'dzin par rlom pa yang*// de la lhag par dad par 'gyur// bdag gis legs par go mod kyis// 'khor dang zang zing sgrub pa'i phyir// bdag gis sems can bsdus pa min// zhes pa/ gzhung lugs la thog ma nas ma sbyangs pa'i blun po chos dad che ba rnams dang*/ sde snod la yun ring du sbyangs kyang bden pa gnyis kyi rang bzhin legs par ma go ba'i mkhas par rlom pa dag kho bos chos kyi rnam grangs sna tshogs pa bsdus nas bshad na/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas dngos yin no zhes dad pa lhag par skyes te snyan grags dang*/

rnyed bkur bshes gnyen gzhan las ches lhag par 'byung bar shes so// 'on kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ma bsams par skye ba phyi ma'i las kyi rnam smin kyang khyad du bsad de tshe 'di'i 'khor dang zang zing mang du sgrub pa'i phyir slob ma (1545) bsdus chos bstan pa ma yin no// gnyis pa ni/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa la// phan par bsams nas bshad pa yin// sangs rgyas bstan pa bzhin bsgrubs na// sangs rgyas bstan la phan par bsams// zhes pa/ bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin las/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' gang byang chub tu sems bskyed nas byang chub sems dpar dam bcas te/ bdag sangs rgyas su gyur cig ces smras la/ de yang thos pas 'tshol ba la yongs su mi brtson na/ sems can thams cad shes rab 'chal par bya ba la zhugs pa yin no// rigs kyi bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' chen po thos pa tshol ba la yongs su brtson par byed na des ni sems can thams cad kyi shes rab yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i (1546) phyir nye bar bstan pa yin no// zhes pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'i chos bzhi sgrub par/ bdud las thams cad shes par 'dod pas brtson 'grus brtsam par bya/ tshig gtso bor bzung bar mi bya/ mkhas pa'i bya ba shes par bya/ 'jig rten thams cad la grags pa'i bya ba yang shes par bya'o// zhes pa dang*/ de la dam pa'i chos shes pa gang zhe na/ gang de rnams tshul bzhin sgrub par byed kyi log par mi sgrub pa yin te/ sbyin pa dang dul ba dang yang dag par sdom pa ni chos shes pa zhes bya'o// zhes pa ltar thub pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas pa dang rgyas par bya ba'i phyir sde snod bshad cing*/ bstan bcos 'di yang dgos pa de sgrub pa'i phyir brtsams pa yin no// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa ni/ bstan 'dzin (1547) gyi skyes bu bshad cing sgrub bzhin du byed pa la rag las shing*/

de yang bshad bya'i chos la rag las par bsams so// de'i phyir 'phags pa zhi ba lhas kyang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu// bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bsti dang*// bcas te yun rings gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ mu stegs byed dang nyan thos dang*// theg pa chen po 'ga' zhig la'ang*// 'khrul pa yod mod mkhas rnams kyis// sun phyung phyir na 'dir ma bstan// zhes pa/ mu stegs rtog ge sde lnga dang*/ bsam gtan pa gsang ba pa dang*/ de gnyis su ma 'dus pa'i nges brjod dang*/ sring srung dang*/ mchod sbyin dang*/ gza' skar mi dpyad smra ba la sogs pa dang*/ nyan thos rdul (1548) phran bden par 'dod pa dang*/ dus gsum rdzas su grub pa dang*/ ldan min 'du byed rdzas grub kyi bem po khas len pa dang*/ sems tsam pa gnyis med kyi rang rig bden par 'dod pa dang*/ dbu ma pa la'ang gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i gtan tshigs kyi kun rdzob snang tsam 'gog pa dang*/ sangs rgyas la ye shes med pa la sogs 'khrul pa du ma yod mod kyi de dag 'phags pa'i yul du bstan pa'i gsal byed du 'byung bar thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyis lung bstan pa'i mkhas grub rgyan drug la sogs pa'i bstan bcos rnams su grub mtha'i rim pa dang theg pa'i mtho dman dang 'tsham par sun phyung zhing nor pa'i rang lugs gsal bar bkod zin pas/ sngon chad ma byung ba yang 'dir brjod min// zhes gsungs pa ltar bstan bcos 'dir ma bkod do// bzhi pa ni/ deng sang (1549) gangs ri'i khrod 'di na// rigs pas sgrub par mi nus shing*// sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gal ba yi// 'khrul pa gsar pa du ma byung*// rdo rje theg pa'i gnad 'phyugs pas// rgyud sde rnams dang grub thob kyi// dgongs pa rnams dang 'gal ba'i gnad// dpag med yod med gsang sngags nyid// yin phyir kho bos gzhan du bshad// ces pa/

kha ba can gyi yul ljongs 'di na mngon sum dang rjes dpag gi rigs pas ma grub cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mdo rgyud rnam dag dang 'gal ba'i grub mtha' nor pa dang*/ lta spyod 'khrul pa rang bzor sbyar ba mang du 'byung zhing*/ khyad par gsang sngags kyi dbang dang rim gnyis kyi gnad 'gag rgyud sde bzhi dang grub thob kyi dgongs pa dang mi mthun pa brjod kyis mi lang pa byung pa rnams zhib (1550) tu smos nas lung rigs kyis sun 'byin par rigs mod kyi/ 'on kyang dbang dang lam dang 'bras bu'i ngos 'dzin gsal bar smras na snod min la gsang ba bsgrag par mi bya'o// zhes rdo rje 'chang gis bkag pa la spyad pa'i ltung bar 'gyur pa'i phyir 'dir ma bkod la/ dga' ba bzhi dang 'pho ba bcu drug dang dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa'i ngos 'dzin gzhan du bstan pa las shes par bya'o// lnga pa ni/ 'di ni kun la bshad rung ba'i// 'khrul pa rags rim ci rigs pa// 'phel na bstan la gnod mthong nas// che longs tsam zhig bshad pa yin// zhes pa/ bstan bcos 'dir ni gsang sngags kyi sbas pa'i tshul dang*/ mthar thug pa'i tshul dang*/ ldem dgongs dang*/ sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa dang*/ nges pa'i (1551) don la log par rtog tshul sun phyung nas shin tu gsal bar bkod na/ snod ldan gyi gdul bya 'ga' zhig la phan pa srid mod kyi phal cher pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi bden pa gnyis zung 'jug tsam yang bstan pa'i snod du mi rung na/ rdo rje theg pa'i gsang chen zab mo'i snod du rung ba lta ci smos/ kho bos zab mo'i chos la ser sna'i dbang gis dpe 'khyud byas pa ni ma yin no// sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la log par rtog pa'i bshad sgrub 'phel na thub pa'i bstan pa la gnod par mthong nas sgra don nor pa'i cha sun 'byin pa'i bshad pa kun gyi thos su rung ba che long tsam bkod pa yin no// gsum pa ni/

da dung 'khrul pa'i rnam bzhag ni// skyon can dpag med snang na yang*// gzhung mangs dogs pas re shig bzhag / (1552) gal te lung dang rigs pa'i gnad// shes pa'i blo ldan rnams kyis de// legs par spyod la dgag sgrub gyis// zhes pa/ thub pa'i bstan pa la nor par dpyod pa bstan bcos 'dir dgag pa de tsam du ma zad kyis/ tshig don la 'khrul pa'i skyon chags pa mang po skye bo 'dus pa'i dbus su gsal bar smos nas lung rigs kyis dgag par 'os pa 'dug na'ang*/ bstan bcos kyi gzhung yi ge mang na blo gros chung ba dag skrag par 'gyur bas ma bkod do// phyin chad bka' bstan bcos rnam par dag pa'i lung dang*/ rig pa bzhi'i gnad ma nor bar shes pa'i blo ldan rnams kyis kun mkhyen gyi gsung dang mthun mi mthun/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam yin ma yin legs par dpyod la nor pa dgag pa dang*/ ma nor ba sgrub pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bya ba yin pas (1553) legs par bsgrubs shig sangs rgyas bstan dang 'phrad dka' zhing*// dal ba 'byor pa'ang rnyed dka' bas// mkhas pa rnams kyis legs rtogs la// gzu bor gnas pa'i blo yi dpyod// ces pa/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'byung ba'ang rgya lam ste// mi yi lus ni tshegs kyis rnyed pa min// kyai ma dad pa dang ni chos ldan pa// 'di 'dra bskal pa brgyar yang rnyed par dka'// zhes gsungs pa bzhin sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal ba la sogs rang gzhan gyi 'byor pa bcu dang*/ ngan song las thar pa la sogs dal ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i phyir dang*/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa rgyal ba sras bcas la bla na med pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyal sras kyi smon lam (1554) chen po ji snyed pa thams cad dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i nang du 'dus par gsungs pa'i phyir/ gau ta ma'i bstan pa la zhugs shing de'i gsung rab la bslabs pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis so sor rtog pa'i blo gros phyogs su ma lhung ba'i drang pos dpyod la bstan pa'i byi dor yang dag pa mdzod cig

ces pas ma 'ongs pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams la gdams shing bskul ba'o// //bstan bcos 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo sdom pa gsum nges 'byung gi tshul khrims yin pas rgyu'i kun slong la nges 'byung gi bsam pa bskyed dgos te/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes nas spong ba dang*/ thar pa'i phan yon shes nas thob par 'dod pa ni so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i kun slong bzang po yin la/ de nyid gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub 'dod dang 'brel na theg chen gyi (1555) sdom pa'i kun slong rnam dag yin no// des kun nas bslangs te thob pa'i so sor thar pa ni/ rten skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ sdom pa rang gi ngo bo dus ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du yin no// rdul phran 'dus pa'i gzugs kyi phung po dang lus ngag gi las yin cing*/ yid kyi las ma yin pa dang*/ yang*/ 'du byed sems pa yid las su 'dod pa ni nyan thos kyi grub mtha'i dri ma yin pas khas blangs nang 'gal dang don la mi gnas pa'i skyon yod do// mdo sde pa yan chad yid kyi las dge sdig dngos yin cing*/ des kun nas blang ba'i lus ngag gi las btags pa ba yin te/ las sgrub pa'i rigs par/ sems pa kho na lus las yin na/ rnam par g.yengs pa dang*/ sems med pa'i gnas skabs su sdom pa dang sdom pa ma yin pa la sogs (1556) pa ji ltar blta bar bya zhe na/ sems pa'i khyad par gyi bag chags gtong bar byed pa'i rgyus ma bcom pas yod do// khyad par ces smos pas sdom pa dang sdom pa ma yin pa'i rnam par rigs byed dang rig byed ma yin par btag pa kun nas slong ba'i sems pa khyad par du bya ba'i don gyi phyir ro// zhes pa dang*/ yang dag par blangs pa'i sems pa rgyun chags pa dang bcas pa ni sdom pa zhes bstan pa yin no// zhes mngon pa bye brag tu bshad pa las byung ba dang*/ spyod 'jug tu/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las// tshul khrims pha rol yin par bshad// ces pa sdom pa spong sems rgyun chags de nyid 'joms byed kyi nyes pas ma bcos pa'i tshul khrims yin no// sngar nyan thos kyi bsam pas blangs pa'i so thar de phyis gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir ma nyams par

(1557) bsrungs na byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims kyi go chod mod kyi/ 'on kyang tshe 'phos nas gtong ba ni so thar gyi tshul khrims spyi'i rnam bzhag yin la/ theg chen gyi so thar la dmigs gsal ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro// byang chub sems dpa'i so thar la/ thog mar len pa'i cho ga dang*/ srung tshul dang*/ sdom pa gtong ba'i tshul khrims la sogs pa don bdun mdo sde dgongs 'grel du gsungs kyang re re nas gsal bar ma byung ngo*// 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ byang sems sdom pa dang por skye ba'i bsten so thar gyi sdom ldan dgos par gsungs kyang*/ phyis gnas pa'i rten du dgos par ma nges/ tshe 'phos nas skye ba gzhan du sdom pa dang ldan par gsal por gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'phags pa zhi ba lhas/ rtsa ltung byung na

(1558) nyes pa bshags pa'i cho ga gsungs nas sdom pa slar len dgos par gsungs pa mi 'dug mod/ 'on kyang 'phags pa thogs med bzhed pa bzhin rtsa ltung byung na spyod 'jug tu smon 'jug gi cho ga'i tshig gsungs pa bzhin blangs na sdom pa blangs par 'gyur bas bla ma'am rgyal ba sras bcas kyi drung du slar yang len pa 'thad par gsungs so// de yang rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ltung byung na phyis sdom pa len dgos par gsungs pas tshul 'dra bar mngon no// so sor thar pa'i spang bya ni ngan 'gror skye ba'i rgyu nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang ba'i mi dge ba dang*/ de dang dgag bya rigs mthun pa'i bcas pa'i nyes pa rnams chu lon ltar 'gog pa yin cing*/ sdom pa yang 'dod khams kyis bsdus pa'i las dge ba yin no// byang sems sdom pa'i spang bya theg chen sems bskyed dang 'gal ba'i (1559) bsam pa dang*/ des kun nas bslang ba'i lus ngag gi bya ba thams cad dge bar snang yang spang dgos te/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'i nyams su blang bya dge ba rnams/ byang chub sems dpa'i dor bya mi dge bar gsungs shing*/ ye shes rgyas pa'i mdor/ tshul khrims 'chal pa dang log par blta ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdig pa'i grogs po ma yin te/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdig pa'i grogs po yin no// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshul khrims 'chal pa dang logs par lta bas ni byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims gzhig par mi nus/ lta ba gzhig par mi nus/ des na byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims 'chal pa dang*/ log par lta ba dang lhan cig tu gnas par rung (1560) gis/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang lhan cig tu gnas par mi rung ngo*// tshul khrims 'chal pa dang log par lta ba ni bla na med pa'i byang chub las ring du song ba tsam yin la/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni mthar byed pa yin/

gsod par byed pa yin no// de bas na lhan cig tu gnas par mi bya ste/ seng ge dang wa skyes bzhin no// nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas ni bdag nyid la phan par bzhugs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' ni rang dang gzhan gnyis ka la phan par zhugs pa yin no// zhes dang*/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus par/ ba lang rmig rjes kyi chu las nor bu rin po che mi 'byung ngo*// de bzhin du nyan thos kyi tshul khrims la dkon mchog gsum mi 'byung ngo*// zhes pa dang*/ lam shes kyi rgyu ston pa'i skabs kyi mdor/ nyan thos dgra bcom (1561) pa la rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i mthu med de/ 'khor ba'i rgyud kyi mtshams bcad pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ dmyal bar skyes pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i gtan gyi gegs ma yin kyang*/ theg dman gyi myang 'das gtan gyi gegs byed du gsungs pa dang*/ rigs pas kyang shes te/ theg dman ni 'khor 'das la blang dor du shes nas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pas rang don du spong bar byed de/ myang 'das bsil bar shes nas sgrub pa'i phyir ro// byang chub sems dpa' ni 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du rtogs nas rang don du 'khor ba mi spong thar pa mi 'dod pa'i phyir/ des na theg dman gyi myang 'das lam ring pos dub pa ngal gso ba'i bsti gnas su re shig gnas pa ltar gsungs nas (1562) theg dman dgra bcom rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su lung bstan pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i thabs kyi spyod yul rnam par 'phrul pa'i mdor/ nga yi mya ngan 'das gcig theg pa gcig /nga yi theg pa tha dad med pa ste// yang dag tu ni theg pa gcig tu bstan// da ni thabs kyi yul du shes par gyis// rgyud zhan bsam pa chung ba'i skye bo dag /'bras bu thob pas 'jig par 'gyur srid ces// de dag rnams la theg pa gsum bstan gyis// theg pa gcig ste theg pa gnyis su med// ces pa'i dgongs pa ni/

'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams pa la ltos na/ theg dman dgra bcom yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur bas mthar thug theg pa gcig tu nges pa dang*/ re shig phung po lhag med kyi dbyings su ngal gso ba'i bsti gnas lta bur gsungs pa yin gyis/ thog ma nyid nas (1563) theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs nas sangs rgyas sgrub pa bas nyan rang dgra bcom rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la thag nye bar gsungs pa ni gtan nas ma yin te/ sngar bstan pa'i lung rigs kyis gnod pa'i phyir dang*/ mdo myang 'das las/ sangs rgyas thob pa bul bar rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyal ba byams pas/ de gnyis yang dang yang du ni// rang sems kun tu 'byung ldan pas// mya ngan 'das la mngon dga'i phyir// rtogs pa bul ba yin par 'dod// ces gsungs pas rang don du zhi ba don gnyer dang 'khor ba'i nyes pas 'jigs pa yun ring du goms pa'i phyir gzhan don du 'khor ba'i nyes pas mi skyo bar sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i snying rje chen po nyams su len pa dang shin tu 'gal ba'i phyir ro// chos kun (1564) bsgo ba'i mdor/ 'khor ba ni skyon chags pa'o// mya ngan las 'das pa ni rnam par grol ba'o// snyam du sems pa 'di ni rnam par grol ba ma lags so// de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bdag tu 'dzin pa de ni de ltar du sems pa lags so// zhes gsungs pas srid zhi tha dad du 'dzin pa'i bsam sbyor 'di byang chub sems dpa'i spang bya chos kyi bdag 'dzin yin par sher phyin gyi bka' bstan bcos nas 'bras bu rgyal ba'i yum las ring par gsungs pa yin no// tshul 'di dpal ldan zla ba grags pa dang yang mthun te/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rkyen nyid 'di pa tsam mthong mod kyi/ de lta na yang*/ de dag la chos kyi bdag med pa rdzogs par bsgom pa med de/ khams gsum na spyod pa'i nyon mongs pa spong ba'i thabs tsam zhig

(1565) yod do// gang zag gi bdag med pa ma lus pa sgom pa yod pa rnam par bzhag go /zhes pa dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnam par grol ba'i phyir bstan to// byang chub sems dpa' rnams rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob pas rnam par grol ba'i phyir du gnyis ka bstan to// zhes gsungs so// nye ba 'khor gyis zhus par/ 'khor ba la mi phyogs pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'chal pa'i tshul khrims kyi mchog yin no// 'khor ba yongs su 'dzin pa ni tshul khrims kyi mchog yin no// zhes pa dang*/ dri ma med par grags pas bstan par/ thabs kyis srid pa'i 'gro bar 'gro ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thar pa'o// thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab ni 'ching (1566) ba'o// shes rab dang bral ba'i thabs kyang 'ching ba'o// zhes gsungs pas stong nyid zab mo la goms 'dris byed cing gtso bo thabs snying rje chen po dang ldan pas bsod nams kyi tshogs la 'bad par byed pa ni byang sems las dang po pa'i spyod pa yin no// gsang sngags kyi sdom pa'i spang bya ni/ bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud la byang chub sems dpa'i spang bya dang mtshungs shing*/ de'i steng du rang gi lha'i dam tshig rgyud nas gang gsungs pa de dang 'gal ba yang spang dgos so// rgyud sde gong ma'i sdom pa'i spang bya ni/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ rtsa ltung dang sbom po'i nyes pa shes nas spong dgos shing*/ khyad par dbang bzhi pa'i don nyams su len pa la dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang ma nyams (1567) par bsten pa shin tu gal che'o// sdom pa gsum ka'i spang bya mi dge ba bcu dang*/ blang bya dge ba bcu yin par khyad med cing*/ de dag kyang dgag dgos che chung ma nor bar gong ma'i bslab bya la gzhan don rlabs po cher 'gyur na/ so so thar pa'i bcas pa dang 'gal ba'i srog gcod pa la sogs bya bar gnang ste/

'on kyang rdo rje gdan bzhir/ gzhan gyi sems la gnod byas pas// rnal 'byor sdom pa ring ba nyid// ces pa dang*/ gal te sems can gnod spong bas// mi dga' ba yi tshig mi smra// zhes pa dang*/ 'jigs byed du/ snying rje'i yid ni ma bral na// 'dod pa thams cad 'dir sgrub bya// gzhan du rmongs pa'i byis pa slu// zhes pa dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du/ 'jam dpal khro bo grub pa'i (1568) bram zes drag po'i las sbyor byas pas ngan song dang lha ma yin du skyes te/ sdug bsngal yun ring du myong bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi sems bskyed mi 'gal bar sgrub pa gal che'o// 'ga' zhig da lta gsang sngags sgrub pa'i skabs ma yin pa ni mi 'thad de/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud du/ rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma rgyud du// thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa yang*// rtsod ldan dus su rab tu spyod// dngos grub med par mi lta ste// rdzogs ldan gsum ldan gnyis ldan dang*// rtsod dus la yang bden par 'grub// ces gsungs so// sdom pa gsum ldan gyi gang zag gcig la ngo bo gcig gam tha dad ji ltar gnas snyam na/ bla ma 'ga' zhig sdom pa gsum cho ga dang rgyu rkyen tshogs pa tha dad las dus snga phyi thob pa'i phyir rdzas tha dad du gnas te/ de ltar ma yin na (1569) gcig btang pas gsum ka btang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ces gsungs na'ang*/ dang por thob pa'i sdom pa'i rdzas ngo bo ma nyams par phyis kyang gnas na/ dus gsum rdzas grub tu 'gyur zhing*/ skye ba mang por bsags pa'i las rnams kyang rnam smin ma byung gi bar du gang zag gcig gi rgyud la rdzas dpag tu med pa rdzas tha dad du gnas par 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan mtshungs pas ha cang thal ba yin no// sdom pa'i ngo bo ni mi mthun phyogs spong ba'i sems dpas nus ldan rkyen sngon du gyur pa'i tshe spong sems mngon du gyur gdon mi za ba yin la/

rnam shes tshogs brgyad dam drug gang yin kyang drug pa yid kyi shes pa las gzhan la spong sems 'byung ba mi srid cing*/ rnam par shes pa gcig gi 'khor du sems byung kun 'gro'i sems pa rdzas (1570) tha dad pa gsum dus mnyam du yod pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ sdom pa gsum ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i sgo nas tha dad du gnas par rigs so// rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i 'khrul spong du/ rgyud 'bum phrag lnga par/ rdo yi rigs kyi bye brag gis// gzhu bas lcags dang zangs dngul 'byung*// gser 'gyur rtsi yi sbyor ba yis// thams cad gser du sgyur bar byed// sems kyi rigs kyi khyad par gyis// rigs can gsum gyi dbye ba yang*// dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs pas// rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bya'o// zhes pa'i lung dang sbyar nas rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa rang bzhin gcig tu gsungs pa ltar chos rje nyid kyang bzhad pa yin la/ gcig btang bas thams cad gtang ba'i skyon du'ang mi 'gyur te/ lcags gong dmar 'bar ba'i tshe me lcags rdzas tha dad du ma grub kyang me (1571) log pas lcags log par ma grub pa bzhin no// sdom gsum mngon gyur rang rig ngo bo gcig yin la/ de yang rig bya rig byed yul dang yul can du phye ba'i rang rigs ma yin gyis/ bems po las log nas rig pa skyes tsam nyid yin par bzhed do// 'di tsam zhig dbu ma pa rnams kyis kyang rnam par bzhag dgos so// sdom pa gsum yang 'du shes dang lta ba dang sems phyin ci log tu gyur pa 'dul ba'i thabs yin pas 'dul ba'i tshul khrims su shes nas nyams su len dgos te/ nyi ma snying po'i mdor/ bdag gis sems kyi sangs rgyas su byed do// bdag gi sems kyis sangs rgyas mthong ngo*// bdag gi sems nyid sangs rgyas so// zhes pa dang*/ thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud du/ rang gi sems nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas// rtogs

(1572) par bya ba sems nyid yin// rang ni sems ni bsad bya ba// sems nyid kho na bsad par byos// rang sems rtogs pas sangs rgyas te// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rtogs pas min// zhes pa dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ bsnyengs yang bral la mang du gsol ci 'tshal// phan pa'i gdams ngag don po 'di lags so// khyod kyis thugs thul mdzod cig sems 'di ni// chos kyi rtsa ba lags par thub pas gsungs// zhes pa dang*/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong du/ thog med bag chags 'dam gyis ni// rin chen sems ni rab tu gos// shes rab thabs kyi chu nyid kyis// bkrus na rab tu gsal bar 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug mkhan pos kyang*/ sems 'di bsrung bar ma byas na// bslab pa bsrung bar yongs mi nus// sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs (1573) pa// brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya// zhes gsungs so// bslab pa bsrung ba'i tshul ni sems bsrung ba yin la/ de'i phyir dran pa dang shes bzhin bsten dgos te/ dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /srog la bab kyang bsrungs shig ces// bdag ni de skad 'doms par byed// ces gsungs pa de nyams su len tshul dbu ma snying por/ yid kyi glang po log 'gro ba// dmigs pa'i ka ba brtan po la// dran pa'i thag pas legs bcings nas// shes rab lcags kyus rim dbang bya// zhes pa ltar dge ba'i dmigs pa la rim gyis sbyar bas dul bar 'gyur te/ rnam bshad rigs par/ sems ni srin bu pad pa 'dra// stobs kyis dam pa'i chos ral brlan// de phyir don gyi ro rnyed na// de la g.yo ba med par gnas// zhes pa ltar ro// de ltar (1574) nyams su len pa'i las dang po pa 'tsho ba bsten tshul ni/ rta dbyangs kyi zhal snga nas/ ji ltar nags kyi ri dwags bzhin// rtsa ba sdong bu la sogs bza'// yang na bung bas me tog bzhin// yang dag 'tsho ba gtsang ma blang*// yang na thabs mkhas bya bzhin du// sdig med sog 'jog cung zad bya// ji ltar nags kyi dom bu bzhin// 'gro ba'i skyabs la brten par bya// zhes pa ltar log 'tsho spangs nas 'tsho ba dag pa la bsten no// nag po zhabs kyi/

gang zag las dang po pa'i lam gyi rim pa gsungs pa ni/ gzhi dad pa dang dad ldan dang*/ rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen brten cing yon tan len pa dang*/ de la sgo gsum gus pa dang*/ gdams ngag la yid ches pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ de la skyo ba med pa dang*/ nga rgyal spangs pa ste/ thog mar sgrub pa'i yan (1575) lag bdun dang*/ dus thams cad du gzhan skyon mi blta zhing mi brjod pa dang*/ rang gi yon tan gyis mi khengs pa dang*/ ngo tsha khrel yod kyis rang bsrung pa dang*/ sdom pa gsum la nan tan byed pa dang*/ ngo dga' gsar 'grogs med pa dang*/ spyod lam zungs thub pa dang*/ yul dus gnas skabs kyis gzhan gyi rgyud tshod shes pa dang*/ gzhan la brnyas pa dang*/ khyad bsod spang ste ya rabs kyi tshul mi nyams pa'i yan lag bdun dang*/ 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa dang*/ chags zhen spong ba dang*/ snyoms las spong ba dang*/ ha cang ngal cing dub pa yang tshod shes par bya ba dang*/ don shin tu mi 'gyur ba'i gtam dang bya ba spang ba dang*/ tshul min yid byed spang ba dang*/ nyon mongs gang gi gnyen por gang 'gro bar shes nas bstan pa ste/ bar chad (1576) spong ba'i yan lag bdun dang*/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba sems pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa don che bar sems pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba don med par sems pa dang*/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rang gi gnyen por bsten shes pa dang*/ myur du 'chi ba shes pa dang*/ longs spyod bsags pa 'dor bar shes pa dang*/ gnyer ma dang skra dkar la sogs pa brtags nas yid skyo bar byas te rang la bzhed bskul 'debs pa'i yan lag bdun dang*/ bslab par bya ba'i chos shin tu rgya che ste/ tshe zad par gyur du 'ong ngo zhes sems pa dang*/ sgra tsam shes pas gzhan mi thul cing mgu dka'o zhes sems pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' la chags sdang spangs te skur pa mi btab pa dang*/ 'dza' bshes dang nye du rnams lam gyi mgron po dang 'dra bar shes pa dang*/
'jig

(1577) rten gyi chos brgyad slu bar shes pa dang*/ khengs grags dang 'dod sred dug dang mtshon cha lta bur shes pa dang*/ dngos po thams cad rmi lam lta bur shes pa ste gdung ba bcad pa'i yan lag bdun dang*/ dben par gnas pa dang*/ lhag pa'i lha mnyes par bya ba dang*/ re dogs dang 'jigs pa spangs nas gnas pa dang*/ snying rje chen po sgom pa dang*/ lus dang srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar sgrub pa'i dam bcas pa dang*/ rmi lam bzang ngan la sogs mtshan mar mi 'dzin cing gzhan la mi smra ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i lhas spyod lam bstan pa la sogs shes par byas nas khyad du mi gsod pa ste 'dod don myur du 'grub pa'i yan lag bdun dang*/ chos sgrub pa'i rten gyi lus srung ba'i phyir zas gos dang sman la sogs pa ji ltar mthun pa bsten pa dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa (1578) bsrung ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i yul du gnas pa dang*/ lus sems dub pa'i bya ba mi byed pa dang*/ zas 'ju ba'i dus dang nam phyed nyin phyed nad khams bskyed pa'i dus su dmigs pa yid la mi byed pa dang*/ dub pa dang skyo ba bsang ba'i man ngag shes par bya ba dang*/ spyod lam mnyam par bzhag pa ste lus srung ba'i yan lag bdun dang*/ de ltar gnas pa'i skabs su dge ba la g.yel ba'i rnam rtog byung na/ rang la lcags gdab pa dang*/ nad glo bur ba dang shes pa mtho dma' byung na bla ma'i man dag gis bcos shing mkhas pa la dri bar bya ba dang*/ rgyal po'i bka' dang rang la nus pa yod na gzhan don sgrub pa dang*/ nyon mongs dang rnam rtog mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa'i gnyen po mi 'dra ba du ma ni mdo rgyud man ngag rnams las shes par bya ste/ kha skong ba'i yan lag bzhi'o// zhes (1579) gsungs pa ltar dam pa'i chos nyams su blang bar bya'o// gsum pa la gnyis/ bstan bcos rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ blo ldan gzu bor gnas pa'i blang byar gdams pa'o// dang po ni/

bdag gis sgra dang tshad ma bslabs// tshig gi sdeb sbyor rnams kyang shes// rgyan dang mngon brjod phal cher go /'dul ba dang ni mngon pa dang*// pha rol phyin pa phal cher thos// gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi po yang*// nyan bshad yod pa phal cher thos// thos pa de dag thams cad kyang*// ming rkyang tsam du ma bzhag go /zhes pa/ rig pa'i gnas rgol ba ngan pa de tshar gcod par byed pa'i yan lag tshig gtan la 'bebs pa'i sgra dang*/ don gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshad ma dang*/ sgra'i yan lag pra ta ra bkod na'i yi ge ci yang dang drag gzhan ring thung (1580) sna tshogs pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi tshigs bcad dang*/ lhug pa 'god pa dang*/ sdeb sbyor lus lta bu'i snyan dngags rgyan lta bu 'dogs pa la rang bzhin la sogs pa'i don rgyan sum cu rtsa gnyis re re la'ang*/ ngo bo dang khyad par gyi chos la sogs pa'i bye brag du ma dang*/ sgra rgyan bya dka' dang bya sla dang kun nas bskor ba la sogs pa rnams dang*/ dngos po re re la'ang bka' dang bstan bcos nas gsungs pa'i ming nyi ma dang*/ snang byed dang rta bdun can dang pad+mo'i gnyen dang bcu gnyis bdag po la sogs pa ming gi rnam grangs du ma ston pa'i mngon brjod dang*/ dri ba la lan la sogs pa'i tshig rnams chen po'i sa nas legs sbyar gyi skad dang*// blon po dmangs la sogs pa zur chag dang rang bzhin gyi skad dang*/ mi ma yin dang gdol pa la sogs pas sha za'i skad du bzlos shing*/ drug skyes (1581) dang bar ma dang gan dha ra la sogs pa'i dbyangs kyi yan lag dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dang bsdebs nas lus kyis gar stabs sna tshogs pa bsgyur cing*/ skye bo mang po 'dus pa'i dbus su rtse zhing rol ba'i zlos gar dang*/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin par byed pa'i yan lag bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang ri mo'i phyag tshad dang*/ lha pho mo dang zhi drag gi nyams dgu ji ltar 'god pa'i tshul dang*/

rgya bod kyi yi ge dang sman dang nor bu dang sa gzhi dang ljon shing brtag pa la sogs bzo rig pa dang*/ lus dang byis pa gdon lus stod// mtshon dug mche ba rgas ro rtsa// zhes pa'i yan lag brgyad kyis bsdus pa'i gso dpyad rlung dang mkhris bad kan 'dus pa rtsa ba bzhi po re re la brgya dang rtsa gcig tu phye ba'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyi rgyu dang rang bzhin dang gnyen po dang (1582) phyis mi 'byung bar byed pa'i tshul sman dang dpyad gso ba rig pa'i gnas rnams bslabs shing shes so// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rtogs pa'i chos tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum gtan la 'bebs par byed pa'i lung gi chos pha rol tu phyin pa dang mngon pa'i sde snod rnams legs par bslabs shing shes so// nang rig pa'i mchog rgyud sde bzhi 'grel pa dang bcas pa la 'chad nyan gyi srol yod pa rnams bslabs shing legs par shes so// rig pa'i gnas lnga po de dag kyang thos lo dang shes lo'i ming tsam ma yin te/ phyin ci ma log par khong du chud do// bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa// sems tsam dang ni dbu ma yi// gdams ngag ji snyed phal cher thos// deng sang bod na grags pa yi// zhi byed rdzogs chen gcod la sogs// skabs brgyad (1583) cig char sgom pa dang*// pha rol phyin pa'i blo sbyong dang*// bka' bsdams gdams ngag lugs gnyis dang*// zhes pa/ phyi rol mu stegs byed kyi grub mtha' mi mthun pa du ma dang*/ nang pa'i nyan thos bye brag tu smra ba'i grub mtha' mi mthun pa du ma dang*/ mdo sde pa dang sems tsam pa dang dbu ma pa'i grub mtha' la'ang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta so sos sbyar ba'i bstan bcos 'grel pa 'grel bshad grub mtha' khyad par phra rags 'dod tshul sna tshogs legs par bltas shing khong du chud pa yin no// de dag dang 'brel pa'i nyams len gyi gdams pa rnams kyang thos so// deng sang bod yul na grags pa'i pha dam pa'i zhi byed brgyud pa gsum dang*/

a ro'i rdzogs chen dang*/ a ma lam sgron gyi gcod chos dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi skabs brgyad kyi don cig (1584) char sgom pa jo bo rje nas brgyud pa dang*/ phar phyin theg pa'i nyams len blo sbyong gi gdams ngag zhus pa dang*/ gdams ngag pa las brgyud pa'i lugs rnams kyang thos shing khong du chud do// sa ra ha dang te lo pa// nag po spyod pa'i dh+wa ha dang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyag bir+wa pa'i// dh+wa ha'i seng ge zhes byas sogs// dh+wa ha'i bye brag mang du thos// rim lnga stan thog gcig pa dang*// nā ro'i chos drug lugs gsum dang*// gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs// de bzhin phag skor gdams ngag dang*// zhes pa/ sa ra ha'i dh+wa ha mdzod kyi glu la sogs pa phyag rgya chen po'i gzhung grub pa sde bdun snying po skor drug la sogs pa dang te lo pa dang nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje'i rtogs pa glur blangs pa'i dh+wa ha dang*/ grub thob bir+wa pa'i rtogs pa glur blangs pa dh+wa ha seng ge zhes bya ba dang*/ mai tri (1585) pa dang tha ga nī dh+wa ha la sogs pa mang du thos shing don ma nor bar shes so// gsang ba 'dus pa'i nyams len tshur dbang nges 'khon gad pa kirti la gdams pa'i snying po rgyun khyer gyi nyams len rim lnga stan thog gcig pa dang*/ mes ston tshon po dang dwags po'i slob ma gtsang bzher dang*/ rmog cog pa nas brgyud pa'i chos drug lugs gsum dang*/ gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs la 'grel pa 'dus pa'i rgyan dang*/ ljon shing snyims pa'i me tog la sogs pa dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi lugs mgos dang gnam kha'u pa nas brgyud pa rje btsun chen po la thos pa dang*/ kha che pan chen la gzhung gdams ngag dang bcas pa thos so// dgyes pa rdo rje snying po'i skor// gshin rje gshed dang 'jigs byed sogs// de yi gdams ngag gsar (1586) rnying dang*// 'khor lo sdom pa'i gdams ngag dang*// dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug sogs// mtshan brjod bshad pa lugs drug dang*// 'chi med grub pa'i gdams ngag dang*// lam 'bras la sogs lam skor dgu// de las 'phros pa du ma dang*// zhes pa/

dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud/ 'grel pa/ gdams ngag phyag rgya chen po snying po'i skor dang*/ gshin rje gshed/ dgra nag gdong drug 'jigs byed man ngag dang bcas pa sngags rnying ma'i lugs rnams kyang thos/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud 'grel gdams ngag dang bcas pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad pa dang*/ sbyor drug lugs mang po dang*/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa sgegs pa rdo rje'i sngags don rnam gzigs dang*/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa che chung gnyis dang*/ lam 'bras kyi lugs (1587) dang*/ dus 'khor gyi lugs dang dbu ma la dga' bas byas pa'i 'grel pa ste lugs drug dang*/ phyag rgya chen po 'chi med 'grub pa dang*/ lam 'bras dang*/ tog rtse pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa'i lam skor gyi gdams ngag dang*/ de dag las 'phros pa phran tshegs kyi gdams ngag mang po rnams kyang mnyan cing khong du chud do// gzhan yang bod dang rgya gar la// deng sang grags pa phal mo che// bdag gis legs par 'bad de mnyan// bslab pa de dag ming rkyang min// de phyir chos rnams phal cher thos// des na bdag la phyogs lhung med// de phyir gzu bos dpyad pa 'di// blo ldan rnams kyis 'di ltar zungs// zhes pa/ deng sang rgya bod na yongs su grags shing (1588) khungs btsun pa'i gdams ngag kha rag sgom chung gi rin dpung skor gsum/ tshom bu pa'i dmar khrid/ 'brog mi lo tsās mkhas pa sgo drug la gsan pa'i gdams pa la sogs 'bad pas brtsad gcod zhus shing khong du chud par byas so// de'i bod kyi bla ma dang chos lugs dang grwa pa'i rang phyogs dang*/ gzhan phyogs la dgag sgrub byed pa'i phyogs lhung cung zad kyang med do// des na chos dang chos ma yin lung dang rigs pas legs par brtags nas drang por bkod pa 'di la rnam dpyod kyi blo gros dang ldan pa'i skye bo dam pa'i chos bzhin spyod pa rnams kyis tshig don kha ton byed pa dang yid la 'dzin par mdzod cig

tha na snang ba med pa'i sems can gyi tshogs tha mal pa'i mig gis stong gsum gyi 'jig rten na mthong ba tsam kun mkhyen ye shes kyis shing rta'i 'khor lo tsam gyi (1589) khyon la gzigs shing*/ 'dul ba 'od ldan du/ 'phags pa ma 'gags pas chu'i nang bar do'i sems can gyis gang ba gzigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tha mal pa'i mig gis rtogs shig ces bka' stsal to// zhes pa ltar sems can gyi rigs de rnams la chos kyi sbyin pa bya bar gsungs pas/ dam pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du sgrogs shig gsum pa la bzhi/ bstan bcos kyi gnas lugs brjod pas blang dor bstan tshul/ blun po phyogs zhen can gyis rtogs dka' bar bstan pa/ brtsams pa'i dge ba gzhan don du bsngo ba/ bka' drin dran pas bla ma yi dam la 'dud pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen gzhal med khang*// log lta'i (1590) mun nag tshang tshing rnam par bsal// blo gsal blo yi pad+mo kha 'byed pa// bstan bcos nyi ma snang ba deng 'dir shar// zhes pa/ bstan bcos nyin mor byed pa'i 'od kyis chos log gi mun nag bsal nas gdul bya blo'i pad+mo rgyas par byas pa'i rgyan gsum bkod pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa 'di yin ces// 'gro la phan pa'i bsam pas bdag gis bshad// mkhas pa kun gyi dgongs pa 'di yin mod// da dung blun po rnams kyis rtogs par dka'// zhes pa/ thub pa'i gsung gi dgongs pa ma nor bar skye rgu la phan par 'dod pa'i lhag bsam gyis brtsams pa 'di mkhas pa'i bzhed pa 'os kyang*/ thos pa chung ba'i gang zag gis rtogs par dka'o zhes dgongs pa can du sbyar ba'o// gsum pa ni/ kun dga' nyi mas sangs (1591) rgyas bstan pa yi// pad+ma rnam par phye ba las byung ba'i// dam pa'i sbrang rtsis 'gro ba'i bung ba kun// rgyun du bde ba'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog

/ces pa/ bstan bcos brtsams pa'i dge ba lus can kun la phan bde'i rgyur bsngos pa ni/ rgyu dang byed las sbyar nas bkod pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ gang gi thugs brtses nyer bzung nas// log pa'i chos rnams spangs nas kyang*// sangs rgyas bstan dang legs sprod pa'i// 'jam mgon bla ma de la 'dud// ces pa/ phan btags pa'i drin rjes su dran pa ni/ skyes bu ya rabs kyi tshul yin cing*/ de las log pa ni chos dang 'jig rten gyis rnam par smad cing spang bar bya ba yin te/ phal po cher/ lha'i sras po dag khyod kyi drin du bzo bar mdzod la/ drin du (1592) mi bzo ba med par mdzod cig lha'i sras po dag byas pa mi dran pa dag ni lha ma yin gyi g.yul du phal cher gzhan gyis bsad cing 'chi bar 'gyur te/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang*/ drin du mi bzo ba'i sems can de dag ni dmyal bar dong par 'gyur ro// zhes pa dang*/ skye bo gso thig las/ rgya mtsho dang ni ri rab gling la sogs// 'jig rten pa rnams bdag gis 'khur min gyis// 'jig rten byas ba mi bzo gang yin pa// de ni bdag gi 'khur chen dag tu 'byung*// zhes pas/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas gus pas 'dud pa ni/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas yin pas/ bstan bcos kyi thog mar legs par bkod pa yin no// sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba sh+lau (1593) stong gi bdag nyid ces bya ba/ chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos/ mang du thos pa'i nor dang ldan pa/ rigs pa dang mi rigs pa dpyod par nus pa'i blo gros can/ sde snod 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba rdzogs so// //bye brag tu gsang sngags kyi gnad gtan la dbab pa/ gsang chen yin pas kho bos logs su bshad par blta'o// dri ma med pa'i bstan pa'i dam chos phyogs bcur rgyas par gyur cig/

//mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi mkhyen pa'i chu gter las/ legs par 'khrungs pa'i bstan 'dzin yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ gangs can gyi skye bo'i blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i rgyan du gyur pa/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i gsung rab sdom pa gsum gyi rab (1594) tu dbye ba legs par bshad pa 'di ni/ brjod bya'i don zab cing rgya che ba/ shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag la khyab pa/ nam mkha'i mtha' lta bu la kho bo'i blo gros bung ba'i bgrod pa lta bus dpag par mi nus mod kyi/ 'on kyang thub pa'i bka' rab 'byams la mkhyen pa'i spyan rgyas shing*/ 'gro ba mtha' dag la bu gcig pa'i ma ltar brtse ba'i thugs rje snyoms par 'jug pas/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'gro ba rnams kyi skyabs gnas mchog tu gyur pa/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi rdul la reg cing*/ gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud cung zad myangs pa dang*/ yongs 'dzin mkhas grub du ma'i legs bshad rna bar lhung bas gsung rab zab mo'i don la blo kha cung zad phyogs par gyur nas spobs pa skyes shing*/

(1595) thub pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos la mi phyed pa'i dad gus brtan pos dbu'i thod ltar 'khur cing*/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta khu dbon gyi chos lugs bzang po gdengs can gyi gtsug rgyan ltar gus pas spyi bo'i gtsug rgyan du 'dzin pa bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po rab brtan kun tu bzang po sku mched kyi gsung gis yang yang bskul ba dang*/ phyogs gzhan na bzhugs pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa dag gis kyang*/ rjes su yi rang ba'i thugs kyis dran bskul dag byung ba la brten nas/ kun mkhyen gyi gsung dang las kyi rnam smin la rkyen gyis mi 'phrogs pa'i yid ches rnyed pa/ khyung gi rigs su skyes pa'i ban rgan rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ nyang stod kyi yul ljongs kyi bye brag spos khang zhes bya bar/ chos nyid kyi gtan tshigs dang sbyar na/ thub dbang (1596) zhi ba'i dbyings su bzhugs pa'i tshul bstan nas/ lo sum stong lnga brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa/ chu mo yos bu'i lo tha dkar gyi zla ba'i tshes grangs bzang po dga' ba'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin legs par grub pa'o// //bstan bcos 'di ni chu gter ji bzhin gting mtha' dpag par dka' ba dang*// kho bo'i blo gros ku sha'i rtse ltar cung zad bgrod par mi nus pas// tshig don rgya che legs par 'byed pa'i gzhung lugs brtsams par mi nus kyang*// 'gro ba'i lhag bsam bzang pos sbyar ba yin// 'di na kha cig rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos du ma yi// tshig dang don rnams phyogs 'dzin rtogs pas rang 'dod phyogs su bcus shing ston// chos dang gang zag khyad du gsod pa'ang thub pa'i dbang pos bkag pa'i (1597) phyir// zhes 'dod phyogs 'dzin 'dir nas dge ba 'od dkar phreng ba nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam pa dang*// sa steng skye dgu'i log rtog mun nag 'thibs po'i tshogs rnams rab bcom zhing*// bden gnyis gnas lugs legs par rtogs pa'i blo gros kun da'i tshal rgyas nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sa chen ma lus kun nas 'khengs pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/legs bshad legs bshad tshig dang don la 'khrul pa'i dri ma mchis gyur na// zur gnas blo ldan mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod pa'i chab kyis dag par mdzod// gangs ri'i khrod kyi mi rnams phal ches kyang*// rtsod dus snyigs ma'i skyon dang bcas pa'i phyir// blo gros gzu bor gnas pa shin tu (1598) dkon// de phyir bden par smra ba'ang rgya lam tsam// rgyal dang rgyal sras stobs bcu mnga' bas kyang*// sems can mos pa sna tshogs mi mgu na// kho bos legs bshad dbyangs snyan bsgrags gyur kyang*// deng sang dus kyi skye bo su zhig 'dzin// 'on kyang yongs 'dzin dam pa'i bka' drin dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi rigs sngags 'od zer gyis// snying gi mun nag rags pa bcom pa'i phyir// mkhas pa'i dgongs pa 'khrul med legs par bshad// 'di na phyi nang grub mtha'i rnam dbye dang*// theg pa gsum dang rgyud sde rnam bzhi yi// rtogs par dka' ba'i don rnams shin tu gsal// don gnyer yid kyi dga' ston mi zad gter// tshig don bzang po'i longs spyod sna tshogs yod// gegs med ci dgar longs (1599) spyod dges par rol// gal te 'ga' zhig smod cing 'dor na yang*// phyogs 'dzin rang blo'i dri mas gos pa snyam// sangs rgyas bstan la skad cig mi g.yel bar// srung skyobs mdzad pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// thub pas bka' bsgo zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams// thogs med mthu stobs dpung dang ldan gyur cig /bstan la zhugs pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig gis// bsam sbyor nongs pas khyed thugs mi skyo bar// skye dgu rnams kyi phan dang bde ba'i gzhi// sangs rgyas bstan pa yun du rgyas par mdzod// lhag bsam bzang pos bskul ma 'debs pa dang*// bsam sbyor bzang pos mthun rkyen sgrub pa dang*// spro bas yi ge'i 'du byed sbyor ba rnams// don gnyis phun sum tshogs (1600) pa 'byor gyur cig

/bdag kyang byams mgon chen po'i zhabs drung du// theg chen dam chos bdud rtsi'i bcud 'thungs nas// stong nyid snying rje'i nus pa rab rgyas te// mkha' dang srid pa ji srid gnas kyi bar// rgyal dang rgyal sras bzhed pa ji bzhin du// dam chos spel cing 'gro ba 'dren par shog /thub dbang sras dang bcas pa'i yon tan dang*// phrin las mthu stobs thogs pa med pa dang*// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa yis// phan bde'i 'byor pa kun tu rgyas gyur cig /'di'i yi ge pa ni/ sgo gsum thub pa'i gsung dang mthun cing sde snod la sbyangs pa/ pu hrang pa'i zhang btsun dge ba'i bshes gnyen mañdzu shrīs kun slong dge ba'i yid (1601) kyis bgyis pa'o// tshig don nor pa'i gzhi byed pas kun la ma grags pa'i bsdus yig mi 'bri ba gal che'o// phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //mad+ga laṃ// sid+dhi// shu bhaṃ// // 'di'i ma dpe ldi li nas kun bzang stobs rgyal dang ma ṇi rdo rje gnyis nas par bskrun gnang ba zhig las ma phyi ma rnyed stabs ma dpe 'di ni chad lhag mang bas nor bcos ma thub pa mang dag yod pa shes ldan yongs la dgongs 'jag zhu// 1$0000220༈ /bal yul nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las gu rus spel/// /1$0000270
